ps1.1:421.2.verse: principlenānattaṁ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṁ, phassanānattaṁ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṁ, vedanānānattaṁ paṭicca uppajjati saññānānattaṁ, saññānānattaṁ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṁ, saṅkappanānattaṁ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṁ, chandanānattaṁ paṭicca uppajjati pariḷāhanānattaṁ, pariḷāhanānattaṁ paṭicca uppajjati pariyesanānānattaṁ, pariyesanānānattaṁ paṭicca uppajjati lābhanānattaṁ—

ps1.1:422.1.verse: Kathaṁ abhiññāpaññā ñātaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, pariññāpaññā tīraṇaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, pahāne paññā pariccāgaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, bhāvanā paññā ekarasaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, sacchikiriyāpaññā phassanaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:422.2.verse: Ye ye dhammā abhiññātā honti, te te dhammā ñātā honti.

ps1.1:422.3.verse: Ye ye dhammā pariññātā honti, te te dhammā tīritā honti.

ps1.1:422.4.verse: Ye ye dhammā pahīnā honti, te te dhammā pariccattā honti.

ps1.1:422.5.verse: Ye ye dhammā bhāvitā honti, te te dhammā ekaFlavours honti.

ps1.1:422.6.verse: Ye ye dhammā sacchikatā honti, te te dhammā phassitā honti.

ps1.1:422.9.verse: “abhiññā paññā ñātaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, pariññā paññā tīraṇaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, pahāne paññā pariccāgaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, bhāvanā paññā ekarasaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, sacchikiriyā paññā phassanaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:423.1.verse: Kathaṁ atthanānatte paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammanānatte paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttinānatte paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānanānatte paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:423.2.verse: Saddhindriyaṁ dhammo, vīriyindriyaṁ dhammo, satindriyaṁ dhammo, samādhindriyaṁ dhammo, paññindriyaṁ dhammo.

ps1.1:423.3.verse: Añño saddhindriyaṁ dhammo, añño vīriyindriyaṁ dhammo, añño satindriyaṁ dhammo, añño samādhindriyaṁ dhammo, añño paññindriyaṁ dhammo.

ps1.1:423.4.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:424.1.verse: Adhimokkhaṭṭho attho, paggahaṭṭho attho, upaṭṭhānaṭṭho attho, avikkhepaṭṭho attho, dassanaṭṭho attho.

ps1.1:424.2.verse: Añño adhimokkhaṭṭho attho, añño paggahaṭṭho attho, añño upaṭṭhānaṭṭho attho, añño avikkhepaṭṭho attho, añño dassanaṭṭho attho.

ps1.1:424.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā atthā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā atthā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:425.1.verse: Pañca dhamme sandassetuṁ byañjananiruttābhilāpā, pañca atthe sandassetuṁ byañjananiruttābhilāpā.

ps1.1:425.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena imā nānā niruttiyo ñātā, teneva ñāṇena imā nānā niruttiyo paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:426.1.verse: Pañcasu dhammesu ñāṇāni, pañcasu atthesu ñāṇāni, dasasu niruttīsu ñāṇāni.

ps1.1:426.2.verse: Aññāni dhammesu ñāṇāni, aññāni atthesu ñāṇāni, aññāni niruttīsu ñāṇāni.

ps1.1:426.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā ñāṇā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā ñāṇā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:427.1.verse: Saddhābalaṁ dhammo, vīriyabalaṁ dhammo, satibalaṁ dhammo, samādhibalaṁ dhammo, paññābalaṁ dhammo.

ps1.1:427.2.verse: Añño saddhābalaṁ dhammo, añño vīriyabalaṁ dhammo, añño satibalaṁ dhammo, añño samādhibalaṁ dhammo, añño paññābalaṁ dhammo.

ps1.1:427.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:428.6.verse: Añño assaddhiye akampiyaṭṭho attho, añño kosajje akampiyaṭṭho attho, añño pamāde akampiyaṭṭho attho, añño uddhacce akampiyaṭṭho attho, añño avijjāya akampiyaṭṭho attho.

ps1.1:428.7.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā atthā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā atthā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:429.1.verse: Pañca dhamme sandassetuṁ byañjananiruttābhilāpā, pañca atthe sandassetuṁ byañjananiruttābhilāpā.

ps1.1:429.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena imā nānā niruttiyo ñātā, teneva ñāṇena imā nānā niruttiyo paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:430.1.verse: Pañcasu dhammesu ñāṇāni, pañcasu atthesu ñāṇāni, dasasu niruttīsu ñāṇāni.

ps1.1:430.2.verse: Aññāni dhammesu ñāṇāni, aññāni atthesu ñāṇāni, aññāni niruttīsu ñāṇāni.

ps1.1:430.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā ñāṇā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā ñāṇā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:431.1.verse: Satisambojjhaṅgo dhammo, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo dhammo, vīriyasambojjhaṅgo dhammo, pītisambojjhaṅgo dhammo, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo dhammo, samādhisambojjhaṅgo dhammo, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo dhammo.

ps1.1:431.2.verse: Añño satisambojjhaṅgo dhammo, añño dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo dhammo, añño vīriyasambojjhaṅgo dhammo, añño pītisambojjhaṅgo dhammo, añño passaddhisambojjhaṅgo dhammo, añño samādhisambojjhaṅgo dhammo, añño upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo dhammo.

ps1.1:431.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:432.1.verse: Upaṭṭhānaṭṭho attho, pavicayaṭṭho attho, paggahaṭṭho attho, pharaṇaṭṭho attho, upasamaṭṭho attho, avikkhepaṭṭho attho, paṭisaṅkhānaṭṭho attho.

ps1.1:432.2.verse: Añño upaṭṭhānaṭṭho attho, añño pavicayaṭṭho attho, añño paggahaṭṭho attho, añño pharaṇaṭṭho attho, añño upasamaṭṭho attho, añño avikkhepaṭṭho attho, añño paṭisaṅkhānaṭṭho attho.

ps1.1:432.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā atthā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā atthā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:433.1.verse: Satta dhamme sandassetuṁ byañjananiruttābhilāpā, satta atthe sandassetuṁ byañjananiruttābhilāpā.

ps1.1:433.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena imā nānā niruttiyo ñātā, teneva ñāṇena imā nānā niruttiyo paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:434.1.verse: Sattasu dhammesu ñāṇāni, sattasu atthesu ñāṇāni, cuddasasu niruttīsu ñāṇāni.

ps1.1:434.2.verse: Aññāni dhammesu ñāṇāni, aññāni atthesu ñāṇāni, aññāni niruttīsu ñāṇāni.

ps1.1:434.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā ñāṇā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā ñāṇā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:435.1.verse: Sammādiṭṭhi dhammo, sammāsaṅkappo dhammo, sammāvācā dhammo, sammākammanto dhammo, sammāājīvo dhammo, sammāvāyāmo dhammo, sammāsati dhammo, sammāsamādhi dhammo.

ps1.1:435.2.verse: Añño sammādiṭṭhi dhammo, añño sammāsaṅkappo dhammo, añño sammāvācā dhammo, añño sammākammanto dhammo, añño sammāājīvo dhammo, añño sammāvāyāmo dhammo, añño sammāsati dhammo, añño sammāsamādhi dhammo.

ps1.1:435.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:436.1.verse: Dassanaṭṭho attho, abhiniropanaṭṭho attho, pariggahaṭṭho attho, samuṭṭhānaṭṭho attho, vodānaṭṭho attho, paggahaṭṭho attho, upaṭṭhānaṭṭho attho, avikkhepaṭṭho attho.

ps1.1:436.2.verse: Añño dassanaṭṭho attho, añño abhiniropanaṭṭho attho, añño pariggahaṭṭho attho, añño samuṭṭhānaṭṭho attho, añño vodānaṭṭho attho, añño paggahaṭṭho attho, añño upaṭṭhānaṭṭho attho, añño avikkhepaṭṭho attho.

ps1.1:436.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā atthā ñātā teneva ñāṇena ime nānā atthā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:437.1.verse: Aṭṭha dhamme sandassetuṁ byañjananiruttābhilāpā, aṭṭha atthe sandassetuṁ byañjananiruttābhilāpā.

ps1.1:437.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena imā nānā niruttiyo ñātā, teneva ñāṇena imā nānā niruttiyo paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:438.1.verse: Aṭṭhasu dhammesu ñāṇāni, aṭṭhasu atthesu ñāṇāni soḷasasu niruttīsu ñāṇāni.

ps1.1:438.2.verse: Aññāni dhammesu ñāṇāni, aññāni atthesu ñāṇāni, aññāni niruttīsu ñāṇāni.

ps1.1:438.3.verse: Yena ñāṇena ime nānā ñāṇā ñātā, teneva ñāṇena ime nānā ñāṇā paṭividitāti.

ps1.1:439.1.verse: Kathaṁ vihāranānatte paññā vihāraṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, samāpattinānatte paññā samāpattaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, vihārasamāpattinānatte paññā vihārasamāpattaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:439.2.verse: Nimittaṁ bhayato sampassamāno animitte adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati—

ps1.1:439.3.verse: animitto vihāro. paṇidhiṁ bhayato sampassamāno appaṇihite adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati—

ps1.1:439.5.verse: Abhinivesaṁ bhayato sampassamāno suññate adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati—

ps1.1:440.1.verse: Nimittaṁ bhayato sampassamāno animitte adhimuttattā pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ animittaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:440.2.verse: animittā samāpatti. paṇidhiṁ bhayato sampassamāno appaṇihite adhimuttattā pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ appaṇihitaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:440.4.verse: Abhinivesaṁ bhayato sampassamāno suññate adhimuttattā pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ suññataṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:441.1.verse: Nimittaṁ bhayato sampassamāno animitte adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati, pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ animittaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:441.2.verse: animittavihārasamāpatti. paṇidhiṁ bhayato sampassamāno appaṇihite adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati, pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ appaṇihitaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:441.4.verse: Abhinivesaṁ bhayato sampassamāno suññate adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati, pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ suññataṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:442.1.verse: Rūpanimittaṁ bhayato sampassamāno animitte adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati—

ps1.1:442.3.verse: Rūpapaṇidhiṁ bhayato sampassamāno appaṇihite adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati—

ps1.1:442.5.verse: Rūpābhinivesaṁ bhayato sampassamāno suññate adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati—

ps1.1:443.1.verse: Rūpanimittaṁ bhayato sampassamāno animitte adhimuttattā pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ animittaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:443.3.verse: Rūpapaṇidhiṁ bhayato sampassamāno appaṇihite adhimuttattā pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ appaṇihitaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:443.5.verse: Rūpābhinivesaṁ bhayato sampassamāno suññate adhimuttattā pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ suññataṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:444.1.verse: Rūpanimittaṁ bhayato sampassamāno animitte adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati, pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ animittaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:444.3.verse: Rūpapaṇidhiṁ bhayato sampassamāno appaṇihite adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati, pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ appaṇihitaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:444.5.verse: Rūpābhinivesaṁ bhayato sampassamāno suññate adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati, pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ suññataṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:445.6.verse: jarāmaraṇanimittaṁ bhayato sampassamāno animitte adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati—

ps1.1:445.8.verse: Jarāmaraṇapaṇidhiṁ bhayato sampassamāno appaṇihite adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati—

ps1.1:445.10.verse: Jarāmaraṇābhinivesaṁ bhayato sampassamāno suññate adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati—

ps1.1:446.1.verse: Jarāmaraṇanimittaṁ bhayato sampassamāno animitte adhimuttattā pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ animittaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:446.3.verse: Jarāmaraṇapaṇidhiṁ bhayato sampassamāno appaṇihite adhimuttattā pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ appaṇihitaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:446.5.verse: Jarāmaraṇābhinivesaṁ bhayato sampassamāno suññate adhimuttattā pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ suññataṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:447.1.verse: Jarāmaraṇanimittaṁ bhayato sampassamāno animitte adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati, pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ animittaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:447.3.verse: Jarāmaraṇapaṇidhiṁ bhayato sampassamāno appaṇihite adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati, pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ appaṇihitaṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:447.5.verse: Jarāmaraṇābhinivesaṁ bhayato sampassamāno suññate adhimuttattā phussa phussa vayaṁ passati, pavattaṁ ajjhupekkhitvā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ suññataṁ āvajjitvā samāpajjati—

ps1.1:447.7.verse: Añño animitto vihāro, añño appaṇihito vihāro, añño suññato vihāro.

ps1.1:447.8.verse: Aññā animittā samāpatti, aññā appaṇihitā samāpatti, aññā suññatā samāpatti.

ps1.1:447.9.verse: Aññā animittā vihārasamāpatti, aññā appaṇihitā vihārasamāpatti, aññā suññatā vihārasamāpatti.

ps1.1:447.12.verse: “vihāranānatte paññā vihāraṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, samāpattinānatte paññā samāpattaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ, vihārasamāpattinānatte paññā vihārasamāpattaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:448.1.verse: Kathaṁ avikkhepaparisuddhattā āsavasamucchede paññā ānantarikasamādhimhi ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:450.2.verse: Sotāpattimaggena anavaseso diṭṭhāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo kāmāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo bhavāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:450.4.verse: Sakadāgāmimaggena oḷāriko kāmāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho bhavāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:450.6.verse: Anāgāmimaggena anavaseso kāmāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho bhavāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:450.8.verse: Arahattamaggena anavaseso bhavāsavo khīyati, anavaseso avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:451.11.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spacevasena …

ps1.1:451.13.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessvasena …

ps1.1:451.14.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionvasena …

ps1.1:452.27.verse: paṭinissaggānupassī passāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi.

ps1.1:452.28.verse: Tassa samādhissa vasena uppajjati ñāṇaṁ, tena ñāṇena āsavā khīyanti.

ps1.1:453.4.verse: Sotāpattimaggena anavaseso diṭṭhāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo kāmāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo bhavāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:453.6.verse: Sakadāgāmimaggena oḷāriko kāmāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho bhavāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:453.8.verse: Anāgāmimaggena anavaseso kāmāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho bhavāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:453.10.verse: Arahattamaggena anavaseso bhavāsavo khīyati, anavaseso avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:454.1.verse: Kathaṁ dassanādhipateyyaṁ santo ca vihārādhigamo paṇītādhimuttatā paññā araṇavihāre ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:455.1.verse: **Dassanādhipateyyan**ti aniccānupassanā dassanādhipateyyaṁ, dukkhānupassanā dassanādhipateyyaṁ, anattānupassanā dassanādhipateyyaṁ, rūpe aniccānupassanā dassanādhipateyyaṁ, rūpe dukkhānupassanā dassanādhipateyyaṁ, rūpe anattānupassanā dassanādhipateyyaṁ;

ps1.1:455.7.verse: jarāmaraṇe aniccānupassanā dassanādhipateyyaṁ, jarāmaraṇe dukkhānupassanā dassanādhipateyyaṁ, jarāmaraṇe anattānupassanā dassanādhipateyyaṁ.

ps1.1:456.1.verse: **Santo ca vihārādhigamo**ti suññato vihāro santo vihārādhigamo.

ps1.1:458.5.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless space araṇavihāro …pe…

ps1.1:458.6.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perception araṇavihāro.

ps1.1:459.10.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceyā rūpasaññaṁ paṭighasaññaṁ nānattasaññaṁ haratīti—

ps1.1:459.14.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessyā consciousnessñcāyatanasaññaṁ haratīti—

ps1.1:459.16.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññaṁ haratīti—

ps1.1:459.21.verse: “dassanādhipateyyaṁ santo ca vihārādhigamo paṇītādhimuttatā paññā araṇavihāre ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:460.1.verse: Kathaṁ dvīhi balehi samannāgatattā tayo ca saṅkhārānaṁ paṭippassaddhiyā soḷasahi ñāṇacariyāhi navahi samādhicariyāhi vasibhāvatā paññā nirodhasamāpattiyā ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:462.10.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceyā Perception of visible objectsya paṭighasaññāya nānattasaññāya na kampatīti—

ps1.1:462.14.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessyā consciousnessñcāyatanasaññāya na kampatīti—

ps1.1:462.16.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāya na kampatīti—

ps1.1:462.18.verse: Uddhacce ca uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca na kampati na calati na vedhatīti—

ps1.1:464.16.verse: Avijjāya ca Ignorance sahagatakilese ca khandhe ca na kampati na calati na vedhatīti—

ps1.1:465.1.verse: **Tayo ca saṅkhārānaṁ paṭippassaddhiyā**ti katamesaṁ tiṇṇannaṁ saṅkhārānaṁ paṭippassaddhiyā?

ps1.1:465.2.verse: The second jhana samāpannassa vitakkavicārā vacīformations paṭippassaddhā honti.

ps1.1:465.3.verse: The fourth jhana samāpannassa assāsapassāsā Bodyformations paṭippassaddhā honti.

ps1.1:465.4.verse: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṁ samāpannassa saññā ca feeling  ca cittaformations paṭippassaddhā honti.

ps1.1:466.2.verse: Aniccānupassanā ñāṇacariyā, dukkhānupassanā ñāṇacariyā, anattānupassanā ñāṇacariyā, nibbidānupassanā ñāṇacariyā, virāgānupassanā ñāṇacariyā, nirodhānupassanā ñāṇacariyā, paṭinissaggānupassanā ñāṇacariyā, vivaṭṭanānupassanā ñāṇacariyā, sotāpattimaggo ñāṇacariyā, sotāpattiphalasamāpatti ñāṇacariyā, sakadāgāmimaggo ñāṇacariyā, sakadāgāmiphalasamāpatti ñāṇacariyā, anāgāmimaggo ñāṇacariyā, anāgāmiphalasamāpatti ñāṇacariyā, arahattamaggo ñāṇacariyā, arahattaphalasamāpatti ñāṇacariyā—

ps1.1:467.2.verse: The first jhana samādhicariyā, The second jhana samādhicariyā, The third jhana samādhicariyā, The fourth jhana samādhicariyā, The attainment of the base consisting of boundless space …pe…

ps1.1:467.4.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingness …

ps1.1:467.5.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perception samādhicariyā.

ps1.1:467.6.verse: The first jhana paṭilābhatthāya vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca …pe…

ps1.1:467.7.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionṁ paṭilābhatthāya vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca—

ps1.1:468.3.verse: The first jhana yatthicchakaṁ yadicchakaṁ yāvaticchakaṁ āvajjati;

ps1.1:468.6.verse: The first jhana yatthicchakaṁ yadicchakaṁ yāvaticchakaṁ samāpajjati;

ps1.1:468.9.verse: The first jhana yatthicchakaṁ yadicchakaṁ yāvaticchakaṁ adhiṭṭhāti;

ps1.1:468.12.verse: The first jhana yatthicchakaṁ yadicchakaṁ yāvaticchakaṁ vuṭṭhāti;

ps1.1:468.15.verse: The first jhana yatthicchakaṁ yadicchakaṁ yāvaticchakaṁ paccavekkhati;

ps1.1:469.2.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionṁ yatthicchakaṁ yadicchakaṁ yāvaticchakaṁ āvajjati;

ps1.1:469.5.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionṁ yatthicchakaṁ yadicchakaṁ yāvaticchakaṁ samāpajjati …pe…

ps1.1:469.14.verse: “dvīhi balehi samannāgatattā tayo ca saṅkhārānaṁ paṭippassaddhiyā soḷasahi ñāṇacariyāhi navahi samādhicariyāhi vasībhāvatā paññā nirodhasamāpattiyā ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:470.1.verse: Kathaṁ sampajānassa pavattapariyādāne paññā parinibbāne ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:470.2.verse: Idha sampajāno nekkhammena kāmacchandassa pavattaṁ pariyādiyati, abyāpādena byāpādassa pavattaṁ pariyādiyati, ālokasaññāya thinamiddhassa pavattaṁ pariyādiyati, avikkhepena uddhaccassa pavattaṁ pariyādiyati, dhammavavatthānena vicikicchāya …pe…

ps1.1:471.1.verse: Atha vā pana sampajānassa anupādisesāya nibbāna principleyā parinibbāyantassa idañceva Eyepavattaṁ pariyādiyati, aññañca Eyepavattaṁ na uppajjati.

ps1.1:471.6.verse: Mindpavattaṁ pariyādiyati, aññañca Mindpavattaṁ na uppajjati.

ps1.1:471.7.verse: Idaṁ sampajānassa pavattapariyādāne paññā parinibbāne ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:472.1.verse: Kathaṁ sabbadhammānaṁ sammā samucchede nirodhe ca anupaṭṭhānatā paññā samasīsaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:472.3.verse: pañcakkhandhā, dvādasāyatanāni, aṭṭhārasa  principleyo, kusalā dhammā, akusalā dhammā, abyākatā dhammā, kāmāvacarā dhammā, rūpāvacarā dhammā, arūpāvacarā dhammā, apariyāpannā dhammā.

ps1.1:474.8.verse: The first jhana paṭiladdhassa nīvaraṇā na upaṭṭhahanti …pe…

ps1.1:475.8.verse: Nīvaraṇānaṁ pahīnattā The first jhana samaṁ …pe…

ps1.1:476.2.verse: palibodhasīsañca taṇhā, vinibandhanasīsañca māno, parāmāsasīsañca diṭṭhi, vikkhepasīsañca uddhaccaṁ, saṅkilesasīsañca avijjā, adhimokkhasīsañca saddhā, paggahasīsañca vīriyaṁ, upaṭṭhānasīsañca sati, avikkhepasīsañca samādhi, dassanasīsañca paññā, pavattasīsañca jīvitindriyaṁ, gocarasīsañca vimokkho, saṅkhārasīsañca nirodho.

ps1.1:476.5.verse: “sabbadhammānaṁ sammā samucchede nirodhe ca anupaṭṭhānatā paññā samasīsaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:477.3.verse: rāgo puthu, doso puthu, moho puthu, kodho …pe…

ps1.1:478.8.verse: Nīvaraṇā nānattaṁ, The first jhana ekattaṁ …pe…

ps1.1:479.2.verse: caraṇaThe fire, guṇaThe fire, paññāThe fire, puññaThe fire, dhammaThe fire.

ps1.1:480.8.verse: Nīvaraṇā asallekho, The first jhana sallekho …pe…

ps1.1:481.2.verse: Anuppannānaṁ pāpakānaṁ akusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ anuppādāya asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:481.3.verse: Uppannānaṁ pāpakānaṁ akusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ pahānāya asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:481.4.verse: Anuppannānaṁ kusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ uppādāya asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:481.5.verse: Uppannānaṁ kusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:482.1.verse: Anuppannassa kāmacchandassa anuppādāya asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:482.2.verse: Uppannassa kāmacchandassa pahānāya asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:482.3.verse: Anuppannassa nekkhammassa uppādāya asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:482.4.verse: Uppannassa nekkhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ …pe….

ps1.1:483.1.verse: Anuppannānaṁ sabbakilesānaṁ anuppādāya asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:483.2.verse: Uppannānaṁ sabbakilesānaṁ pahānāya asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ …pe…

ps1.1:483.3.verse: anuppannassa arahattamaggassa uppādāya asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:483.4.verse: Uppannassa arahattamaggassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā asallīnattapahitattapaggahaṭṭhe paññā vīriyārambhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:484.2.verse: **Nānādhammā**ti pañcakkhandhā, dvādasāyatanāni, aṭṭhārasa  principleyo, kusalā dhammā, akusalā dhammā, abyākatā dhammā, kāmāvacarā dhammā, rūpāvacarā dhammā, arūpāvacarā dhammā, apariyāpannā dhammā.

ps1.1:488.3.verse: imehi dvādasahi ākārehi sabbe dhammā ekasaṅgahitā.

ps1.1:492.11.verse: Yaṁ yaṁ viditaṁ taṁ taṁ khamatīti—

ps1.1:493.2.verse: materiality  aniccato phusati, materiality  dukkhato phusati, materiality  anattato phusati.

ps1.1:493.3.verse: Yaṁ yaṁ phusati taṁ taṁ pariyogahatīti—

ps1.1:493.10.verse: aging and death aniccato phusati, dukkhato phusati, anattato phusati.

ps1.1:493.11.verse: Yaṁ yaṁ phusati taṁ taṁ pariyogahatīti—

ps1.1:495.1.verse: Chando ca avūpasanto hoti, vitakko ca avūpasanto hoti, saññā ca avūpasantā hoti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṁ.

ps1.1:495.2.verse: Chando ca vūpasanto hoti, vitakko ca avūpasanto hoti, saññā ca avūpasantā hoti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṁ.

ps1.1:495.3.verse: Chando ca vūpasanto hoti, vitakko ca vūpasanto hoti, saññā ca avūpasantā hoti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṁ.

ps1.1:495.4.verse: Chando ca vūpasanto hoti, vitakko ca vūpasanto hoti, saññā ca vūpasantā hoti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṁ.

ps1.1:495.5.verse: Appattassa pattiyā atthi āyavaṁ, tasmimpi ṭhāne anuppatte tappaccayāpi vedayitaṁ.

ps1.1:499.2.verse: “Eye suññaṁ attena vā attaniyena vā niccena vā dhuvena vā sassatena vā avipariṇāmadhammena vā”ti yathābhūtaṁ jānato passato cakkhābhinivesato ñāṇaṁ vivaṭṭatīti—

ps1.1:499.8.verse: Mind suñño attena vā attaniyena vā niccena vā dhuvena vā sassatena vā avipariṇāmadhammena vā”ti yathābhūtaṁ jānato passato manābhinivesato ñāṇaṁ vivaṭṭatīti—

ps1.1:501.2.verse: Dukkhassa pīḷanaṭṭhaṁ saṅkhataṭṭhaṁ santāpaṭṭhaṁ vipariṇāmaṭṭhaṁ parijānanto vivaṭṭatīti—

ps1.1:501.4.verse: Samudayassa āyūhanaṭṭhaṁ nidānaṭṭhaṁ saññogaṭṭhaṁ palibodhaṭṭhaṁ pajahanto vivaṭṭatīti—

ps1.1:501.6.verse: Nirodhassa nissaraṇaṭṭhaṁ vivekaṭṭhaṁ asaṅkhataṭṭhaṁ amataṭṭhaṁ sacchikaronto vivaṭṭatīti—

ps1.1:501.8.verse: Maggassa niyyānaṭṭhaṁ hetuṭṭhaṁ dassanaṭṭhaṁ ādhipateyyaṭṭhaṁ bhāvento vivaṭṭatīti—

ps1.1:503.5.verse: Yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo, tattha ñāṇavivaṭṭo.

ps1.1:503.6.verse: Yattha ñāṇavivaṭṭo, tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo.

ps1.1:503.7.verse: Yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo, tattha vimokkhavivaṭṭo.

ps1.1:503.8.verse: Yattha vimokkhavivaṭṭo, tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo.

ps1.1:503.9.verse: Yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo vimokkhavivaṭṭo, tattha saccavivaṭṭo.

ps1.1:503.10.verse: Yattha saccavivaṭṭo, tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo vimokkhavivaṭṭo.

ps1.1:504.1.verse: Kathaṁ Bodympi cittampi ekavavatthānatā sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca adhiṭṭhānavasena ijjhanaṭṭhe paññā iddhividhe ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:504.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti, cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti, vīmaṁsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti.

ps1.1:504.3.verse: So imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṁ paribhāveti paridameti, muduṁ karoti kammaniyaṁ.

ps1.1:504.4.verse: So imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṁ paribhāvetvā paridametvā muduṁ karitvā kammaniyaṁ Bodympi citte samodahati, cittampi kāye samodahati, Bodyvasena cittaṁ pariṇāmeti, cittavasena Bodyṁ pariṇāmeti, Bodyvasena cittaṁ adhiṭṭhāti, cittavasena Bodyṁ adhiṭṭhāti;

ps1.1:504.5.verse: Bodyvasena cittaṁ pariṇāmetvā cittavasena Bodyṁ pariṇāmetvā Bodyvasena cittaṁ adhiṭṭhahitvā cittavasena Bodyṁ adhiṭṭhahitvā sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati.

ps1.1:504.6.verse: So tathābhāvitena cittena parisuddhena pariyodātena iddhividhañāṇāya cittaṁ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

ps1.1:505.1.verse: Ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti;

ps1.1:505.3.verse: tirokuṭṭaṁ tiropākāraṁ tiropabbataṁ asajjamāno gacchati, seyyathāpi ākāse;

ps1.1:505.6.verse: ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati, seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo;

ps1.1:505.7.verse: imepi candimasūriye evaṁmahiddhike evaṁmahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjati;

ps1.1:505.11.verse: “Bodympi cittampi ekavavatthānatā sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca adhiṭṭhānavasena ijjhanaṭṭhe paññā iddhividhe ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:506.1.verse: Kathaṁ vitakkavipphāravasena nānattekattasaddanimittānaṁ pariyogāhaṇe paññā Ear- principlevisuddhiñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:506.6.verse: So imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṁ paribhāveti paridameti, muduṁ karoti kammaniyaṁ.

ps1.1:506.7.verse: So imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṁ paribhāvetvā paridametvā, muduṁ karitvā kammaniyaṁ dūrepi Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, santikepi Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, oḷārikānampi Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, sukhumānampi Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, saṇhasaṇhānampi Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, puratthimāyapi disāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, pacchimāyapi disāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, uttarāyapi disāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, dakkhiṇāyapi disāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, puratthimāyapi anudisāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, pacchimāyapi anudisāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, uttarāyapi anudisāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, dakkhiṇāyapi anudisāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, heṭṭhimāyapi disāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti, uparimāyapi disāya Soundsnaṁ saddanimittaṁ manasi karoti.

ps1.1:506.8.verse: So tathābhāvitena cittena parisuddhena pariyodātena Ear- principlevisuddhiñāṇāya cittaṁ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

ps1.1:506.9.verse: So dibbāya Ear- principleyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusiBody ubho sadde suṇāti—

ps1.1:506.10.verse: dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike ca.

ps1.1:507.1.verse: Kathaṁ tiṇṇaṁ cittānaṁ vipphārattā indriyānaṁ pasādavasena nānattekattaconsciousnesscariyāpariyogāhaṇe paññā cetopariyañāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:507.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhi …pe…

ps1.1:507.5.verse: So imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṁ paribhāveti paridameti, muduṁ karoti kammaniyaṁ.

ps1.1:507.6.verse: So imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṁ paribhāvetvā paridametvā, muduṁ karitvā kammaniyaṁ evaṁ pajānāti—

ps1.1:507.7.verse: “idaṁ materiality  somanassindriyasamuṭṭhitaṁ, idaṁ materiality  domanassindriyasamuṭṭhitaṁ, idaṁ materiality  upekkhindriyasamuṭṭhitan”ti.

ps1.1:507.8.verse: So tathābhāvitena cittena parisuddhena pariyodātena cetopariyañāṇāya cittaṁ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

ps1.1:507.9.verse: So parasattānaṁ parapuggalānaṁ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti—

ps1.1:507.28.verse: “tiṇṇaṁ cittānaṁ vipphārattā indriyānaṁ pasādavasena nānattekattaconsciousnesscariyāpariyogāhaṇe paññā cetopariyañāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:508.1.verse: Kathaṁ paccayapavattānaṁ dhammānaṁ nānattekattakammavipphāravasena pariyogāhaṇe paññā pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:508.4.verse: “imasmiṁ sati idaṁ hoti, imassuppādā idaṁ uppajjati, yadidaṁ—

ps1.1:508.5.verse: avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā consciousness, consciousnesspaccayā nāmarūpaṁ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṁ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṁ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā aging and death sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti;

ps1.1:509.1.verse: So tathābhāvitena cittena parisuddhena pariyodātena pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṁ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

ps1.1:509.3.verse: ekampi jātiṁ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṁsampi jātiyo cattālīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo, jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi, anekepi saṁvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṁvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe—

ps1.1:509.4.verse: “amutrāsiṁ evaṁnāmo evaṅgotto evaṁvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṁsukhadukkhappaṭisaṁvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṁ;

ps1.1:509.5.verse: tatrāpāsiṁ evaṁnāmo evaṅgotto evaṁvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṁsukhadukkhappaṭisaṁvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapanno”ti.

ps1.1:509.6.verse: Iti sākāraṁ sauddesaṁ anekavihitaṁ pubbenivāsaṁ anussarati.

ps1.1:510.1.verse: Kathaṁ obhāsavasena nānattekattarūpanimittānaṁ dassanaṭṭhe paññā dibbaEyeñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:510.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhi …pe…

ps1.1:510.5.verse: So imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṁ paribhāveti paridameti, muduṁ karoti kammaniyaṁ.

ps1.1:510.6.verse: So imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṁ paribhāvetvā paridametvā, muduṁ karitvā kammaniyaṁ ālokasaññaṁ manasi karoti, divāsaññaṁ adhiṭṭhāti—

ps1.1:510.7.verse: “yathā divā tathā rattiṁ, yathā rattiṁ tathā divā”.

ps1.1:510.8.verse: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṁ cittaṁ bhāveti.

ps1.1:510.9.verse: So tathābhāvitena cittena parisuddhena pariyodātena sattānaṁ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṁ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

ps1.1:510.10.verse: So dibbena Eyenā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena, satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti—

ps1.1:510.11.verse: “ime vata bhonto sattā Bodyduccaritena samannāgatā, vacīduccaritena samannāgatā, Mindduccaritena samannāgatā, ariyānaṁ upavādakā, micchādiṭṭhikā, micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā;

ps1.1:510.12.verse: te Bodyssa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapannā.

ps1.1:510.13.verse: Ime vā pana bhonto sattā Bodysucaritena samannāgatā, vacīsucaritena samannāgatā, Mindsucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṁ anupavādakā, sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā;

ps1.1:510.14.verse: te Bodyssa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapannā”ti.

ps1.1:510.15.verse: Iti dibbena Eyenā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.

ps1.1:511.1.verse: Kathaṁ catusaṭṭhiyā ākārehi tiṇṇannaṁ indriyānaṁ vasibhāvatā paññā āsavānaṁ khaye ñāṇaṁ?

ps1.1:512.1.verse: Anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṁ kati ṭhānāni gacchati, aññindriyaṁ kati ṭhānāni gacchati, aññātāvindriyaṁ kati ṭhānāni gacchati?

ps1.1:512.5.verse: sotāpattiphalaṁ, sakadāgāmimaggaṁ, sakadāgāmiphalaṁ, anāgāmimaggaṁ, anāgāmiphalaṁ, arahattamaggaṁ.

ps1.1:513.1.verse: Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe anaññātaññassāmītindriyassa saddhindriyaṁ adhimokkhaparivāraṁ hoti, vīriyindriyaṁ paggahaparivāraṁ hoti, satindriyaṁ upaṭṭhānaparivāraṁ hoti, samādhindriyaṁ avikkhepaparivāraṁ hoti, paññindriyaṁ dassanaparivāraṁ hoti, manindriyaṁ vijānanaparivāraṁ hoti, somanassindriyaṁ abhisandanaparivāraṁ hoti, jīvitindriyaṁ pavattasantatādhipateyyaparivāraṁ hoti.

ps1.1:513.2.verse: Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe jātā dhammā ṭhapetvā cittasamuṭṭhānaṁ materiality  sabbeva kusalā honti, sabbeva anāsavā honti, sabbeva niyyānikā honti, sabbeva apacayagāmino honti, sabbeva lokuttarā honti, sabbeva nibbānārammaṇā honti.

ps1.1:513.3.verse: Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe anaññātaññassāmītindriyassa imāni aṭṭhindriyāni sahajātaparivārā honti, aññamaññaparivārā honti, nissayaparivārā honti, sampayuttaparivārā honti, sahagatā honti, sahajātā honti, saṁsaṭṭhā honti, sampayuttā honti.

ps1.1:513.4.verse: Teva tassa ākārā ceva honti parivārā ca.

ps1.1:514.1.verse: Sotāpattiphalakkhaṇe aññindriyassa saddhindriyaṁ adhimokkhaparivāraṁ hoti, vīriyindriyaṁ paggahaparivāraṁ hoti, satindriyaṁ upaṭṭhānaparivāraṁ hoti, samādhindriyaṁ avikkhepaparivāraṁ hoti, paññindriyaṁ dassanaparivāraṁ hoti, manindriyaṁ vijānanaparivāraṁ hoti, somanassindriyaṁ abhisandanaparivāraṁ hoti, jīvitindriyaṁ pavattasantatādhipateyyaparivāraṁ hoti.

ps1.1:514.2.verse: Sotāpattiphalakkhaṇe jātā dhammā sabbeva abyākatā honti, ṭhapetvā cittasamuṭṭhānaṁ materiality  sabbeva anāsavā honti, sabbeva lokuttarā honti, sabbeva nibbānārammaṇā honti.

ps1.1:514.3.verse: Sotāpattiphalakkhaṇe aññindriyassa imāni aṭṭhindriyāni sahajātaparivārā honti, aññamaññaparivārā honti, nissayaparivārā honti, sampayuttaparivārā honti, sahagatā honti, sahajātā honti, saṁsaṭṭhā honti, sampayuttā honti.

ps1.1:514.4.verse: Teva tassa ākārā ceva honti parivārā ca.

ps1.1:515.7.verse: Arahattamaggakkhaṇe jātā dhammā ṭhapetvā cittasamuṭṭhānaṁ materiality  sabbeva kusalā honti, sabbeva anāsavā honti, sabbeva niyyānikā honti, sabbeva apacayagāmino honti, sabbeva lokuttarā honti, sabbeva nibbānārammaṇā honti.

ps1.1:515.8.verse: Arahattamaggakkhaṇe aññindriyassa imāni aṭṭhindriyāni sahajātaparivārā honti, aññamaññaparivārā honti, nissayaparivārā honti, sampayuttaparivārā honti, sahagatā honti, sahajātā honti, saṁsaṭṭhā honti, sampayuttā honti.

ps1.1:515.9.verse: Teva tassa ākārā ceva honti parivārā ca.

ps1.1:516.1.verse: Arahattaphalakkhaṇe aññātāvindriyassa saddhindriyaṁ adhimokkhaparivāraṁ hoti, vīriyindriyaṁ paggahaparivāraṁ hoti, satindriyaṁ upaṭṭhānaparivāraṁ hoti, samādhindriyaṁ avikkhepaparivāraṁ hoti, paññindriyaṁ dassanaparivāraṁ hoti, manindriyaṁ vijānanaparivāraṁ hoti, somanassindriyaṁ abhisandanaparivāraṁ hoti, jīvitindriyaṁ pavattasantatādhipateyyaparivāraṁ hoti.

ps1.1:516.2.verse: Arahattaphalakkhaṇe jātā dhammā sabbeva abyākatā honti, ṭhapetvā cittasamuṭṭhānaṁ materiality  sabbeva anāsavā honti, sabbeva lokuttarā honti, sabbeva nibbānārammaṇā honti.

ps1.1:516.3.verse: Arahattaphalakkhaṇe aññātāvindriyassa imāni aṭṭhindriyāni sahajātaparivārā honti, aññamaññaparivārā honti, nissayaparivārā honti, sampayuttaparivārā honti, sahagatā honti, sahajātā honti, saṁsaṭṭhā honti, sampayuttā honti.

ps1.1:516.4.verse: Teva tassa ākārā ceva honti parivārā ca.

ps1.1:517.4.verse: Sotāpattimaggena anavaseso diṭṭhāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo kāmāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo bhavāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:517.6.verse: Sakadāgāmimaggena oḷāriko kāmāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho bhavāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:517.8.verse: Anāgāmimaggena anavaseso kāmāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho bhavāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:517.10.verse: Arahattamaggena anavaseso bhavāsavo khīyati, anavaseso avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.1:517.14.verse: “catusaṭṭhiyā ākārehi tiṇṇannaṁ indriyānaṁ vasibhāvatā paññā āsavānaṁ khaye ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:518.1.verse: Kathaṁ pariññaṭṭhe paññā **dukkhe ñāṇaṁ**, pahānaṭṭhe paññā **samudaye ñāṇaṁ**, sacchikiriyaṭṭhe paññā **nirodhe ñāṇaṁ**, bhāvanaṭṭhe paññā **magge ñāṇaṁ**?

ps1.1:518.2.verse: Dukkhassa pīḷanaṭṭho saṅkhataṭṭho santāpaṭṭho vipariṇāmaṭṭho pariññātaṭṭho;

ps1.1:518.3.verse: samudayassa āyūhanaṭṭho nidānaṭṭho saññogaṭṭho palibodhaṭṭho pahānaṭṭho;

ps1.1:518.4.verse: nirodhassa nissaraṇaṭṭho vivekaṭṭho asaṅkhataṭṭho amataṭṭho sacchikiriyaṭṭho;

ps1.1:518.5.verse: maggassa niyyānaṭṭho hetuṭṭho dassanaṭṭho ādhipateyyaṭṭho bhāvanaṭṭho.

ps1.1:518.8.verse: “pariññaṭṭhe paññā dukkhe ñāṇaṁ, pahānaṭṭhe paññā samudaye ñāṇaṁ, sacchikiriyaṭṭhe paññā nirodhe ñāṇaṁ, bhāvanaṭṭhe paññā magge ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:519.1.verse: Kathaṁ **dukkhe ñāṇaṁ, dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṁ, dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṁ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṁ**?

ps1.1:519.2.verse: Maggasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṁ dukkhepetaṁ ñāṇaṁ, dukkhasamudayepetaṁ ñāṇaṁ, dukkhanirodhepetaṁ ñāṇaṁ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyapetaṁ ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:520.2.verse: suffering ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṁ kosallaṁ nepuññaṁ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūri medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṁ patodo paññā paññindriyaṁ paññābalaṁ paññāsatthaṁ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṁ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi—

ps1.1:520.6.verse: dukkhanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadaṁ ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā …pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi—

ps1.1:520.10.verse: “dukkhe ñāṇaṁ, dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṁ, dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṁ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:521.1.verse: Kathaṁ **atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ**?

ps1.1:521.2.verse: Atthesu ñāṇaṁ atthapaṭisambhidā, dhammesu ñāṇaṁ dhammapaṭisambhidā, niruttīsu ñāṇaṁ niruttipaṭisambhidā, paṭibhānesu ñāṇaṁ paṭibhānapaṭisambhidā.

ps1.1:521.3.verse: Atthanānatte paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammanānatte paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttinānatte paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānanānatte paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, atthavavatthāne paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammavavatthāne paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ niruttivavatthāne paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānavavatthāne paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:522.1.verse: Atthasallakkhaṇe paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammasallakkhaṇe paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttisallakkhaṇe paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānasallakkhaṇe paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:522.2.verse: Atthūpalakkhaṇe paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammūpalakkhaṇe paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttūpalakkhaṇe paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānūpalakkhaṇe paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:523.1.verse: Atthappabhede paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammappabhede paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttippabhede paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānappabhede paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:523.2.verse: Atthappabhāvane paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammappabhāvane paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttippabhāvane paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānappabhāvane paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:524.1.verse: Atthajotane paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammajotane paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttijotane paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānajotane paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:524.2.verse: Atthavirocane paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammavirocane paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttivirocane paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānavirocane paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:524.3.verse: Atthappakāsane paññā atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammappakāsane paññā dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttippakāsane paññā niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānappakāsane paññā paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:524.6.verse: “atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ, paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ”.

ps1.1:525.2.verse: Idha tathāgato satte passati apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvino.

ps1.1:526.1.verse: **Apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe**ti saddho puggalo apparajakkho, assaddho puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.1:526.2.verse: Āraddhavīriyo puggalo apparajakkho, kusīto puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.1:526.3.verse: Upaṭṭhitassati puggalo apparajakkho, muṭṭhassati puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.1:526.4.verse: Samāhito puggalo apparajakkho, asamāhito puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.1:526.5.verse: Paññavā puggalo apparajakkho, duppañño puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.1:527.1.verse: **Tikkhindriye mudindriye**ti saddho puggalo tikkhindriyo, assaddho puggalo mudindriyo.

ps1.1:527.2.verse: Āraddhavīriyo puggalo tikkhindriyo, kusīto puggalo mudindriyo.

ps1.1:527.3.verse: Upaṭṭhitassati puggalo tikkhindriyo, muṭṭhassati puggalo mudindriyo.

ps1.1:527.4.verse: Samāhito puggalo tikkhindriyo, asamāhito puggalo mudindriyo.

ps1.1:527.5.verse: Paññavā puggalo tikkhindriyo, duppañño puggalo mudindriyo.

ps1.1:528.1.verse: **Svākāre dvākāre**ti saddho puggalo svākāro, assaddho puggalo dvākāro.

ps1.1:528.2.verse: Āraddhavīriyo puggalo svākāro, kusīto puggalo dvākāro.

ps1.1:528.3.verse: Upaṭṭhitassati puggalo svākāro, muṭṭhassati puggalo dvākāro.

ps1.1:528.4.verse: Samāhito puggalo svākāro, asamāhito puggalo dvākāro.

ps1.1:528.5.verse: Paññavā puggalo svākāro, duppañño puggalo dvākāro.

ps1.1:529.1.verse: **Suviññāpaye duviññāpaye**ti saddho puggalo suviññāpayo, assaddho puggalo duviññāpayo.

ps1.1:529.2.verse: Āraddhavīriyo puggalo suviññāpayo, kusīto puggalo duviññāpayo.

ps1.1:529.3.verse: Upaṭṭhitassati puggalo suviññāpayo, muṭṭhassati puggalo duviññāpayo.

ps1.1:529.4.verse: Samāhito puggalo suviññāpayo, asamāhito puggalo duviññāpayo.

ps1.1:529.5.verse: Paññavā puggalo suviññāpayo, duppañño puggalo duviññāpayo.

ps1.1:530.1.verse: **Appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino, appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvino**ti saddho puggalo paralokavajjabhayadassāvī, assaddho puggalo na paralokavajjabhayadassāvī.

ps1.1:530.2.verse: Āraddhavīriyo puggalo paralokavajjabhayadassāvī, kusīto puggalo na paralokavajjabhayadassāvī.

ps1.1:530.3.verse: Upaṭṭhitassati puggalo paralokavajjabhayadassāvī, muṭṭhassati puggalo na paralokavajjabhayadassāvī.

ps1.1:530.4.verse: Samāhito puggalo paralokavajjabhayadassāvī, asamāhito puggalo na paralokavajjabhayadassāvī.

ps1.1:530.5.verse: Paññavā puggalo paralokavajjabhayadassāvī, duppañño puggalo na paralokavajjabhayadassāvī.

ps1.1:531.2.verse: khandhaloko,  principleloko, āyatanaloko, vipattibhavaloko, vipattisambhavaloko, sampattibhavaloko, sampattisambhavaloko.

ps1.1:544.1.verse: **Vajjan**ti sabbe kilesā vajjā, sabbe duccaritā vajjā, sabbe abhiformations vajjā, sabbe bhavagāmikammā vajjā.

ps1.1:544.2.verse: Iti imasmiñca loke imasmiñca vajje tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, seyyathāpi ukkhittāsike vadhake.

ps1.1:544.3.verse: Imehi paññāsāya ākārehi imāni pañcindriyāni jānāti passati aññāti paṭivijjhati—

ps1.1:545.2.verse: Idha tathāgato sattānaṁ āsayaṁ jānāti, anusayaṁ jānāti, caritaṁ jānāti, adhimuttiṁ jānāti, bhabbābhabbe satte pajānāti.

ps1.1:545.4.verse: “Sassato loko”ti vā, “asassato loko”ti vā, “antavā loko”ti vā, “anantavā loko”ti vā, “taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran”ti vā, “aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran”ti vā, “hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā”ti vā, “na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā”ti vā, “hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā”ti vā, “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā”ti vā.

ps1.1:545.5.verse: Iti bhavadiṭṭhisannissitā vā sattā honti vibhavadiṭṭhisannissitā vā.

ps1.1:546.1.verse: Ete vā pana ubho ante anupagamma idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu anulomikā khanti paṭiladdhā hoti, yathābhūtaṁ vā ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.1:547.3.verse: kāmarāgānusayo, paṭighānusayo, mānānusayo, diṭṭhānusayo, vicikicchānusayo, bhavarāgānusayo, avijjānusayo.

ps1.1:547.4.verse: Yaṁ loke piyamateriality  sātarūpaṁ, ettha sattānaṁ kāmarāgānusayo anuseti.

ps1.1:547.5.verse: Yaṁ loke appiyamateriality  asātarūpaṁ, ettha sattānaṁ paṭighānusayo anuseti.

ps1.1:547.6.verse: Iti imesu dvīsu dhammesu Ignorance anupatitā, tadekaṭṭho māno ca diṭṭhi ca vicikicchā ca daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.1:548.2.verse: Puññābhisaṅkhāro apuññābhisaṅkhāro āneñjābhisaṅkhāro parittabhūmako vā mahābhūmako vā.

ps1.1:549.2.verse: Santi sattā hīnādhimuttikā, santi sattā paṇītādhimuttikā.

ps1.1:549.3.verse: Hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttike satte sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti.

ps1.1:549.4.verse: Paṇītādhimuttikā sattā paṇītādhimuttike satte sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti.

ps1.1:549.5.verse: Atītampi addhānaṁ hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttike satte seviṁsu bhajiṁsu payirupāsiṁsu;

ps1.1:549.6.verse: paṇītādhimuttikā sattā paṇītādhimuttike satte seviṁsu bhajiṁsu payirupāsiṁsu.

ps1.1:549.7.verse: Anāgatampi addhānaṁ hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttike satte sevissanti bhajissanti payirupāsissanti;

ps1.1:549.8.verse: paṇītādhimuttikā sattā paṇītādhimuttike satte sevissanti bhajissanti payirupāsissanti.

ps1.1:550.2.verse: Ye te sattā kammāvaraṇena samannāgatā, kilesāvaraṇena samannāgatā, vipākāvaraṇena samannāgatā, assaddhā acchandikā duppaññā, abhabbā niyāmaṁ okkamituṁ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṁ—

ps1.1:551.2.verse: Ye te sattā na kammāvaraṇena samannāgatā, na kilesāvaraṇena samannāgatā, na vipākāvaraṇena samannāgatā, saddhā chandikā paññavanto, bhabbā niyāmaṁ okkamituṁ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṁ—

ps1.1:552.2.verse: Idha tathāgato yamakapāṭihīraṁ karoti asādhāraṇaṁ sāvakehi.

ps1.1:555.9.verse: avijjāgato lokasannivāso aṇḍabhūto pariyonaddho tantākulakajāto kulāgaṇḍikajāto muñjapabbajabhūto apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ saṁsāraṁ nātivattatīti—

ps1.1:555.14.verse: tassa natthañño koci jaṭaṁ vijaṭetā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:559.8.verse: rāgabandhanena dosabandhanena mohabandhanena mānabandhanena diṭṭhibandhanena kilesabandhanena duccaritabandhanena;

ps1.1:559.9.verse: tassa natthañño koci bandhanaṁ mocetā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:559.12.verse: tassa natthañño koci okāsaṁ dassetā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:559.15.verse: tassa natthañño koci palibodhaṁ chetā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:559.18.verse: tassa natthañño koci papātā uddhatā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:559.21.verse: tassa natthañño koci kantāraṁ tāretā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:560.10.verse: tassa natthañño koci bandhanaṁ mocetā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:560.13.verse: tassa natthañño koci tāyetā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:561.6.verse: tassa natthañño koci ariyapathaṁ ānetā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:561.9.verse: tassa natthañño koci oghā uddhatā, aññatra mayāti—

ps1.1:563.6.verse: pahomi khvāhaṁ tiṇṇo tāretuṁ, mutto mocetuṁ, danto dametuṁ, santo sametuṁ, assattho assāsetuṁ, parinibbuto pare ca parinibbāpetunti—

ps1.1:566.1.verse: Eye ceva rūpā ca, evaṁ taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:566.9.verse: Mind ceva dhammā ca, evaṁ taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:567.1.verse: Yāvatā aniccaṭṭhaṁ dukkhaṭṭhaṁ anattaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:567.5.verse: Yāvatā rūpassa aniccaṭṭhaṁ dukkhaṭṭhaṁ anattaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:567.14.verse: jarāmaraṇassa aniccaṭṭhaṁ dukkhaṭṭhaṁ anattaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:568.1.verse: Yāvatā abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:568.8.verse: yāvatā sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:569.1.verse: Yāvatā khandhānaṁ khandhaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:569.8.verse: yāvatā asaṅkhatassa asaṅkhataṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:571.1.verse: Yāvatā dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:571.7.verse: yāvatā maggassa maggaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:572.1.verse: Yāvatā atthapaṭisambhidāya atthapaṭisambhidaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:572.7.verse: yāvatā paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāya paṭibhānapaṭisambhidaṭṭhaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:573.7.verse: yāvatā mahākaruṇāsamāpattiyā ñāṇaṁ, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:574.1.verse: Yāvatā sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṁ sutaṁ mutaṁ viññātaṁ pattaṁ pariyesitaṁ anuvicaritaṁ manasā, taṁ sabbaṁ jānātīti—

ps1.1:576.3.verse: Dukkhe ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, atthapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, dhammapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, niruttipaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, paṭibhānapaṭisambhide ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, indriyaparopariyattañāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, sattānaṁ āsayānusaye ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, yamakapāṭihīre ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, mahākaruṇāsamāpattiyā ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, sabbaññutaññāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, anāvaraṇañāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ—

ps1.1:576.5.verse: Imesaṁ cuddasannaṁ buddhañāṇānaṁ aṭṭha ñāṇāni sāvakasādhāraṇāni;

ps1.1:577.6.verse: Yāvatā dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho, sabbo ñāto, sabbo diṭṭho, sabbo vidito, sabbo sacchikato, sabbo phassito paññāya;

ps1.1:577.17.verse: yāvatā paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāya paṭibhānapaṭisambhidaṭṭho, sabbo ñāto, sabbo diṭṭho, sabbo vidito, sabbo sacchikato, sabbo phassito paññāya;

ps1.1:578.5.verse: sabbaṁ ñātaṁ, sabbaṁ diṭṭhaṁ, sabbaṁ viditaṁ, sabbaṁ sacchikataṁ, sabbaṁ phassitaṁ paññāya;

ps1.1:579.1.verse: Yāvatā sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṁ sutaṁ mutaṁ viññātaṁ pattaṁ pariyesitaṁ anuvicaritaṁ manasā, sabbaṁ ñātaṁ, sabbaṁ diṭṭhaṁ, sabbaṁ viditaṁ, sabbaṁ sacchikataṁ, sabbaṁ phassitaṁ paññāya;

ps1.3:1.2.verse: aṭṭha paripanthe ñāṇāni, aṭṭha ca upakāre ñāṇāni, aṭṭhārasa upakkilese ñāṇāni, terasa vodāne ñāṇāni, bāttiṁsa satokārissa ñāṇāni, catuvīsati samādhivasena ñāṇāni, dvesattati vipassanāvasena ñāṇāni, aṭṭha nibbidāñāṇāni, aṭṭha nibbidānulomañāṇāni, aṭṭha nibbidāpaṭippassaddhiñāṇāni, ekavīsati vimuttisukhe ñāṇāni.

ps1.3:2.1.verse: Katamāni aṭṭha paripanthe ñāṇāni, aṭṭha ca upakāre ñāṇāni?

ps1.3:2.2.verse: Kāmacchando samādhissa paripantho, nekkhammaṁ samādhissa upakāraṁ.

ps1.3:2.3.verse: Byāpādo samādhissa paripantho, abyāpādo samādhissa upakāraṁ.

ps1.3:2.4.verse: Thinamiddhaṁ samādhissa paripantho, ālokasaññā samādhissa upakāraṁ.

ps1.3:2.5.verse: Uddhaccaṁ samādhissa paripantho, avikkhepo samādhissa upakāraṁ.

ps1.3:2.6.verse: Vicikicchā samādhissa paripantho, dhammavavatthānaṁ samādhissa upakāraṁ.

ps1.3:2.7.verse: Ignorance samādhissa paripantho, ñāṇaṁ samādhissa upakāraṁ.

ps1.3:2.8.verse: Arati samādhissa paripantho, pāmojjaṁ samādhissa upakāraṁ.

ps1.3:2.9.verse: Sabbepi akusalā dhammā samādhissa paripanthā, sabbepi kusalā dhammā samādhissa upakārā.

ps1.3:2.10.verse: Imāni aṭṭha paripanthe ñāṇāni, aṭṭha ca upakāre ñāṇāni.

ps1.3:3.1.verse: Imehi soḷasahi ākārehi uducitaṁ cittaṁ samuducitaṁ cittaṁ ekatte santiṭṭhati, nīvaraṇehi visujjhati.

ps1.3:3.3.verse: Nekkhammaṁ ekattaṁ, abyāpādo ekattaṁ, ālokasaññā ekattaṁ, avikkhepo ekattaṁ, dhammavavatthānaṁ ekattaṁ, ñāṇaṁ ekattaṁ, pāmojjaṁ ekattaṁ, sabbepi kusalā dhammā ekattā.

ps1.3:4.2.verse: Kāmacchando nīvaraṇaṁ, byāpādo nīvaraṇaṁ, thinamiddhaṁ nīvaraṇaṁ, uddhaccakukkuccaṁ nīvaraṇaṁ, vicikicchā nīvaraṇaṁ, Ignorance nīvaraṇaṁ, arati nīvaraṇaṁ, sabbepi akusalā dhammā nīvaraṇā.

ps1.3:7.4.verse: Tena ca kāmacchandena nivutattā nekkhammaṁ ariyānaṁ niyyānaṁ nappajānātīti—

ps1.3:8.4.verse: Tena ca byāpādena nivutattā abyāpādaṁ ariyānaṁ niyyānaṁ nappajānātīti—

ps1.3:9.4.verse: Tena ca thinamiddhena nivutattā ālokasaññaṁ ariyānaṁ niyyānaṁ nappajānātīti—

ps1.3:10.4.verse: Tena ca uddhaccena nivutattā avikkhepaṁ ariyānaṁ niyyānaṁ nappajānātīti—

ps1.3:11.4.verse: Tāya ca vicikicchāya nivutattā dhammavavatthānaṁ ariyānaṁ niyyānaṁ nappajānātīti—

ps1.3:12.4.verse: Tāya ca avijjāya nivutattā ñāṇaṁ ariyānaṁ niyyānaṁ nappajānātīti—

ps1.3:13.4.verse: Tāya ca aratiyā nivutattā pāmojjaṁ ariyānaṁ niyyānaṁ nappajānātīti—

ps1.3:14.2.verse: Tehi ca kusalehi dhammehi ariyā niyyanti.

ps1.3:14.4.verse: Tehi ca akusalehi dhammehi nivutattā kusale dhamme ariyānaṁ niyyānaṁ nappajānātīti—

ps1.3:15.1.verse: Imehi ca pana nīvaraṇehi visuddhacittassa soḷasavatthukaṁ ānāpānassatisamādhiṁ bhāvayato khaṇikasamodhānā katame aṭṭhārasa upakkilesā uppajjanti?

ps1.3:15.2.verse: Assāsādimajjhapariyosānaṁ satiyā anugacchato ajjhattavikkhepagataṁ cittaṁ samādhissa paripantho.

ps1.3:15.3.verse: Passāsādimajjhapariyosānaṁ satiyā anugacchato bahiddhāvikkhepagataṁ cittaṁ samādhissa paripantho.

ps1.3:27.1.verse: Assāsādimajjhapariyosānaṁ satiyā anugacchato ajjhattaṁ vikkhepagatena cittena kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:27.2.verse: Passāsādimajjhapariyosānaṁ satiyā anugacchato bahiddhāvikkhepagatena cittena kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:27.3.verse: Assāsapaṭikaṅkhanāya nikantiyā taṇhācariyāya kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:27.4.verse: Passāsapaṭikaṅkhanāya nikantiyā taṇhācariyāya kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:27.5.verse: Assāsenābhitunnassa passāsapaṭilābhe mucchitattā kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:27.6.verse: Passāsenābhitunnassa assāsapaṭilābhe mucchitattā kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.1.verse: Nimittaṁ āvajjato assāse cittaṁ vikampitattā kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.2.verse: Assāsaṁ āvajjato nimitte cittaṁ vikampitattā kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.3.verse: Nimittaṁ āvajjato passāse cittaṁ vikampitattā kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.4.verse: Passāsaṁ āvajjato nimitte cittaṁ vikampitattā kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.5.verse: Assāsaṁ āvajjato passāse cittaṁ vikampitattā kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.6.verse: Passāsaṁ āvajjato assāse cittaṁ vikampitattā kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.7.verse: Atītānudhāvanena cittena vikkhepānupatitena kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.8.verse: Anāgatapaṭikaṅkhanena cittena vikampitena kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.9.verse: Līnena cittena kosajjānupatitena kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.10.verse: Atipaggahitena cittena uddhaccānupatitena kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.11.verse: Abhinatena cittena rāgānupatitena kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:28.12.verse: Apanatena cittena byāpādānupatitena kāyopi cittampi sāraddhā ca honti iñjitā ca phanditā ca.

ps1.3:31.1.verse: Imehi ca pana nīvaraṇehi visuddhacittassa soḷasavatthukaṁ ānāpānassatisamādhiṁ bhāvayato khaṇikasamodhānā ime aṭṭhārasa upakkilesā uppajjanti.

ps1.3:32.20.verse: Imehi chahi ṭhānehi parisuddhaṁ cittaṁ pariyodātaṁ ekattagataṁ hoti.

ps1.3:33.3.verse: Dānavosaggupaṭṭhānekattaṁ cāgādhimuttānaṁ, samathanimittupaṭṭhānekattañca adhicittamanuyuttānaṁ, vayalakkhaṇupaṭṭhānekattañca vipassakānaṁ, nirodhupaṭṭhānekattañca ariyapuggalānaṁ—

ps1.3:33.4.verse: imehi catūhi ṭhānehi ekattagataṁ cittaṁ paṭipadāvisuddhipakkhandañceva hoti, upekkhānubrūhitañca, ñāṇena ca sampahaṁsitaṁ.

ps1.3:34.1.verse: Paṭhamassa jhānassa ko ādi, kiṁ majjhe, kiṁ pariyosānaṁ?

ps1.3:34.2.verse: Paṭhamassa jhānassa paṭipadāvisuddhi ādi, upekkhānubrūhanā majjhe, sampahaṁsanā pariyosānaṁ.

ps1.3:34.6.verse: Yo tassa paripantho tato cittaṁ visujjhati, visuddhattā cittaṁ majjhimaṁ samathanimittaṁ paṭipajjati, paṭipannattā tattha cittaṁ pakkhandati.

ps1.3:34.7.verse: Yañca paripanthato cittaṁ visujjhati, yañca visuddhattā cittaṁ majjhimaṁ samathanimittaṁ paṭipajjati, yañca paṭipannattā tattha cittaṁ pakkhandati.

ps1.3:35.4.verse: Visuddhaṁ cittaṁ ajjhupekkhati, samathapaṭipannaṁ ajjhupekkhati, ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ ajjhupekkhati.

ps1.3:35.5.verse: Yañca visuddhaṁ cittaṁ ajjhupekkhati, yañca samathapaṭipannaṁ ajjhupekkhati, yañca ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ ajjhupekkhati—

ps1.3:36.4.verse: Tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena sampahaṁsanā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena sampahaṁsanā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena sampahaṁsanā, āsevanaṭṭhena sampahaṁsanā.

ps1.3:36.9.verse: Evaṁ tivattagataṁ cittaṁ tividhakalyāṇakaṁ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṁ vitakkasampannañceva hoti vicārasampannañca pītisampannañca sukhasampannañca cittassa adhiṭṭhānasampannañca saddhāsampannañca vīriyasampannañca satisampannañca samādhisampannañca paññāsampannañca.

ps1.3:37.1.verse: Dutiyassa jhānassa ko ādi, kiṁ majjhe, kiṁ pariyosānaṁ?

ps1.3:37.2.verse: Dutiyassa jhānassa paṭipadāvisuddhi ādi, upekkhānubrūhanā majjhe, sampahaṁsanā pariyosānaṁ …pe…

ps1.3:37.3.verse: evaṁ tivattagataṁ cittaṁ tividhakalyāṇakaṁ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṁ pītisampannañceva hoti sukhasampannañca cittassa adhiṭṭhānasampannañca saddhāsampannañca vīriyasampannañca satisampannañca samādhisampannañca paññāsampannañca.

ps1.3:38.1.verse: Tatiyassa jhānassa ko ādi, kiṁ majjhe, kiṁ pariyosānaṁ …pe…

ps1.3:38.2.verse: evaṁ tivattagataṁ cittaṁ tividhakalyāṇakaṁ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṁ sukhasampannañceva hoti cittassa adhiṭṭhānasampannañca saddhāsampannañca vīriyasampannañca satisampannañca samādhisampannañca paññāsampannañca.

ps1.3:39.1.verse: Catutthassa jhānassa ko ādi, kiṁ majjhe, kiṁ pariyosānaṁ …pe…

ps1.3:39.2.verse: evaṁ tivattagataṁ cittaṁ tividhakalyāṇakaṁ dasalakkhaṇasampannañca upekkhāsampannañceva hoti cittassa adhiṭṭhānasampannañca saddhāsampannañca vīriyasampannañca satisampannañca samādhisampannañca paññāsampannañca.

ps1.3:40.1.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceyā …pe…

ps1.3:40.2.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousnessyā …

ps1.3:40.3.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessyā …

ps1.3:40.4.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā ko ādi, kiṁ majjhe, kiṁ pariyosānaṁ …pe…

ps1.3:40.5.verse: evaṁ tivattagataṁ cittaṁ tividhakalyāṇakaṁ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṁ upekkhāsampannañceva hoti cittassa adhiṭṭhānasampannañca …pe…

ps1.3:41.1.verse: Aniccānupassanāya ko ādi, kiṁ majjhe, kiṁ pariyosānaṁ …pe…

ps1.3:41.2.verse: evaṁ tivattagataṁ cittaṁ tividhakalyāṇakaṁ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṁ vitakkasampannañceva hoti vicārasampannañca pītisampannañca sukhasampannañca cittassa adhiṭṭhānasampannañca saddhāsampannañca vīriyasampannañca satisampannañca samādhisampannañca paññāsampannañca.

ps1.3:42.4.verse: arahattamaggassa ko ādi, kiṁ majjhe, kiṁ pariyosānaṁ?

ps1.3:42.5.verse: Arahattamaggassa paṭipadāvisuddhi ādi upekkhānubrūhanā majjhe, sampahaṁsanā pariyosānaṁ.

ps1.3:42.9.verse: Yo tassa paripantho tato cittaṁ visujjhati, visuddhattā cittaṁ majjhimaṁ samathanimittaṁ paṭipajjati, paṭipannattā tattha cittaṁ pakkhandati.

ps1.3:42.10.verse: Yañca paripanthato cittaṁ visujjhati, yañca visuddhattā cittaṁ majjhimaṁ samathanimittaṁ paṭipajjati, yañca paṭipannattā tattha cittaṁ pakkhandati—

ps1.3:43.4.verse: Visuddhaṁ cittaṁ ajjhupekkhati, samathapaṭipannaṁ ajjhupekkhati, ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ ajjhupekkhati.

ps1.3:43.5.verse: Yañca visuddhaṁ cittaṁ ajjhupekkhati, yañca samathapaṭipannaṁ ajjhupekkhati, yañca ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ ajjhupekkhati.

ps1.3:44.4.verse: Tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena sampahaṁsanā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena sampahaṁsanā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena sampahaṁsanā, āsevanaṭṭhena sampahaṁsanā.

ps1.3:44.9.verse: Evaṁ tivattagataṁ cittaṁ tividhakalyāṇakaṁ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṁ vitakkasampannañceva hoti vicārasampannañca pītisampannañca sukhasampannañca cittassa adhiṭṭhānasampannañca saddhāsampannañca vīriyasampannañca satisampannañca samādhisampannañca paññāsampannañca.

ps1.3:47.1.verse: Kathaṁ ime tayo dhammā ekacittassa ārammaṇā na honti, na cime tayo dhammā aviditā honti, na ca cittaṁ vikkhepaṁ gacchati, padhānañca paññāyati, payogañca sādheti, visesamadhigacchati?

ps1.3:47.4.verse: Rukkhe phuṭṭhakakacadantānaṁ vasena purisassa sati upaṭṭhitā hoti;

ps1.3:47.5.verse: na āgate vā gate vā kakacadante manasi karoti.

ps1.3:47.6.verse: Na āgatā vā gatā vā kakacadantā aviditā honti, padhānañca paññāyati, payogañca sādheti.

ps1.3:47.10.verse: Yathā rukkhe phuṭṭhakakacadantānaṁ vasena purisassa sati upaṭṭhitā hoti, na āgate vā gate vā kakacadante manasi karoti, na āgatā vā gatā vā kakacadantā aviditā honti, padhānañca paññāyati, payogañca sādheti.

ps1.3:47.11.verse: Evamevaṁ bhikkhu nāsikagge vā mukhanimitte vā satiṁ upaṭṭhapetvā nisinno hoti, na āgate vā gate vā assāsapassāse manasi karoti, na āgatā vā gatā vā assāsapassāsā aviditā honti, padhānañca paññāyati, payogañca sādheti.

ps1.3:48.10.verse: Evaṁ ime tayo dhammā ekacittassa ārammaṇā na honti, na cime tayo dhammā aviditā honti, na ca cittaṁ vikkhepaṁ gacchati, padhānañca paññāyati, payogañca sādheti, visesamadhigacchati.

ps1.3:50.3.verse: Assāsavasena upaṭṭhānaṁ sati, passāsavasena upaṭṭhānaṁ sati.

ps1.3:51.1.verse: Yo assasati tassupaṭṭhāti, yo passasati tassupaṭṭhāti.

ps1.3:51.2.verse: Paripuṇṇāti pariggahaṭṭhena paripuṇṇā, parivāraṭṭhena paripuṇṇā, paripūraṭṭhena paripuṇṇā.

ps1.3:51.4.verse: tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.

ps1.3:51.5.verse: Tassime cattāro bhāvanaṭṭhā yānīkatā honti vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā.

ps1.3:52.1.verse: Yānīkatāti yattha yattha ākaṅkhati tattha tattha vasippatto hoti balappatto vesārajjappatto.

ps1.3:52.2.verse: Tassa me te dhammā āvajjanapaṭibaddhā honti ākaṅkhapaṭibaddhā manasikārapaṭibaddhā cittuppādapaṭibaddhā.

ps1.3:52.5.verse: Vatthukatāti yasmiṁ yasmiṁ vatthusmiṁ cittaṁ svādhiṭṭhitaṁ hoti, tasmiṁ tasmiṁ vatthusmiṁ sati sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:52.6.verse: Yasmiṁ yasmiṁ vā pana vatthusmiṁ sati sūpaṭṭhitā hoti, tasmiṁ tasmiṁ vatthusmiṁ cittaṁ svādhiṭṭhitaṁ hoti.

ps1.3:52.9.verse: Anuṭṭhitāti vatthusmiṁ yena yena cittaṁ abhinīharati tena tena sati anuparivattati.

ps1.3:52.10.verse: Yena yena vā pana sati anuparivattati tena tena cittaṁ abhinīharati.

ps1.3:52.13.verse: Paricitāti pariggahaṭṭhena paricitā, parivāraṭṭhena paricitā, paripūraṭṭhena paricitā.

ps1.3:52.14.verse: Satiyā pariggaṇhanto jināti pāpake akusale dhamme.

ps1.3:52.18.verse: tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena susamāraddhā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena susamāraddhā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena susamāraddhā, tappaccanīkānaṁ kilesānaṁ susamūhatattā susamāraddhā.

ps1.3:53.3.verse: Ye tattha jātā anavajjā kusalā bodhipakkhiyā—

ps1.3:53.6.verse: Yaṁ tesaṁ tesaṁ dhammānaṁ ārammaṇaṁ nirodho nibbānaṁ—

ps1.3:53.8.verse: Iti idañca samaṁ idañca susamaṁ ñātaṁ hoti diṭṭhaṁ viditaṁ sacchikataṁ phassitaṁ paññāya.

ps1.3:53.9.verse: Āraddhaṁ hoti vīriyaṁ asallīnaṁ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṁ cittaṁ ekaggaṁ.

ps1.3:54.1.verse: Anupubbaṁ paricitāti dīghaṁ assāsavasena purimā purimā paricitā, pacchimā pacchimā anuparicitā.

ps1.3:54.2.verse: Dīghaṁ passāsavasena purimā purimā paricitā, pacchimā pacchimā anuparicitā.

ps1.3:54.3.verse: Rassaṁ assāsavasena purimā purimā paricitā, pacchimā pacchimā anuparicitā.

ps1.3:54.4.verse: Rassaṁ passāsavasena purimā purimā paricitā, pacchimā pacchimā anuparicitā …pe…

ps1.3:54.5.verse: paṭinissaggānupassī assāsavasena purimā purimā paricitā, pacchimā pacchimā anuparicitā.

ps1.3:54.6.verse: Paṭinissaggānupassī passāsavasena purimā purimā paricitā, pacchimā pacchimā anuparicitā.

ps1.3:54.7.verse: Sabbāpi soḷasavatthukā ānāpānassatiyo aññamaññaṁ paricitā ceva honti anuparicitā ca.

ps1.3:55.2.verse: attadamathattho yathattho, attasamathattho yathattho, attaparinibbāpanattho yathattho, abhiññattho yathattho, pariññattho yathattho, pahānattho yathattho, bhāvanattho yathattho, sacchikiriyattho yathattho, saccābhisamayattho yathattho, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpakattho yathattho.

ps1.3:56.1.verse: Buddhoti yo so bhagavā sayambhū anācariyako pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṁ saccāni abhisambujjhi, tattha ca sabbaññutaṁ pāpuṇi, balesu ca vasībhāvaṁ.

ps1.3:57.26.verse: Buddhoti netaṁ nāmaṁ mātarā kataṁ, na pitarā kataṁ, na bhātarā kataṁ, na bhaginiyā kataṁ, na mittāmaccehi kataṁ, na ñātisālohitehi kataṁ, na samaṇabrāhmaṇehi kataṁ, na devatāhi kataṁ.

ps1.3:57.27.verse: Vimokkhantikametaṁ buddhānaṁ bhagavantānaṁ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutaññāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikā paññatti yadidaṁ—

ps1.3:57.29.verse: Desitāti attadamathattho yathattho yathā buddhena desito, attasamathattho yathattho yathā buddhena desito, attaparinibbāpanattho yathattho yathā buddhena desito …pe…

ps1.3:57.30.verse: nirodhe patiṭṭhāpakattho yathattho yathā buddhena desito.

ps1.3:58.1.verse: Soti gahaṭṭho vā hoti pabbajito vā.

ps1.3:58.2.verse: Lokoti khandhaloko dhātuloko āyatanaloko vipattibhavaloko vipattisambhavaloko sampattibhavaloko sampattisambhavaloko.

ps1.3:58.8.verse: So imaṁ lokaṁ obhāseti bhāseti pabhāseti.

ps1.3:58.10.verse: So imaṁ lokaṁ obhāseti bhāseti pabhāseti.

ps1.3:58.12.verse: So imaṁ lokaṁ obhāseti bhāseti pabhāseti …pe…

ps1.3:58.14.verse: So imaṁ lokaṁ obhāseti bhāseti pabhāseti.

ps1.3:59.1.verse: Abbhā muttova candimāti yathā abbhā, evaṁ kilesā.

ps1.3:59.4.verse: Yathā cando abbhā mutto mahikā mutto dhūmarajā mutto rāhugahaṇā vippamutto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate ca, evamevaṁ bhikkhu sabbakilesehi vippamutto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate ca.

ps1.3:60.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṁ ābhujitvā ujuṁ kāyaṁ paṇidhāya parimukhaṁ satiṁ upaṭṭhapetvā.

ps1.3:61.1.verse: Idhāti imissā diṭṭhiyā, imissā khantiyā, imissā ruciyā, imasmiṁ ādāye, imasmiṁ dhamme, imasmiṁ vinaye, imasmiṁ dhammavinaye, imasmiṁ pāvacane, imasmiṁ brahmacariye, imasmiṁ satthusāsane.

ps1.3:61.4.verse: Bhikkhūti puthujjanakalyāṇako vā hoti bhikkhu sekkho vā arahā vā akuppadhammo.

ps1.3:61.5.verse: Araññanti nikkhamitvā bahi indakhīlā sabbametaṁ araññaṁ.

ps1.3:61.6.verse: Rukkhamūlanti yattha bhikkhuno āsanaṁ paññattaṁ hoti mañco vā pīṭhaṁ vā bhisi vā taṭṭikā vā cammakhaṇḍo vā tiṇasantharo vā paṇṇasantharo vā palālasantharo vā, tattha bhikkhu caṅkamati vā tiṭṭhati vā nisīdati vā seyyaṁ vā kappeti.

ps1.3:61.7.verse: Suññanti kenaci anākiṇṇaṁ hoti gahaṭṭhehi vā pabbajitehi vā.

ps1.3:61.8.verse: Agāranti vihāro aḍḍhayogo pāsādo hammiyaṁ guhā.

ps1.3:61.9.verse: Nisīdati pallaṅkaṁ ābhujitvāti nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṁ ābhujitvā.

ps1.3:61.10.verse: Ujuṁ kāyaṁ paṇidhāyāti ujuko hoti kāyo ṭhito supaṇihito.

ps1.3:62.1.verse: Satova assasati, sato passasatīti bāttiṁsāya ākārehi sato kārī hoti.

ps1.3:62.2.verse: Dīghaṁ assāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:62.3.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena sato kārī hoti.

ps1.3:62.4.verse: Dīghaṁ passāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:62.5.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena sato kārī hoti.

ps1.3:62.6.verse: Rassaṁ assāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:62.7.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena sato kārī hoti.

ps1.3:62.8.verse: Rassaṁ passāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:62.9.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena sato kārī hoti …pe…

ps1.3:62.11.verse: paṭinissaggānupassī passāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:62.12.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena sato kārī hoti.

ps1.3:63.1.verse: Kathaṁ dīghaṁ assasanto “dīghaṁ assasāmī”ti pajānāti, dīghaṁ passasanto “dīghaṁ passasāmī”ti pajānāti?

ps1.3:63.2.verse: Dīghaṁ assāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte assasati, dīghaṁ passāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte passasati, dīghaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte assasatipi passasatipi.

ps1.3:63.3.verse: Dīghaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte assasatopi passasatopi chando uppajjati.

ps1.3:63.4.verse: Chandavasena tato sukhumataraṁ dīghaṁ assāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte assasati, chandavasena tato sukhumataraṁ dīghaṁ passāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte passasati, chandavasena tato sukhumataraṁ dīghaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte assasatipi passasatipi.

ps1.3:63.5.verse: Chandavasena tato sukhumataraṁ dīghaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte assasatopi passasatopi pāmojjaṁ uppajjati.

ps1.3:63.6.verse: Pāmojjavasena tato sukhumataraṁ dīghaṁ assāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte assasati, pāmojjavasena tato sukhumataraṁ dīghaṁ passāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte passasati, pāmojjavasena tato sukhumataraṁ dīghaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte assasatipi passasatipi.

ps1.3:63.7.verse: Pāmojjavasena tato sukhumataraṁ dīghaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ addhānasaṅkhāte assasatopi passasatopi dīghaṁ assāsapassāsāpi cittaṁ vivattati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti.

ps1.3:63.13.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena taṁ kāyaṁ anupassati.

ps1.3:65.2.verse: tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.

ps1.3:65.3.verse: Dīghaṁ assāsapassāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato viditā feeling  uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti.

ps1.3:65.4.verse: Viditā saññā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti.

ps1.3:65.5.verse: Viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti.

ps1.3:66.1.verse: Kathaṁ viditā feeling  uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti?

ps1.3:66.7.verse: phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayoti paccayasamudayaṭṭhena vedanāya uppādo vidito hoti.

ps1.3:66.8.verse: Nibbattilakkhaṇaṁ passatopi vedanāya uppādo vidito hoti.

ps1.3:68.6.verse: phassanirodhā vedanānirodhoti paccayanirodhaṭṭhena vedanāya atthaṅgamo vidito hoti.

ps1.3:68.7.verse: Vipariṇāmalakkhaṇaṁ passatopi vedanāya atthaṅgamo vidito hoti.

ps1.3:68.9.verse: Evaṁ viditā feeling  uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti.

ps1.3:69.1.verse: Kathaṁ viditā saññā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti?

ps1.3:69.9.verse: Nibbattilakkhaṇaṁ passatopi saññāya uppādo vidito hoti.

ps1.3:71.8.verse: Vipariṇāmalakkhaṇaṁ passatopi saññāya atthaṅgamo vidito hoti.

ps1.3:71.10.verse: Evaṁ viditā saññā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti.

ps1.3:72.1.verse: Kathaṁ viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti?

ps1.3:72.9.verse: Nibbattilakkhaṇaṁ passatopi vitakkānaṁ uppādo vidito hoti.

ps1.3:74.8.verse: Vipariṇāmalakkhaṇaṁ passatopi vitakkānaṁ atthaṅgamo vidito hoti.

ps1.3:74.10.verse: Evaṁ viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti.

ps1.3:75.1.verse: Dīghaṁ assāsapassāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānanto indriyāni samodhāneti, gocarañca pajānāti, samatthañca paṭivijjhati …pe…

ps1.3:75.2.verse: maggaṁ samodhāneti, dhamme samodhāneti, gocarañca pajānāti, samatthañca paṭivijjhati.

ps1.3:76.2.verse: Adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ samodhāneti, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ samodhāneti, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ samodhāneti, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ samodhāneti, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ samodhāneti.

ps1.3:76.3.verse: Ayaṁ puggalo imāni indriyāni imasmiṁ ārammaṇe samodhāneti.

ps1.3:77.1.verse: Gocarañca pajānātīti yaṁ tassa ārammaṇaṁ, taṁ tassa gocaraṁ.

ps1.3:77.2.verse: Yaṁ tassa gocaraṁ, taṁ tassa ārammaṇaṁ.

ps1.3:78.1.verse: Samanti ārammaṇassa upaṭṭhānaṁ samaṁ, cittassa avikkhepo samaṁ, cittassa adhiṭṭhānaṁ samaṁ, cittassa vodānaṁ samaṁ.

ps1.3:78.3.verse: Paṭivijjhatīti ārammaṇassa upaṭṭhānaṭṭhaṁ paṭivijjhati, cittassa avikkhepaṭṭhaṁ paṭivijjhati, cittassa adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhaṁ paṭivijjhati, cittassa vodānaṭṭhaṁ paṭivijjhati.

ps1.3:79.2.verse: Assaddhiye akampiyaṭṭhena saddhābalaṁ samodhāneti, kosajje akampiyaṭṭhena vīriyabalaṁ samodhāneti, pamāde akampiyaṭṭhena satibalaṁ samodhāneti, uddhacce akampiyaṭṭhena samādhibalaṁ samodhāneti, avijjāya akampiyaṭṭhena paññābalaṁ samodhāneti.

ps1.3:79.3.verse: Ayaṁ puggalo imāni balāni imasmiṁ ārammaṇe samodhāneti.

ps1.3:80.2.verse: Upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satisambojjhaṅgaṁ samodhāneti, pavicayaṭṭhena dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṁ samodhāneti, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyasambojjhaṅgaṁ samodhāneti, pharaṇaṭṭhena pītisambojjhaṅgaṁ samodhāneti, upasamaṭṭhena passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṁ samodhāneti, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhisambojjhaṅgaṁ samodhāneti, paṭisaṅkhānaṭṭhena upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṁ samodhāneti.

ps1.3:80.3.verse: Ayaṁ puggalo ime bojjhaṅge imasmiṁ ārammaṇe samodhāneti.

ps1.3:81.2.verse: Dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhiṁ samodhāneti, abhiniropanaṭṭhena sammāsaṅkappaṁ samodhāneti, pariggahaṭṭhena sammāvācaṁ samodhāneti, samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena sammākammantaṁ samodhāneti, vodānaṭṭhena sammāājīvaṁ samodhāneti, paggahaṭṭhena sammāvāyāmaṁ samodhāneti, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena sammāsatiṁ samodhāneti, avikkhepaṭṭhena sammāsamādhiṁ samodhāneti.

ps1.3:81.3.verse: Ayaṁ puggalo imaṁ maggaṁ imasmiṁ ārammaṇe samodhāneti.

ps1.3:82.2.verse: Ādhipateyyaṭṭhena indriyāni samodhāneti, akampiyaṭṭhena balāni samodhāneti, niyyānaṭṭhena bojjhaṅge samodhāneti, hetuṭṭhena maggaṁ samodhāneti, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satipaṭṭhānaṁ samodhāneti, padahanaṭṭhena sammappadhānaṁ samodhāneti, ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhipādaṁ samodhāneti tathaṭṭhena saccaṁ samodhāneti, avikkhepaṭṭhena samathaṁ samodhāneti, anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanaṁ samodhāneti, ekarasaṭṭhena samathavipassanaṁ samodhāneti, anativattanaṭṭhena yuganaddhaṁ samodhāneti, saṁvaraṭṭhena sīlavisuddhiṁ samodhāneti, avikkhepaṭṭhena cittavisuddhiṁ samodhāneti, dassanaṭṭhena diṭṭhivisuddhiṁ samodhāneti, vimuttaṭṭhena vimokkhaṁ samodhāneti, paṭivedhaṭṭhena vijjaṁ samodhāneti, pariccāgaṭṭhena vimuttiṁ samodhāneti, samucchedaṭṭhena khaye ñāṇaṁ samodhāneti, paṭippassaddhaṭṭhena anuppāde ñāṇaṁ samodhāneti, chandaṁ mūlaṭṭhena samodhāneti, manasikāraṁ samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena samodhāneti, phassaṁ samodhānaṭṭhena samodhāneti, vedanaṁ samosaraṇaṭṭhena samodhāneti, samādhiṁ pamukhaṭṭhena samodhāneti, satiṁ ādhipateyyaṭṭhena samodhāneti, paññaṁ taduttaraṭṭhena samodhāneti, vimuttiṁ sāraṭṭhena samodhāneti, amatogadhaṁ nibbānaṁ pariyosānaṭṭhena samodhāneti.

ps1.3:82.3.verse: Ayaṁ puggalo ime dhamme imasmiṁ ārammaṇe samodhāneti.

ps1.3:83.1.verse: Gocarañca pajānātīti yaṁ tassa ārammaṇaṁ, taṁ tassa gocaraṁ.

ps1.3:83.2.verse: Yaṁ tassa gocaraṁ, taṁ tassa ārammaṇaṁ pajānātīti puggalo.

ps1.3:83.4.verse: Samanti ārammaṇassa upaṭṭhānaṁ samaṁ, cittassa avikkhepo samaṁ, cittassa adhiṭṭhānaṁ samaṁ, cittassa vodānaṁ samaṁ.

ps1.3:83.6.verse: Paṭivijjhatīti ārammaṇassa upaṭṭhānaṭṭhaṁ paṭivijjhati, cittassa avikkhepaṭṭhaṁ paṭivijjhati, cittassa adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhaṁ paṭivijjhati, cittassa vodānaṭṭhaṁ paṭivijjhati.

ps1.3:84.1.verse: Kathaṁ rassaṁ assasanto “rassaṁ assasāmī”ti pajānāti, rassaṁ passasanto “rassaṁ passasāmī”ti pajānāti?

ps1.3:84.2.verse: Rassaṁ assāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte assasati, rassaṁ passāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte passasati, rassaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte assasatipi passasatipi.

ps1.3:84.3.verse: Rassaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte assasatopi passasatopi chando uppajjati.

ps1.3:84.4.verse: Chandavasena tato sukhumataraṁ rassaṁ assāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte assasati.

ps1.3:84.5.verse: Chandavasena tato sukhumataraṁ rassaṁ passāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte passasati.

ps1.3:84.6.verse: Chandavasena tato sukhumataraṁ rassaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte assasatipi passasatipi.

ps1.3:84.7.verse: Chandavasena tato sukhumataraṁ rassaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte assasatopi passasatopi pāmojjaṁ uppajjati.

ps1.3:84.8.verse: Pāmojjavasena tato sukhumataraṁ rassaṁ assāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte assasati, pāmojjavasena tato sukhumataraṁ rassaṁ passāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte passasati, pāmojjavasena tato sukhumataraṁ rassaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte assasatipi passasatipi.

ps1.3:84.9.verse: Pāmojjavasena tato sukhumataraṁ rassaṁ assāsapassāsaṁ ittarasaṅkhāte assasatopi passasatopi rassā assāsapassāsā cittaṁ vivattati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti.

ps1.3:84.10.verse: Imehi navahākārehi rassā assāsapassāsā kāyo upaṭṭhānaṁ sati anupassanā ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.3:84.13.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena taṁ kāyaṁ anupassati.

ps1.3:85.5.verse: Rassaṁ assāsapassāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato viditā feeling  uppajjanti …pe…

ps1.3:85.6.verse: rassaṁ assāsapassāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānanto indriyāni samodhāneti …pe…

ps1.3:86.5.verse: Vedanā, saññā, cetanā, phasso, manasikāro, nāmañca nāmakāyo ca, ye ca vuccanti cittasaṅkhārā—

ps1.3:86.8.verse: Cattāro ca mahābhūtā, catunnañca mahābhūtānaṁ upādāyarūpaṁ, assāso ca passāso ca, nimittañca upanibandhanā, ye ca vuccanti kāyasaṅkhārā—

ps1.3:87.2.verse: Dīghaṁ assāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:87.3.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena te kāyā paṭividitā honti.

ps1.3:87.4.verse: Dīghaṁ passāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:87.5.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena te kāyā paṭividitā honti.

ps1.3:87.6.verse: Rassaṁ assāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:87.7.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena te kāyā paṭividitā honti.

ps1.3:87.8.verse: Rassaṁ passāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti.

ps1.3:87.9.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena te kāyā paṭividitā honti.

ps1.3:88.1.verse: Āvajjato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, pajānato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, passato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, paccavekkhato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, cittaṁ adhiṭṭhahato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, saddhāya adhimuccato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, vīriyaṁ paggaṇhato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, satiṁ upaṭṭhāpayato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, cittaṁ samādahato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, paññāya pajānato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, abhiññeyyaṁ abhijānato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, pariññeyyaṁ parijānato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, pahātabbaṁ pajahato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, bhāvetabbaṁ bhāvayato te kāyā paṭividitā honti, sacchikātabbaṁ sacchikaroto te kāyā paṭividitā honti.

ps1.3:88.3.verse: Sabbakāyapaṭisaṁvedī assāsapassāsā kāyo upaṭṭhānaṁ sati anupassanā ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.3:88.6.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena taṁ kāyaṁ anupassati.

ps1.3:90.1.verse: Sabbakāyapaṭisaṁvedī assāsapassāsānaṁ saṁvaraṭṭhena sīlavisuddhi, avikkhepaṭṭhena cittavisuddhi, dassanaṭṭhena diṭṭhivisuddhi.

ps1.3:90.5.verse: Imā tisso sikkhāyo āvajjanto sikkhati, jānanto sikkhati, passanto sikkhati, paccavekkhanto sikkhati, cittaṁ adhiṭṭhahanto sikkhati, saddhāya adhimuccanto sikkhati, vīriyaṁ paggaṇhanto sikkhati, satiṁ upaṭṭhapento sikkhati, cittaṁ samādahanto sikkhati, paññāya pajānanto sikkhati, abhiññeyyaṁ abhijānanto sikkhati, pariññeyyaṁ parijānanto sikkhati, pahātabbaṁ pajahanto sikkhati, bhāvetabbaṁ bhāvento sikkhati, sacchikātabbaṁ sacchikaronto sikkhati.

ps1.3:91.1.verse: Sabbakāyapaṭisaṁvedī assāsapassāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato viditā feeling  uppajjanti …pe…

ps1.3:91.2.verse: sabbakāyapaṭisaṁvedī assāsapassāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānanto indriyāni samodhāneti …pe…

ps1.3:92.1.verse: Kathaṁ “passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ assasissāmī”ti sikkhati, “passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ passasissāmī”ti sikkhati?

ps1.3:92.5.verse: Te kāyasaṅkhāre passambhento nirodhento vūpasamento sikkhati.

ps1.3:92.8.verse: Te kāyasaṅkhāre passambhento nirodhento vūpasamento sikkhati.

ps1.3:92.12.verse: Te kāyasaṅkhāre passambhento nirodhento vūpasamento sikkhati.

ps1.3:93.1.verse: Yathārūpehi kāyasaṅkhārehi yā kāyassa ānamanā vinamanā sannamanā paṇamanā iñjanā phandanā calanā pakampanā—

ps1.3:93.2.verse: passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ assasissāmīti sikkhati, passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ passasissāmīti sikkhati.

ps1.3:93.3.verse: Yathārūpehi kāyasaṅkhārehi yā kāyassa na ānamanā na vinamanā na sannamanā na paṇamanā aniñjanā aphandanā acalanā akampanā santaṁ sukhumaṁ passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ assasissāmīti sikkhati, passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ passasissāmīti sikkhati.

ps1.3:94.1.verse: Iti kira “passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ assasissāmī”ti sikkhati, “passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ passasissāmī”ti sikkhati.

ps1.3:94.2.verse: Evaṁ sante vātūpaladdhiyā ca pabhāvanā na hoti, assāsapassāsānañca pabhāvanā na hoti, ānāpānassatiyā ca pabhāvanā na hoti, ānāpānassatisamādhissa ca pabhāvanā na hoti;

ps1.3:94.3.verse: na ca naṁ taṁ samāpattiṁ paṇḍitā samāpajjantipi vuṭṭhahantipi.

ps1.3:95.1.verse: Iti kira “passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ assasissāmī”ti sikkhati, “passambhayaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ passasissāmī”ti sikkhati.

ps1.3:95.4.verse: tañca naṁ samāpattiṁ paṇḍitā samāpajjantipi vuṭṭhahantipi.

ps1.3:95.6.verse: Seyyathāpi kaṁse ākoṭite paṭhamaṁ oḷārikā saddā pavattanti.

ps1.3:95.7.verse: Oḷārikānaṁ saddānaṁ nimittaṁ suggahitattā sumanasikatattā sūpadhāritattā niruddhepi oḷārike sadde, atha pacchā sukhumakā saddā pavattanti.

ps1.3:95.8.verse: Sukhumakānaṁ saddānaṁ nimittaṁ suggahitattā sumanasikatattā sūpadhāritattā niruddhepi sukhumake sadde, atha pacchā sukhumasaddanimittārammaṇatāpi cittaṁ pavattati.

ps1.3:95.10.verse: oḷārikānaṁ assāsapassāsānaṁ nimittaṁ suggahitattā sumanasikatattā sūpadhāritattā niruddhepi oḷārike assāsapassāse, atha pacchā sukhumakā assāsapassāsā pavattanti.

ps1.3:95.11.verse: Sukhumakānaṁ assāsapassāsānaṁ nimittaṁ suggahitattā sumanasikatattā sūpadhāritattā niruddhepi sukhumake assāsapassāse, atha pacchā sukhumakaassāsapassāsānaṁ nimittārammaṇatāpi cittaṁ na vikkhepaṁ gacchati.
