ps1.3:131.5.verse: katihākārehi phasse ādīnavo hoti, katihākārehi contact nirujjhati …

ps1.3:131.6.verse: katihākārehi vedanāya ādīnavo hoti, katihākārehi feeling  nirujjhati …

ps1.3:131.7.verse: katihākārehi taṇhāya ādīnavo hoti, katihākārehi craving nirujjhati …

ps1.3:131.8.verse: katihākārehi upādāne ādīnavo hoti, katihākārehi clinging nirujjhati …

ps1.3:131.9.verse: katihākārehi bhave ādīnavo hoti, katihākārehi being  nirujjhati …

ps1.3:131.10.verse: katihākārehi jātiyā ādīnavo hoti, katihākārehi birth nirujjhati …

ps1.3:131.11.verse: katihākārehi jarāmaraṇe ādīnavo hoti, katihākārehi aging and death nirujjhati?

ps1.3:131.12.verse: Pañcahākārehi jarāmaraṇe ādīnavo hoti, aṭṭhahākārehi aging and death nirujjhati.

ps1.3:133.1.verse: Katamehi aṭṭhahākārehi aging and death nirujjhati?

ps1.3:133.2.verse: Nidānanirodhena aging and death nirujjhati, samudayanirodhena …pe…

ps1.3:133.9.verse: imehi aṭṭhahākārehi aging and death nirujjhati.

ps1.3:133.10.verse: Imehi pañcahākārehi jarāmaraṇe ādīnavaṁ disvā imehi aṭṭhahākārehi jarāmaraṇanirodhe chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ.

ps1.3:133.11.verse: “Jarāmaraṇe nirodhānupassī assasissāmī”ti sikkhati, “jarāmaraṇe nirodhānupassī passasissāmī”ti sikkhati.

ps1.3:133.12.verse: Nirodhānupassī assāsapassāsavasena dhammā upaṭṭhānaṁ sati anupassanā ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.3:133.15.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena te dhamme anupassati.

ps1.3:134.6.verse: nirodhānupassī assāsapassāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato …pe…

ps1.3:135.8.verse: “Rūpe paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmī”ti sikkhati, “rūpe paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmī”ti sikkhati.

ps1.3:135.18.verse: “Jarāmaraṇe paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmī”ti sikkhati, “jarāmaraṇe paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmī”ti sikkhati.

ps1.3:135.19.verse: Paṭinissaggānupassī assāsapassāsavasena dhammā upaṭṭhānaṁ sati anupassanā ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.3:135.22.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena te dhamme anupassati.

ps1.3:136.10.verse: Paṭinissaggānupassī assāsapassāsānaṁ saṁvaraṭṭhena sīlavisuddhi, avikkhepaṭṭhena cittavisuddhi, dassanaṭṭhena diṭṭhivisuddhi.

ps1.3:136.14.verse: imā tisso sikkhāyo āvajjanto sikkhati jānanto sikkhati …pe…

ps1.3:137.1.verse: Paṭinissaggānupassī assāsapassāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānato viditā feeling  uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṁ gacchanti …pe…

ps1.3:137.2.verse: paṭinissaggānupassī assāsapassāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṁ avikkhepaṁ pajānanto indriyāni samodhāneti gocarañca pajānāti samatthañca paṭivijjhati;

ps1.3:137.6.verse: dhamme samodhāneti gocarañca pajānāti samatthañca paṭivijjhati.

ps1.3:139.1.verse: Aṭṭha anupassane ñāṇāni aṭṭha ca upaṭṭhānānussatiyo cattāri suttantikavatthūni dhammesu dhammānupassanāya.

ps1.3:140.2.verse: Dīghaṁ assāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi, dīghaṁ passāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi …pe…

ps1.3:140.3.verse: vimocayaṁ cittaṁ assāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi, vimocayaṁ cittaṁ passāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi.

ps1.3:141.2.verse: Dīghaṁ assāsaṁ aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dīghaṁ passāsaṁ aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā …pe…

ps1.3:141.3.verse: vimocayaṁ cittaṁ assāsaṁ, vimocayaṁ cittaṁ passāsaṁ aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā.

ps1.3:142.3.verse: nibbidāñāṇaṁ, aniccānupassī passasaṁ yathābhūtaṁ jānāti passatīti—

ps1.3:142.6.verse: nibbidāñāṇaṁ, paṭinissaggānupassī passasaṁ yathābhūtaṁ jānāti passatīti—

ps1.3:143.2.verse: Aniccānupassī assasaṁ bhayatupaṭṭhāne paññā nibbidānulome ñāṇaṁ, aniccānupassī passasaṁ bhayatupaṭṭhāne paññā nibbidānulome ñāṇaṁ …pe…

ps1.3:143.3.verse: paṭinissaggānupassī assasaṁ bhayatupaṭṭhāne paññā nibbidānulome ñāṇaṁ, paṭinissaggānupassī passasaṁ bhayatupaṭṭhāne paññā nibbidānulome ñāṇaṁ—

ps1.3:144.2.verse: Aniccānupassī assasaṁ paṭisaṅkhā santiṭṭhanā paññā nibbidāpaṭippassaddhiñāṇaṁ, aniccānupassī passasaṁ paṭisaṅkhā santiṭṭhanā paññā nibbidāpaṭippassaddhiñāṇaṁ …pe…

ps1.3:144.3.verse: paṭinissaggānupassī assasaṁ paṭisaṅkhā santiṭṭhanā paññā nibbidāpaṭippassaddhiñāṇaṁ, paṭinissaggānupassī passasaṁ paṭisaṅkhā santiṭṭhanā paññā nibbidāpaṭippassaddhiñāṇaṁ—

ps1.3:145.2.verse: Sotāpattimaggena sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā pahīnattā samucchinnattā uppajjati vimuttisukhe ñāṇaṁ, vicikicchāya pahīnattā samucchinnattā uppajjati vimuttisukhe ñāṇaṁ, sīlabbataparāmāsassa …pe…

ps1.3:145.3.verse: diṭṭhānusayassa, vicikicchānusayassa pahīnattā samucchinnattā uppajjati vimuttisukhe ñāṇaṁ, sakadāgāmimaggena oḷārikassa, kāmarāgasaññojanassa …pe…

ps1.3:145.4.verse: paṭighasaññojanassa, oḷārikassa kāmarāgānusayassa, paṭighānusayassa pahīnattā samucchinnattā uppajjati vimuttisukhe ñāṇaṁ, anāgāmimaggena anusahagatassa kāmarāgasaññojanassa …pe…

ps1.3:145.5.verse: paṭighasaññojanassa, anusahagatassa kāmarāgānusayassa, paṭighānusayassa pahīnattā samucchinnattā uppajjati vimuttisukhe ñāṇaṁ, arahattamaggena, rūparāgassa …pe…

ps1.3:145.6.verse: arūparāgassa, mānassa, uddhaccassa, avijjāya, mānānusayassa, bhavarāgānusayassa, avijjānusayassa pahīnattā samucchinnattā uppajjati vimuttisukhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.3:145.8.verse: Soḷasavatthukaṁ ānāpānassatisamādhiṁ bhāvayato samadhikāni imāni dve ñāṇasatāni uppajjanti.

ps1.4:1.2.verse: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.

ps1.4:3.3.verse: Assaddhe puggale parivajjayato, saddhe puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato, pasādanīye suttante paccavekkhato—

ps1.4:3.5.verse: Kusīte puggale parivajjayato, āraddhavīriye puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato, sammappadhāne paccavekkhato—

ps1.4:3.7.verse: Muṭṭhassatī puggale parivajjayato, upaṭṭhitassatī puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato, satipaṭṭhāne paccavekkhato—

ps1.4:3.9.verse: Asamāhite puggale parivajjayato, samāhite puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato, jhānavimokkhe paccavekkhato—

ps1.4:3.11.verse: Duppaññe puggale parivajjayato, paññavante puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato, gambhīrañāṇacariyaṁ paccavekkhato—

ps1.4:3.13.verse: Iti ime pañca puggale parivajjayato, pañca puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato, pañca suttantakkhandhe paccavekkhato—

ps1.4:3.14.verse: imehi pannarasahi ākārehi imāni pañcindriyāni visujjhanti.

ps1.4:4.1.verse: Katihākārehi pañcindriyāni bhāviyanti, katihākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvanā hoti?

ps1.4:4.2.verse: Dasahākārehi pañcindriyāni bhāviyanti, dasahākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvanā hoti.

ps1.4:4.3.verse: Assaddhiyaṁ pajahanto saddhindriyaṁ bhāveti, saddhindriyaṁ bhāvento assaddhiyaṁ pajahati;

ps1.4:4.4.verse: kosajjaṁ pajahanto vīriyindriyaṁ bhāveti, vīriyindriyaṁ bhāvento kosajjaṁ pajahati;

ps1.4:4.5.verse: pamādaṁ pajahanto satindriyaṁ bhāveti, satindriyaṁ bhāvento pamādaṁ pajahati;

ps1.4:4.6.verse: uddhaccaṁ pajahanto samādhindriyaṁ bhāveti, samādhindriyaṁ bhāvento uddhaccaṁ pajahati;

ps1.4:4.7.verse: avijjaṁ pajahanto paññindriyaṁ bhāveti, paññindriyaṁ bhāvento avijjaṁ pajahati.

ps1.4:4.8.verse: Imehi dasahākārehi pañcindriyāni bhāviyanti, imehi dasahākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvanā hoti.

ps1.4:5.3.verse: Assaddhiyassa pahīnattā suppahīnattā saddhindriyaṁ bhāvitaṁ hoti subhāvitaṁ;

ps1.4:5.4.verse: saddhindriyassa bhāvitattā subhāvitattā assaddhiyaṁ pahīnaṁ hoti suppahīnaṁ.

ps1.4:5.5.verse: Kosajjassa pahīnattā suppahīnattā vīriyindriyaṁ bhāvitaṁ hoti subhāvitaṁ;

ps1.4:5.6.verse: vīriyindriyassa bhāvitattā subhāvitattā kosajjaṁ pahīnaṁ hoti suppahīnaṁ.

ps1.4:5.7.verse: Pamādassa pahīnattā suppahīnattā satindriyaṁ bhāvitaṁ hoti subhāvitaṁ;

ps1.4:5.8.verse: satindriyassa bhāvitattā subhāvitattā pamādo pahīno hoti suppahīno.

ps1.4:5.9.verse: Uddhaccassa pahīnattā suppahīnattā samādhindriyaṁ bhāvitaṁ hoti subhāvitaṁ;

ps1.4:5.10.verse: samādhindriyassa bhāvitattā subhāvitattā uddhaccaṁ pahīnaṁ hoti suppahīnaṁ.

ps1.4:5.11.verse: Avijjāya pahīnattā paññindriyaṁ bhāvitaṁ hoti subhāvitaṁ;

ps1.4:5.12.verse: paññindriyassa bhāvitattā subhāvitattā Ignorance pahīnā hoti suppahīnā.

ps1.4:5.13.verse: Imehi dasahākārehi pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.

ps1.4:6.1.verse: Katihākārehi pañcindriyāni bhāviyanti, katihākārehi pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni ceva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭippassaddhāni ca suppaṭippassaddhāni ca?

ps1.4:6.2.verse: Catūhākārehi pañcindriyāni bhāviyanti catūhākārehi pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni ceva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭippassaddhāni ca suppaṭippassaddhāni ca.

ps1.4:6.4.verse: sotāpattiphalakkhaṇe pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni ceva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭippassaddhāni ca suppaṭippassaddhāni ca.

ps1.4:6.6.verse: sakadāgāmiphalakkhaṇe pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni ceva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭippassaddhāni ca suppaṭippassaddhāni ca.

ps1.4:6.8.verse: anāgāmiphalakkhaṇe pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni ceva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭippassaddhāni ca suppaṭippassaddhāni ca.

ps1.4:6.10.verse: arahattaphalakkhaṇe pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni ceva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭippassaddhāni ca suppaṭippassaddhāni ca.

ps1.4:6.11.verse: Iti catasso maggavisuddhiyo, catasso phalavisuddhiyo, catasso samucchedavisuddhiyo, catasso paṭippassaddhivisuddhiyo.

ps1.4:6.13.verse: imehi catūhākārehi pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni ceva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭippassaddhāni ca suppaṭippassaddhāni ca.

ps1.4:7.9.verse: Savanena buddho tathāgatassa sāvako khīṇāsavo bhāvitindriyo, sayaṁ bhūtaṭṭhena paccekasambuddho bhāvitindriyo, appameyyaṭṭhena tathāgato arahaṁ sammāsambuddho bhāvitindriyo—

ps1.4:9.1.verse: Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā, brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā;

ps1.4:9.2.verse: na ca panete āyasmantā sāmaññatthaṁ vā brahmaññatthaṁ vā diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.

ps1.4:10.1.verse: Ye ca kho keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānanti, te kho me, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā, brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā;

ps1.4:10.2.verse: te ca panāyasmantā sāmaññatthañca brahmaññatthañca diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī”ti.

ps1.4:11.5.verse: Katihākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ assādo hoti, katihākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ assādaṁ pajānāti?

ps1.4:12.1.verse: Cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayo hoti;

ps1.4:12.2.verse: cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:12.3.verse: Cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ atthaṅgamo hoti;

ps1.4:12.4.verse: cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ atthaṅgamaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:12.5.verse: Pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ assādo hoti;

ps1.4:12.6.verse: pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ assādaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:12.7.verse: Pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ ādīnavo hoti;

ps1.4:12.8.verse: pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ ādīnavaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:12.9.verse: Asītisataṁ ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ nissaraṇaṁ hoti;

ps1.4:12.10.verse: asītisataṁ ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ nissaraṇaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:13.1.verse: Katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayo hoti;

ps1.4:13.2.verse: katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayaṁ pajānāti?

ps1.4:13.3.verse: Adhimokkhatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, adhimokkhavasena chandassa samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, adhimokkhavasena manasikārassa samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, saddhindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti;

ps1.4:13.4.verse: paggahatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo vīriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahavasena chandassa samudayo vīriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahavasena manasikārassa samudayo vīriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, vīriyindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ vīriyindriyassa samudayo hoti;

ps1.4:13.5.verse: upaṭṭhānatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena chandassa samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena manasikārassa samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, satindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ satindriyassa samudayo hoti;

ps1.4:13.6.verse: avikkhepatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepavasena chandassa samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepavasena manasikārassa samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, samādhindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti;

ps1.4:13.7.verse: dassanatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanavasena chandassa samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanavasena manasikārassa samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti, paññindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.

ps1.4:13.8.verse: Adhimokkhatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo vīriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.

ps1.4:13.9.verse: Adhimokkhavasena chandassa samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahavasena chandassa samudayo vīriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena chandassa samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepavasena chandassa samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanavasena chandassa samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.

ps1.4:13.10.verse: Adhimokkhavasena manasikārassa samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahavasena manasikārassa samudayo vīriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena manasikārassa samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepavasena manasikārassa samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanavasena manasikārassa samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.

ps1.4:13.11.verse: Saddhindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti vīriyindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ vīriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, satindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ satindriyassa samudayo hoti, samādhindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, paññindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṁ paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.

ps1.4:14.1.verse: Imehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayo hoti, imehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:15.1.verse: Katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ atthaṅgamo hoti;

ps1.4:15.2.verse: katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ atthaṅgamaṁ pajānāti?

ps1.4:15.3.verse: Adhimokkhatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo saddhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, adhimokkhavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo saddhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, adhimokkhavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo saddhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, saddhindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ saddhindriyassa vasena atthaṅgamo hoti;

ps1.4:15.4.verse: paggahatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo vīriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, paggahavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo vīriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, paggahavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo vīriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, vīriyindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ vīriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti;

ps1.4:15.5.verse: upaṭṭhānatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, satindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti;

ps1.4:15.6.verse: avikkhepatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, avikkhepavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, avikkhepavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, samādhindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti;

ps1.4:15.7.verse: dassanatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, dassanavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, dassanavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, paññindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti.

ps1.4:16.1.verse: Adhimokkhatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo saddhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, paggahatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo vīriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, upaṭṭhānatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, avikkhepatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, dassanatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti.

ps1.4:16.2.verse: Adhimokkhavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo saddhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, paggahavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo vīriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, avikkhepavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, dassanavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti.

ps1.4:16.3.verse: Adhimokkhavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo saddhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, paggahavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo vīriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, avikkhepavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, dassanavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti.

ps1.4:16.4.verse: Saddhindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ saddhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, vīriyindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ vīriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, satindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, samādhindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, paññindriyassa vasena ekattaanupaṭṭhānaṁ paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti.

ps1.4:17.1.verse: Imehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ atthaṅgamo hoti;

ps1.4:17.2.verse: imehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ atthaṅgamaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:18.1.verse: Katamehi pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ assādo hoti;

ps1.4:18.2.verse: katamehi pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ assādaṁ pajānāti?

ps1.4:18.3.verse: Assaddhiyassa anupaṭṭhānaṁ saddhindriyassa assādo hoti, assaddhiyapariḷāhassa anupaṭṭhānaṁ saddhindriyassa assādo hoti, adhimokkhacariyāya vesārajjaṁ saddhindriyassa assādo hoti, santo ca vihārādhigamo saddhindriyassa assādo hoti, yaṁ saddhindriyaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ ayaṁ saddhindriyassa assādo.

ps1.4:19.1.verse: Kosajjassa anupaṭṭhānaṁ vīriyindriyassa assādo hoti, kosajjapariḷāhassa anupaṭṭhānaṁ vīriyindriyassa assādo hoti, paggahacariyāya vesārajjaṁ vīriyindriyassa assādo hoti, santo ca vihārādhigamo vīriyindriyassa assādo hoti, yaṁ vīriyindriyaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ ayaṁ vīriyindriyassa assādo.

ps1.4:20.1.verse: Pamādassa anupaṭṭhānaṁ satindriyassa assādo hoti, pamādapariḷāhassa anupaṭṭhānaṁ satindriyassa assādo hoti, upaṭṭhānacariyāya vesārajjaṁ satindriyassa assādo hoti, santo ca vihārādhigamo satindriyassa assādo hoti, yaṁ satindriyaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ ayaṁ satindriyassa assādo.

ps1.4:21.1.verse: Uddhaccassa anupaṭṭhānaṁ samādhindriyassa assādo hoti, uddhaccapariḷāhassa anupaṭṭhānaṁ samādhindriyassa assādo hoti, avikkhepacariyāya vesārajjaṁ samādhindriyassa assādo hoti, santo ca vihārādhigamo samādhindriyassa assādo hoti, yaṁ samādhindriyaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ ayaṁ samādhindriyassa assādo.

ps1.4:22.1.verse: Avijjāya anupaṭṭhānaṁ paññindriyassa assādo hoti, avijjāpariḷāhassa anupaṭṭhānaṁ paññindriyassa assādo hoti, dassanacariyāya vesārajjaṁ paññindriyassa assādo hoti, santo ca vihārādhigamo paññindriyassa assādo hoti, yaṁ paññindriyaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ ayaṁ paññindriyassa assādo.

ps1.4:23.1.verse: Imehi pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ assādo hoti;

ps1.4:23.2.verse: imehi pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ assādaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:24.1.verse: Katamehi pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ ādīnavo hoti;

ps1.4:24.2.verse: katamehi pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ ādīnavaṁ pajānāti?

ps1.4:24.3.verse: Assaddhiyassa upaṭṭhānaṁ saddhindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, assaddhiyapariḷāhassa upaṭṭhānaṁ saddhindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, aniccaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, dukkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, anattaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa ādīnavo hoti.

ps1.4:25.1.verse: Kosajjassa upaṭṭhānaṁ vīriyindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, kosajjapariḷāhassa upaṭṭhānaṁ vīriyindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, aniccaṭṭhena vīriyindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, dukkhaṭṭhena …pe…

ps1.4:26.1.verse: Pamādassa upaṭṭhānaṁ satindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, pamādapariḷāhassa upaṭṭhānaṁ satindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, aniccaṭṭhena satindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, dukkhaṭṭhena …pe…

ps1.4:27.1.verse: Uddhaccassa upaṭṭhānaṁ samādhindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, uddhaccapariḷāhassa upaṭṭhānaṁ samādhindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, aniccaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, dukkhaṭṭhena …pe…

ps1.4:28.1.verse: Avijjāya upaṭṭhānaṁ paññindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, avijjāpariḷāhassa upaṭṭhānaṁ paññindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, aniccaṭṭhena paññindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, dukkhaṭṭhena paññindriyassa ādīnavo hoti, anattaṭṭhena paññindriyassa ādīnavo hoti.

ps1.4:29.1.verse: Imehi pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ ādīnavo hoti;

ps1.4:29.2.verse: imehi pañcavīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ ādīnavaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:30.1.verse: Katamehi asītisataṁ ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ nissaraṇaṁ hoti;

ps1.4:30.2.verse: katamehi asītisataṁ ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ nissaraṇaṁ pajānāti?

ps1.4:31.1.verse: Adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ assaddhiyā nissaṭaṁ hoti, assaddhiyapariḷāhā nissaṭaṁ hoti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca nissaṭaṁ hoti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi nissaṭaṁ hoti, tato paṇītatarasaddhindriyassa paṭilābhā purimatarasaddhindriyā nissaṭaṁ hoti.

ps1.4:32.1.verse: Paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ kosajjā nissaṭaṁ hoti, kosajjapariḷāhā nissaṭaṁ hoti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca nissaṭaṁ hoti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi nissaṭaṁ hoti, tato paṇītataravīriyindriyassa paṭilābhā purimataravīriyindriyā nissaṭaṁ hoti.

ps1.4:33.1.verse: Upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ pamādā nissaṭaṁ hoti, pamādapariḷāhā nissaṭaṁ hoti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca nissaṭaṁ hoti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi nissaṭaṁ hoti, tato paṇītatarasatindriyassa paṭilābhā purimatarasatindriyā nissaṭaṁ hoti.

ps1.4:34.1.verse: Avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ uddhaccā nissaṭaṁ hoti, uddhaccapariḷāhā nissaṭaṁ hoti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca nissaṭaṁ hoti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi nissaṭaṁ hoti, tato paṇītatarasamādhindriyassa paṭilābhā purimatarasamādhindriyā nissaṭaṁ hoti.

ps1.4:35.1.verse: Dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ avijjāya nissaṭaṁ hoti, avijjāpariḷāhā nissaṭaṁ hoti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca nissaṭaṁ hoti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi nissaṭaṁ hoti, tato paṇītatarapaññindriyassa paṭilābhā purimatarapaññindriyā nissaṭaṁ hoti.

ps1.4:36.1.verse: Pubbabhāge pañcahi indriyehi paṭhamajjhānavasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, paṭhame jhāne pañcahindriyehi dutiyajjhānavasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, dutiye jhāne pañcahindriyehi tatiyajjhānavasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, tatiye jhāne pañcahindriyehi catutthajjhānavasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, catutthe jhāne pañcahindriyehi The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spacevasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceyā pañcahindriyehi The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousnessvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousnessyā pañcahindriyehi The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessyā pañcahindriyehi The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti.

ps1.4:37.1.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā pañcahindriyehi aniccānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, aniccānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi dukkhānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, dukkhānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi anattānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, anattānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi nibbidānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, nibbidānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi virāgānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, virāgānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi nirodhānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, nirodhānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi paṭinissaggānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, paṭinissaggānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi khayānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, khayānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi vayānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, vayānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi vipariṇāmānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, vipariṇāmānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi animittānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, animittānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi appaṇihitānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, appaṇihitānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi suññatānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti suññatānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi adhipaññādhammavipassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti.

ps1.4:37.2.verse: Adhipaññādhammavipassanāya pañcahindriyehi yathābhūtañāṇadassanavasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, yathābhūtañāṇadassane pañcahindriyehi ādīnavānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, ādīnavānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi paṭisaṅkhānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, paṭisaṅkhānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi vivaṭṭanānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti.

ps1.4:38.1.verse: Vivaṭṭanānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi sotāpattimaggavasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, sotāpattimagge pañcahindriyehi sotāpattiphalasamāpattivasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, sotāpattiphalasamāpattiyā pañcahindriyehi sakadāgāmimaggavasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, sakadāgāmimagge pañcahindriyehi sakadāgāmiphalasamāpattivasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, sakadāgāmiphalasamāpattiyā pañcahindriyehi anāgāmimaggavasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, anāgāmimagge pañcahindriyehi anāgāmiphalasamāpattivasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, anāgāmiphalasamāpattiyā pañcahindriyehi arahattamaggavasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, arahattamagge pañcahindriyehi arahattaphalasamāpattivasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti.

ps1.4:39.1.verse: Nekkhamme pañcindriyāni kāmacchandato nissaṭāni honti, abyāpāde pañcindriyāni byāpādato nissaṭāni honti, ālokasaññāya pañcindriyāni thinamiddhato nissaṭāni honti, avikkhepe pañcindriyāni uddhaccato nissaṭāni honti, dhammavavatthāne pañcindriyāni vicikicchāya nissaṭāni honti, ñāṇe pañcindriyāni avijjāya nissaṭāni honti, pāmojje pañcindriyāni aratiyā nissaṭāni honti.

ps1.4:40.1.verse: Paṭhame jhāne pañcindriyāni nīvaraṇehi nissaṭāni honti, dutiye jhāne pañcindriyāni vitakkavicārehi nissaṭāni honti, tatiye jhāne pañcindriyāni pītiyā nissaṭāni honti, catutthe jhāne pañcindriyāni sukhadukkhehi nissaṭāni honti, The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceyā pañcindriyāni rūpasaññāya paṭighasaññāya nānattasaññāya nissaṭāni honti, The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousnessyā pañcindriyāni ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāya nissaṭāni honti, The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessyā pañcindriyāni viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāya nissaṭāni honti, The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā pañcindriyāni ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāya nissaṭāni honti.

ps1.4:41.1.verse: Aniccānupassanāya pañcindriyāni niccasaññāya nissaṭāni honti, dukkhānupassanāya pañcindriyāni sukhasaññāya nissaṭāni honti, anattānupassanāya pañcindriyāni attasaññāya nissaṭāni honti, nibbidānupassanāya pañcindriyāni nandiyā nissaṭāni honti, virāgānupassanāya pañcindriyāni rāgato nissaṭāni honti, nirodhānupassanāya pañcindriyāni samudayato nissaṭāni honti, paṭinissaggānupassanāya pañcindriyāni ādānato nissaṭāni honti, khayānupassanāya pañcindriyāni ghanasaññāya nissaṭāni honti, vayānupassanāya pañcindriyāni āyūhanato nissaṭāni honti, vipariṇāmānupassanāya pañcindriyāni dhuvasaññāya nissaṭāni honti, animittānupassanāya pañcindriyāni nimittato nissaṭāni honti, appaṇihitānupassanāya pañcindriyāni paṇidhiyā nissaṭāni honti, suññatānupassanāya pañcindriyāni abhinivesato nissaṭāni honti.

ps1.4:41.2.verse: Adhipaññādhammavipassanāya pañcindriyāni sārādānābhinivesato nissaṭāni honti, yathābhūtañāṇadassane pañcindriyāni sammohābhinivesato nissaṭāni honti, ādīnavānupassanāya pañcindriyāni ālayābhinivesato nissaṭāni honti, paṭisaṅkhānupassanāya pañcindriyāni appaṭisaṅkhāya nissaṭāni honti, vivaṭṭanānupassanāya pañcindriyāni saññogābhinivesato nissaṭāni honti.

ps1.4:42.1.verse: Sotāpattimagge pañcindriyāni diṭṭhekaṭṭhehi kilesehi nissaṭāni honti, sakadāgāmimagge pañcindriyāni oḷārikehi kilesehi nissaṭāni honti, anāgāmimagge pañcindriyāni anusahagatehi kilesehi nissaṭāni honti, arahattamagge pañcindriyāni sabbakilesehi nissaṭāni honti, sabbesaññeva khīṇāsavānaṁ tattha tattha pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni ceva honti sunissaṭāni ca paṭippassaddhāni ca suppaṭippassaddhāni ca.

ps1.4:43.1.verse: Imehi asītisataṁ ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ nissaraṇaṁ hoti;

ps1.4:43.2.verse: imehi asītisataṁ ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ nissaraṇaṁ pajānāti.

ps1.4:45.1.verse: Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu saddhindriyassa vasena katihākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:45.2.verse: Catūsu sammappadhānesu vīriyindriyassa vasena katihākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:45.3.verse: Catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu satindriyassa vasena katihākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:45.4.verse: Catūsu jhānesu samādhindriyassa vasena katihākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:45.5.verse: Catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena katihākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:46.1.verse: Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu saddhindriyassa vasena vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:46.2.verse: Catūsu sammappadhānesu vīriyindriyassa vasena vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:46.3.verse: Catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu satindriyassa vasena vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:46.4.verse: Catūsu jhānesu samādhindriyassa vasena vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:46.5.verse: Catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:47.1.verse: Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu saddhindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:47.2.verse: Sappurisasaṁseve sotāpattiyaṅge adhimokkhādhipateyyaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, saddhindriyassa vasena paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ;

ps1.4:47.5.verse: dhammānudhammapaṭipattiyā sotāpattiyaṅge adhimokkhādhipateyyaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, saddhindriyassa vasena paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:47.6.verse: Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu saddhindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:48.1.verse: Catūsu sammappadhānesu vīriyindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:48.2.verse: Anuppannānaṁ pāpakānaṁ akusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ anuppādāya sammappadhāne paggahādhipateyyaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, vīriyindriyassa vasena upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:48.3.verse: Uppannānaṁ pāpakānaṁ akusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ pahānāya sammappadhāne …pe…

ps1.4:48.5.verse: uppannānaṁ kusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā sammappadhāne paggahādhipateyyaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, vīriyindriyassa vasena upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:48.6.verse: Catūsu sammappadhānesu vīriyindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:49.1.verse: Catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu satindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:49.2.verse: Kāye kāyānupassanāsatipaṭṭhāne upaṭṭhānādhipateyyaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, satindriyassa vasena avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:49.5.verse: dhammesu dhammānupassanāsatipaṭṭhāne upaṭṭhānādhipateyyaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, satindriyassa vasena avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:49.6.verse: Catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu satindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:50.1.verse: Catūsu jhānesu samādhindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:50.2.verse: Paṭhame jhāne avikkhepādhipateyyaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, samādhindriyassa vasena dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:50.5.verse: catutthe jhāne avikkhepādhipateyyaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, samādhindriyassa vasena dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:50.6.verse: Catūsu jhānesu samādhindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:51.1.verse: Catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni?

ps1.4:51.2.verse: Dukkhe ariyasacce dassanādhipateyyaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:51.5.verse: dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasacce dassanādhipateyyaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:51.6.verse: Catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcindriyāni daṭṭhabbāni.

ps1.4:52.1.verse: Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu saddhindriyassa vasena katihākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?

ps1.4:53.4.verse: catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena katihākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?

ps1.4:53.5.verse: Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu saddhindriyassa vasena vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:53.9.verse: catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:54.1.verse: Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu saddhindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?

ps1.4:54.2.verse: Sappurisasaṁseve sotāpattiyaṅge adhimokkhādhipateyyaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, saddhindriyassa vasena paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:54.5.verse: dhammānudhammapaṭipattiyā sotāpattiyaṅge adhimokkhādhipateyyaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, saddhindriyassa vasena paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:54.6.verse: Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu saddhindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:55.1.verse: Catūsu sammappadhānesu vīriyindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?

ps1.4:55.2.verse: Anuppannānaṁ pāpakānaṁ akusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ anuppādāya sammappadhāne paggahādhipateyyaṭṭhena vīriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, vīriyindriyassa vasena upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:55.3.verse: Uppannānaṁ pāpakānaṁ akusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ pahānāya sammappadhāne …pe…

ps1.4:55.5.verse: uppannānaṁ kusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā sammappadhāne paggahādhipateyyaṭṭhena vīriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā …pe…

ps1.4:55.6.verse: catūsu sammappadhānesu vīriyindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:56.1.verse: Catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu satindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?

ps1.4:56.2.verse: Kāye kāyānupassanāsatipaṭṭhāne upaṭṭhānādhipateyyaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, satindriyassa vasena avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:56.5.verse: dhammesu dhammānupassanāsatipaṭṭhāne upaṭṭhānādhipateyyaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā …pe…

ps1.4:56.6.verse: catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu satindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:57.1.verse: Catūsu jhānesu samādhindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?

ps1.4:57.2.verse: Paṭhame jhāne avikkhepādhipateyyaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, samādhindriyassa vasena dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:57.5.verse: catutthe jhāne avikkhepādhipateyyaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā …pe…

ps1.4:57.6.verse: catūsu jhānesu samādhindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:58.1.verse: Catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?

ps1.4:58.2.verse: Dukkhe ariyasacce dassanādhipateyyaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:58.5.verse: dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasacce dassanādhipateyyaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:58.6.verse: Catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ cariyā daṭṭhabbā.

ps1.4:59.1.verse: Cāro ca vihāro ca anubuddho hoti paṭividdho, yathācarantaṁ yathāviharantaṁ viññū sabrahmacārī gambhīresu ṭhānesu okappeyyuṁ—

ps1.4:60.2.verse: iriyāpathacariyā, āyatanacariyā, saticariyā, samādhicariyā, ñāṇacariyā, maggacariyā, patticariyā, lokatthacariyāti.

ps1.4:60.10.verse: Lokatthacariyāti tathāgatesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu, padese paccekabuddhesu, padese sāvakesu.

ps1.4:60.11.verse: Iriyāpathacariyā ca paṇidhisampannānaṁ, āyatanacariyā ca indriyesu guttadvārānaṁ, saticariyā ca appamādavihārīnaṁ, samādhicariyā ca adhicittamanuyuttānaṁ, ñāṇacariyā ca buddhisampannānaṁ, maggacariyā ca sammāpaṭipannānaṁ, patticariyā ca adhigataphalānaṁ, lokatthacariyā ca tathāgatānaṁ arahantānaṁ sammāsambuddhānaṁ, padese paccekabuddhānaṁ, padese sāvakānaṁ.

ps1.4:61.2.verse: Adhimuccanto saddhāya carati, paggaṇhanto vīriyena carati, upaṭṭhāpento satiyā carati, avikkhepaṁ karonto samādhinā carati, pajānanto paññāya carati, vijānanto viññāṇacariyāya carati, evaṁ paṭipannassa kusalā dhammā āyāpentīti āyatanacariyāya carati, evaṁ paṭipanno visesamadhigacchatīti visesacariyāya carati—

ps1.4:62.2.verse: Dassanacariyā ca sammādiṭṭhiyā, abhiniropanacariyā ca sammāsaṅkappassa, pariggahacariyā ca sammāvācāya, samuṭṭhānacariyā ca sammākammantassa, vodānacariyā ca sammāājīvassa, paggahacariyā ca sammāvāyāmassa, upaṭṭhānacariyā ca sammāsatiyā, avikkhepacariyā ca sammāsamādhissa—

ps1.4:63.1.verse: Vihāroti adhimuccanto saddhāya viharati, paggaṇhanto vīriyena viharati, upaṭṭhāpento satiyā viharati, avikkhepaṁ karonto samādhinā viharati, pajānanto paññāya viharati.

ps1.4:64.1.verse: Anubuddhoti saddhindriyassa adhimokkhaṭṭho anubuddho hoti, vīriyindriyassa paggahaṭṭho anubuddho hoti, satindriyassa upaṭṭhānaṭṭho anubuddho hoti, samādhindriyassa avikkhepaṭṭho anubuddho hoti, paññindriyassa dassanaṭṭho anubuddho hoti.

ps1.4:65.1.verse: Paṭividdhoti saddhindriyassa adhimokkhaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti, vīriyindriyassa paggahaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti, satindriyassa upaṭṭhānaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti, samādhindriyassa avikkhepaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti, paññindriyassa dassanaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti.

ps1.4:65.2.verse: Yathācarantanti evaṁ saddhāya carantaṁ, evaṁ vīriyena carantaṁ, evaṁ satiyā carantaṁ, evaṁ samādhinā carantaṁ, evaṁ paññāya carantaṁ.

ps1.4:65.3.verse: Yathāviharantanti evaṁ saddhāya viharantaṁ, evaṁ vīriyena viharantaṁ, evaṁ satiyā viharantaṁ, evaṁ samādhinā viharantaṁ, evaṁ paññāya viharantaṁ.

ps1.4:65.4.verse: Viññūti viññū vibhāvī medhāvī paṇḍitā buddhisampannā.

ps1.4:65.6.verse: Gambhīresu ṭhānesūti gambhīrāni ṭhānāni vuccanti jhānā ca vimokkhā ca samādhī ca samāpattiyo ca maggā ca phalāni ca abhiññāyo ca paṭisambhidā ca.

ps1.4:65.8.verse: Addhāti ekaṁsavacanametaṁ nissaṁsayavacanametaṁ nikkaṅkhavacanametaṁ advejjhavacanametaṁ adveḷhakavacanametaṁ niyogavacanametaṁ apaṇṇakavacanametaṁ avatthāpanavacanametaṁ—

ps1.4:66.8.verse: ādhipateyyaṭṭhena ādivisodhanaṭṭhena adhimattaṭṭhena, adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhena, pariyādānaṭṭhena, patiṭṭhāpakaṭṭhena”.

ps1.4:67.2.verse: Assaddhiyaṁ pajahato adhimokkhādhipateyyaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, saddhindriyassa vasena paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:67.3.verse: Kosajjaṁ pajahato paggahādhipateyyaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, vīriyindriyassa vasena upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:67.4.verse: Pamādaṁ pajahato upaṭṭhānādhipateyyaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, satindriyassa vasena avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:67.5.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato avikkhepādhipateyyaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, samādhindriyassa vasena dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:67.6.verse: Avijjaṁ pajahato dassanādhipateyyaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:68.1.verse: Kāmacchandaṁ pajahato nekkhammavasena adhimokkhādhipateyyaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, saddhindriyassa vasena paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:68.2.verse: Kāmacchandaṁ pajahato nekkhammavasena paggahādhipateyyaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, vīriyindriyassa vasena upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:68.3.verse: Kāmacchandaṁ pajahato nekkhammavasena upaṭṭhānādhipateyyaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, satindriyassa vasena avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:68.4.verse: Kāmacchandaṁ pajahato nekkhammavasena avikkhepādhipateyyaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, samādhindriyassa vasena dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:68.5.verse: Kāmacchandaṁ pajahato nekkhammavasena dassanādhipateyyaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:69.3.verse: sabbakilese pajahato arahattamaggavasena adhimokkhādhipateyyaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, saddhindriyassa vasena paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ …pe…

ps1.4:69.4.verse: sabbakilese pajahato arahattamaggavasena dassanādhipateyyaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ.

ps1.4:71.25.verse: ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanāvasena saddhāvasena saddhindriyaṁ adhimattaṁ hoti.

ps1.4:73.18.verse: uddhaccassa pahānāya chando uppajjati uddhaccapariḷāhassa pahānāya chando uppajjati …pe…

ps1.4:76.2.verse: Adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ assaddhiyaṁ pariyādiyati, assaddhiyapariḷāhaṁ pariyādiyati.

ps1.4:76.3.verse: Paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ kosajjaṁ pariyādiyati, kosajjapariḷāhaṁ pariyādiyati.

ps1.4:76.4.verse: Upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ pamādaṁ pariyādiyati, pamādapariḷāhaṁ pariyādiyati.

ps1.4:76.5.verse: Avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ uddhaccaṁ pariyādiyati, uddhaccapariḷāhaṁ pariyādiyati.

ps1.4:76.6.verse: Dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyaṁ avijjaṁ pariyādiyati, avijjāpariḷāhaṁ pariyādiyati.

ps1.4:77.2.verse: Saddho saddhindriyaṁ adhimokkhe patiṭṭhāpeti, saddhassa saddhindriyaṁ adhimokkhe patiṭṭhāpeti.

ps1.4:77.3.verse: Vīriyavā vīriyindriyaṁ paggahe patiṭṭhāpeti, vīriyavato vīriyindriyaṁ paggahe patiṭṭhāpeti.

ps1.4:77.4.verse: Satimā satindriyaṁ upaṭṭhāne patiṭṭhāpeti, satimato satindriyaṁ upaṭṭhāne patiṭṭhāpeti.

ps1.4:77.5.verse: Samāhito samādhindriyaṁ avikkhepe patiṭṭhāpeti, samāhitassa samādhindriyaṁ avikkhepe patiṭṭhāpeti.

ps1.4:77.6.verse: Paññavā paññindriyaṁ dassane patiṭṭhāpeti, paññavato paññindriyaṁ dassane patiṭṭhāpeti.

ps1.4:77.7.verse: Yogāvacaro pañcindriyāni nekkhamme patiṭṭhāpeti, yogāvacarassa pañcindriyāni nekkhamme patiṭṭhāpenti.

ps1.4:77.8.verse: Yogāvacaro pañcindriyāni abyāpāde patiṭṭhāpeti, yogāvacarassa pañcindriyāni abyāpāde patiṭṭhāpenti.

ps1.4:77.9.verse: Yogāvacaro pañcindriyāni ālokasaññāya patiṭṭhāpeti, yogāvacarassa pañcindriyāni ālokasaññāya patiṭṭhāpenti.

ps1.4:77.10.verse: Yogāvacaro pañcindriyāni avikkhepe patiṭṭhāpeti, yogāvacarassa pañcindriyāni avikkhepe patiṭṭhāpenti …pe…

ps1.4:77.11.verse: yogāvacaro pañcindriyāni arahattamagge patiṭṭhāpeti, yogāvacarassa pañcindriyāni arahattamagge patiṭṭhāpenti.

ps1.4:78.1.verse: Puthujjano samādhiṁ bhāvento katihākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:78.2.verse: Sekkho samādhiṁ bhāvento katihākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:78.3.verse: Vītarāgo samādhiṁ bhāvento katihākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:78.4.verse: Puthujjano samādhiṁ bhāvento sattahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:78.5.verse: Sekkho samādhiṁ bhāvento aṭṭhahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:78.6.verse: Vītarāgo samādhiṁ bhāvento dasahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:79.1.verse: Puthujjano samādhiṁ bhāvento katamehi sattahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:79.2.verse: Āvajjitattā ārammaṇūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, samathanimittūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, paggahanimittūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, avikkhepūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, obhāsūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, sampahaṁsanūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, upekkhūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti—

ps1.4:79.3.verse: puthujjano samādhiṁ bhāvento imehi sattahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:80.1.verse: Sekkho samādhiṁ bhāvento katamehi aṭṭhahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:80.2.verse: Āvajjitattā ārammaṇūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, samathanimittūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, paggahanimittūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, avikkhepūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, obhāsūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, sampahaṁsanūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, upekkhūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, ekattūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti—

ps1.4:80.3.verse: sekkho samādhiṁ bhāvento imehi aṭṭhahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:81.1.verse: Vītarāgo samādhiṁ bhāvento katamehi dasahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:81.2.verse: Āvajjitattā ārammaṇūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti …pe… ekattūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, ñāṇūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, vimuttūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti—

ps1.4:81.3.verse: vītarāgo samādhiṁ bhāvento imehi dasahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:82.1.verse: Puthujjano vipassanaṁ bhāvento katihākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, katihākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:82.2.verse: Sekkho vipassanaṁ bhāvento katihākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, katihākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:82.3.verse: Vītarāgo vipassanaṁ bhāvento katihākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, katihākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:83.1.verse: Puthujjano vipassanaṁ bhāvento navahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, navahi ākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:83.2.verse: Sekkho vipassanaṁ bhāvento dasahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, dasahi ākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:83.3.verse: Vītarāgo vipassanaṁ bhāvento dvādasahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, dvādasahi ākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:84.1.verse: Puthujjano vipassanaṁ bhāvento katamehi navahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, katamehi navahi ākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:84.2.verse: Aniccato upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, niccato anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:84.3.verse: Dukkhato upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, sukhato anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:84.4.verse: Anattato upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, attato anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:84.5.verse: Khayato upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, ghanato anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:84.11.verse: puthujjano vipassanaṁ bhāvento imehi navahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, imehi navahi ākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:85.1.verse: Sekkho vipassanaṁ bhāvento katamehi dasahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, katamehi dasahi ākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:85.2.verse: Aniccato upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, niccato anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti …pe… suññatūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, abhinivesānupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:85.4.verse: sekkho vipassanaṁ bhāvento imehi dasahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, imehi dasahi ākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:86.1.verse: Vītarāgo vipassanaṁ bhāvento katamehi dvādasahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, katamehi dvādasahi ākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti?

ps1.4:86.2.verse: Aniccato upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, niccato anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti …pe… ñāṇūpaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, añāṇānupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:86.5.verse: vītarāgo vipassanaṁ bhāvento imehi dvādasahi ākārehi upaṭṭhānakusalo hoti, imehi dvādasahi ākārehi anupaṭṭhānakusalo hoti.

ps1.4:87.1.verse: Āvajjitattā ārammaṇūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena indriyāni samodhāneti, gocarañca pajānāti, samatthañca paṭivijjhati …pe…

ps1.4:87.2.verse: dhamme samodhāneti, gocarañca pajānāti, samatthañca paṭivijjhati.

ps1.4:87.4.verse: Adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ samodhāneti …pe… samathanimittūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, paggahanimittūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, avikkhepūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, obhāsūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, sampahaṁsanūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, upekkhūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, ekattūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, ñāṇūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, vimuttūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena.

ps1.4:88.1.verse: Aniccato upaṭṭhānakusalavasena, niccato anupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, dukkhato upaṭṭhānakusalavasena, sukhato anupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, anattato upaṭṭhānakusalavasena, attato anupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, khayato upaṭṭhānakusalavasena, ghanato anupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, vayato upaṭṭhānakusalavasena, āyūhanānupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, vipariṇāmūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, dhuvato anupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, animittūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, nimittānupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, appaṇihitūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, paṇidhianupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, suññatūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, abhinivesānupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, ñāṇūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, añāṇānupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, visaññogūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, saññogānupaṭṭhānakusalavasena, nirodhūpaṭṭhānakusalavasena, saṅkhārānupaṭṭhānakusalavasena indriyāni samodhāneti, gocarañca pajānāti, samatthañca paṭivijjhati.

ps1.4:89.1.verse: Catusaṭṭhiyā ākārehi tiṇṇannaṁ indriyānaṁ vasibhāvatā paññā āsavānaṁ khaye ñāṇaṁ.

ps1.4:90.7.verse: sotāpattiphalaṁ, sakadāgāmimaggaṁ, sakadāgāmiphalaṁ, anāgāmimaggaṁ, anāgāmiphalaṁ, arahattamaggaṁ.

ps1.4:91.1.verse: Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe anaññātaññassāmītindriyassa saddhindriyaṁ adhimokkhaparivāraṁ hoti, vīriyindriyaṁ paggahaparivāraṁ hoti, satindriyaṁ upaṭṭhānaparivāraṁ hoti, samādhindriyaṁ avikkhepaparivāraṁ hoti, paññindriyaṁ dassanaparivāraṁ hoti, manindriyaṁ vijānanaparivāraṁ hoti, somanassindriyaṁ abhisandanaparivāraṁ hoti, jīvitindriyaṁ pavattasantatādhipateyyaparivāraṁ hoti.

ps1.4:91.2.verse: Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe jātā dhammā, ṭhapetvā cittasamuṭṭhānaṁ rūpaṁ, sabbeva kusalā honti, sabbeva anāsavā honti, sabbeva niyyānikā honti, sabbeva apacayagāmino honti, sabbeva lokuttarā honti, sabbeva nibbānārammaṇā honti.

ps1.4:91.3.verse: Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe anaññātaññassāmītindriyassa imāni aṭṭhindriyāni sahajātaparivārā honti, aññamaññaparivārā honti, nissayaparivārā honti, sampayuttaparivārā honti, sahagatā honti, sahajātā honti, saṁsaṭṭhā honti, sampayuttā honti.

ps1.4:91.4.verse: Teva tassa ākārā ceva honti parivārā ca.

ps1.4:92.4.verse: Arahattaphalakkhaṇe jātā dhammā sabbeva abyākatā honti, ṭhapetvā cittasamuṭṭhānaṁ materiality  sabbeva anāsavā honti, sabbeva lokuttarā honti, sabbeva nibbānārammaṇā honti.

ps1.4:92.5.verse: Arahattaphalakkhaṇe aññātāvindriyassa imāni aṭṭhindriyāni sahajātaparivārā honti.

ps1.4:92.6.verse: Teva tassa ākārā ceva honti parivārā ca.

ps1.4:92.7.verse: Iti imāni aṭṭha aṭṭhakāni catusaṭṭhi honti.

ps1.4:93.5.verse: Apāyagamanīyo kāmāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo bhavāsavo khīyati, apāyagamanīyo avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.4:93.7.verse: Sakadāgāmimaggena oḷāriko kāmāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho bhavāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.4:93.9.verse: Anāgāmimaggena anavaseso kāmāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho bhavāsavo khīyati, tadekaṭṭho avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.4:93.11.verse: Arahattamaggena anavaseso bhavāsavo khīyati, anavaseso avijjāsavo khīyati.

ps1.4:95.3.verse: dukkhe ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ …pe…

ps1.4:95.6.verse: Imesaṁ cuddasannaṁ buddhañāṇānaṁ aṭṭha ñāṇāni sāvakasādhāraṇāni, cha ñāṇāni asādhāraṇāni sāvakehi.

ps1.4:96.1.verse: Yāvatā dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho ñāto, aññāto dukkhaṭṭho natthīti—

ps1.4:96.4.verse: Paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ.

ps1.4:96.5.verse: Yāvatā dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho diṭṭho vidito sacchikato phassito paññāya;

ps1.4:96.9.verse: Paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ.

ps1.4:96.21.verse: yāvatā sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṁ sutaṁ mutaṁ viññātaṁ pattaṁ pariyesitaṁ anuvicaritaṁ manasā, taṁ ñātaṁ diṭṭhaṁ viditaṁ sacchikataṁ phassitaṁ paññāya.

ps1.4:96.25.verse: Paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyaṁ, paggahaṭṭhena vīriyindriyaṁ, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyaṁ, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyaṁ.

ps1.4:99.1.verse: Yaṁ buddhacakkhu taṁ buddhañāṇaṁ, yaṁ buddhañāṇaṁ taṁ buddhacakkhu, yena cakkhunā tathāgato satte passati apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino, appekacce naparalokavajjabhayadassāvino.

ps1.4:100.1.verse: Apparajakkhe mahārajakkheti saddho puggalo apparajakkho, assaddho puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.4:100.2.verse: Āraddhavīriyo puggalo apparajakkho, kusīto puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.4:100.3.verse: Upaṭṭhitassati puggalo apparajakkho, muṭṭhassati puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.4:100.4.verse: Samāhito puggalo apparajakkho, asamāhito puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.4:100.5.verse: Paññavā puggalo apparajakkho, duppañño puggalo mahārajakkho.

ps1.4:101.1.verse: Tikkhindriye mudindriyeti saddho puggalo tikkhindriyo, assaddho puggalo mudindriyo …pe…

ps1.4:101.2.verse: paññavā puggalo tikkhindriyo, duppañño puggalo mudindriyo.

ps1.4:101.3.verse: Svākāre dvākāreti saddho puggalo svākāro, assaddho puggalo dvākāro …pe…

ps1.4:101.4.verse: paññavā puggalo svākāro, duppañño puggalo dvākāro.

ps1.4:101.5.verse: Suviññāpaye duviññāpayeti saddho puggalo suviññāpayo, assaddho puggalo duviññāpayo …pe…

ps1.4:101.6.verse: paññavā puggalo suviññāpayo, duppañño puggalo duviññāpayo.

ps1.4:102.1.verse: Appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino, appekacce naparalokavajjabhayadassāvinoti saddho puggalo paralokavajjabhayadassāvī, assaddho puggalo naparalokavajjabhayadassāvī.

ps1.4:102.2.verse: Āraddhavīriyo puggalo paralokavajjabhayadassāvī, kusīto puggalo naparalokavajjabhayadassāvī …pe…

ps1.4:102.3.verse: paññavā puggalo paralokavajjabhayadassāvī, duppañño puggalo naparalokavajjabhayadassāvī.

ps1.4:103.1.verse: Lokoti khandhaloko dhātuloko āyatanaloko vipattibhavaloko vipattisambhavaloko sampattibhavaloko sampattisambhavaloko.

ps1.4:105.1.verse: Vajjanti sabbe kilesā vajjā, sabbe duccaritā vajjā, sabbe abhiformations vajjā, sabbe bhavagāmikammā vajjā.

ps1.4:105.2.verse: Iti imasmiñca loke imasmiñca vajje tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā honti, seyyathāpi ukkhittāsike vadhake.

ps1.4:105.3.verse: Imehi paññāsāya ākārehi imāni pañcindriyāni jānāti passati aññāti paṭivijjhatīti.

ps1.5:1.4.verse: Suññato vimokkho, animitto vimokkho, appaṇihito vimokkho—

ps1.5:2.2.verse: suññato vimokkho, animitto vimokkho, appaṇihito vimokkho;

ps1.5:2.3.verse: ajjhattavuṭṭhāno vimokkho, bahiddhāvuṭṭhāno vimokkho, dubhato vuṭṭhāno vimokkho;

ps1.5:2.4.verse: ajjhattavuṭṭhānā cattāro vimokkhā, bahiddhāvuṭṭhānā cattāro vimokkhā, dubhato vuṭṭhānā cattāro vimokkhā;

ps1.5:2.5.verse: ajjhattavuṭṭhānānaṁ anulomā cattāro vimokkhā, bahiddhāvuṭṭhānānaṁ anulomā cattāro vimokkhā, dubhato vuṭṭhānānaṁ anulomā cattāro vimokkhā;

ps1.5:2.6.verse: ajjhattavuṭṭhānapaṭippassaddhī cattāro vimokkhā, bahiddhāvuṭṭhānapaṭippassaddhī cattāro vimokkhā, dubhato vuṭṭhānapaṭippassaddhī cattāro vimokkhā;

ps1.5:2.7.verse: rūpī rūpāni passatīti vimokkho, ajjhattaṁ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passatīti vimokkho, subhaṁ teva adhimutto hotīti vimokkho;

ps1.5:2.8.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless space vimokkho, viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpatti vimokkho, The attainment of the base consisting of nothingness vimokkho;

ps1.5:2.9.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perception vimokkho, saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpatti vimokkho;

ps1.5:2.16.verse: nirāmisānirāmisataro vimokkho, paṇihito vimokkho, appaṇihito vimokkho, paṇihitappaṭippassaddhi vimokkho;

ps1.5:3.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati—

ps1.5:4.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati—

ps1.5:5.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati—

ps1.5:8.2.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless space rūpasaññāya paṭighasaññāya nānattasaññāya vuṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:8.3.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousness ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāya vuṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:8.4.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingness viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāya vuṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:8.5.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perception ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāya vuṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:9.2.verse: Sotāpattimaggo sakkāyadiṭṭhivicikicchāsīlabbataparāmāsā diṭṭhānusayā vicikicchānusayā vuṭṭhāti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhāti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi vuṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:9.3.verse: Sakadāgāmimaggo oḷārikā kāmarāgasaññojanā paṭighasaññojanā oḷārikā kāmarāgānusayā paṭighānusayā vuṭṭhāti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhāti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi vuṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:9.4.verse: Anāgāmimaggo anusahagatā kāmarāgasaññojanā paṭighasaññojanā anusahagatā kāmarāgānusayā paṭighānusayā vuṭṭhāti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhāti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi vuṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:9.5.verse: Arahattamaggo rūparāgā arūparāgā mānā uddhaccā avijjāya mānānusayā bhavarāgānusayā avijjānusayā vuṭṭhāti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhāti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi vuṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:10.2.verse: Paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ paṭilābhatthāya vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca, dutiyaṁ jhānaṁ paṭilābhatthāya …pe…

ps1.5:10.4.verse: catutthaṁ jhānaṁ paṭilābhatthāya vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca—

ps1.5:11.2.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceṁ paṭilābhatthāya vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca, viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiṁ …pe…

ps1.5:11.3.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessṁ …pe…

ps1.5:11.4.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionṁ paṭilābhatthāya vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca—

ps1.5:12.1.verse: Katame dubhato vuṭṭhānānaṁ anulomā cattāro vimokkhā?

ps1.5:12.6.verse: ime dubhato vuṭṭhānānaṁ anulomā cattāro vimokkhā.

ps1.5:13.2.verse: Paṭhamassa jhānassa paṭilābho vā vipāko vā, dutiyassa jhānassa …pe…

ps1.5:13.4.verse: catutthassa jhānassa paṭilābho vā vipāko vā—

ps1.5:14.2.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceyā paṭilābho vā vipāko vā, viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā …pe…

ps1.5:14.3.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessyā …pe…

ps1.5:14.4.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā paṭilābho vā vipāko vā—

ps1.5:15.2.verse: Sotāpattimaggassa sotāpattiphalaṁ, sakadāgāmimaggassa sakadāgāmiphalaṁ, anāgāmimaggassa anāgāmiphalaṁ, arahattamaggassa arahattaphalaṁ—

ps1.5:16.2.verse: Idhekacco ajjhattaṁ paccattaṁ nīlanimittaṁ manasikaroti, nīlasaññaṁ paṭilabhati.

ps1.5:16.3.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ karoti, sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāreti, svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpeti.

ps1.5:16.4.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ katvā sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāretvā svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpetvā bahiddhā nīlanimitte cittaṁ upasaṁharati, nīlasaññaṁ paṭilabhati.

ps1.5:16.5.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ karoti, sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāreti, svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpeti.

ps1.5:16.6.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ katvā upadhāretvā svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpetvā āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

ps1.5:16.8.verse: “ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca ubhayamidaṁ rūpan”ti, rūpasaññī hoti.

ps1.5:16.12.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ karoti, sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāreti, svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpeti.

ps1.5:16.13.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ katvā sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāretvā svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpetvā bahiddhā odātanimitte cittaṁ upasaṁharati, odātasaññaṁ paṭilabhati.

ps1.5:16.14.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ karoti, sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāreti, svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpeti.

ps1.5:16.15.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ katvā sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāretvā svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpetvā āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

ps1.5:16.17.verse: “ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca ubhayamidaṁ rūpan”ti, rūpasaññī hoti.

ps1.5:17.1.verse: Kathaṁ ajjhattaṁ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passatīti—vimokkho?

ps1.5:17.2.verse: Idhekacco ajjhattaṁ paccattaṁ nīlanimittaṁ na manasikaroti, nīlasaññaṁ na paṭilabhati;

ps1.5:17.3.verse: bahiddhā nīlanimitte cittaṁ upasaṁharati, nīlasaññaṁ paṭilabhati.

ps1.5:17.4.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ karoti, sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāreti, svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpeti.

ps1.5:17.5.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ katvā sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāretvā svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpetvā āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

ps1.5:17.10.verse: odātanimittaṁ na manasikaroti, odātasaññaṁ na paṭilabhati;

ps1.5:17.11.verse: bahiddhā odātanimitte cittaṁ upasaṁharati, odātasaññaṁ paṭilabhati.

ps1.5:17.12.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ karoti, sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāreti, svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpeti.

ps1.5:17.13.verse: So taṁ nimittaṁ suggahitaṁ katvā sūpadhāritaṁ upadhāretvā svāvatthitaṁ avatthāpetvā āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

ps1.5:17.16.verse: Evaṁ ajjhattaṁ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passatīti—

ps1.5:18.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṁ disaṁ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṁ, tathā tatiyaṁ, tathā catutthaṁ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṁ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṁ lokaṁ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.

ps1.5:18.8.verse: Upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṁ disaṁ pharitvā viharati …pe…

ps1.5:19.1.verse: Katamo The attainment of the base consisting of boundless space vimokkho?

ps1.5:19.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṁ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṁ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṁ amanasikārā “ananto ākāso”ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṁ upasampajja viharati—

ps1.5:19.3.verse: ayaṁ The attainment of the base consisting of boundless space vimokkho.

ps1.5:20.1.verse: Katamo The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousness vimokkho?

ps1.5:20.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṁ samatikkamma “anantaṁ viññāṇan”ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṁ upasampajja viharati—

ps1.5:20.3.verse: ayaṁ The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousness vimokkho.

ps1.5:21.1.verse: Katamo The attainment of the base consisting of nothingness vimokkho?

ps1.5:21.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṁ samatikkamma “natthi kiñcī”ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṁ upasampajja viharati—

ps1.5:21.3.verse: ayaṁ The attainment of the base consisting of nothingness vimokkho.

ps1.5:22.1.verse: Katamo The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perception vimokkho?

ps1.5:22.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṁ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṁ upasampajja viharati—

ps1.5:22.3.verse: ayaṁ The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perception vimokkho.

ps1.5:23.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṁ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṁ upasampajja viharati—

ps1.5:24.2.verse: Cattāri ca jhānāni catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo—

ps1.5:25.2.verse: Cattāro ca ariyamaggā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca—

ps1.5:26.2.verse: Cattāri ca jhānāni, catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo—

ps1.5:27.2.verse: Cattāro ca ariyamaggā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca—

ps1.5:28.2.verse: Cattāri ca jhānāni, catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo—

ps1.5:29.2.verse: Cattāro ca ariyamaggā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca—

ps1.5:30.2.verse: Cattāri ca jhānāni, catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo—

ps1.5:31.2.verse: Cattāro ca ariyamaggā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca—

ps1.5:32.2.verse: Cattāri ca jhānāni, catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo—

ps1.5:33.2.verse: Cattāro ca ariyamaggā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca—

ps1.5:36.2.verse: Cattāro ca ariyamaggā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca—

ps1.5:37.2.verse: Cattāri ca jhānāni, catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo—

ps1.5:37.5.verse: Cattāro ca ariyamaggā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca—

ps1.5:38.2.verse: Paṭhamassa jhānassa paṭilābho vā vipāko vā …pe…

ps1.5:38.3.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā paṭilābho vā vipāko vā—

ps1.5:39.2.verse: Cattāri ca jhānāni, catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo—

ps1.5:40.2.verse: Cattāro ca ariyamaggā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca—

ps1.5:41.2.verse: Cattāro ca ariyamaggā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānañca—

ps1.5:42.2.verse: Cattāri ca jhānāni, catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo—

ps1.5:43.2.verse: Siyā eko saññāvimokkho dasa saññāvimokkhā honti, dasa saññāvimokkhā eko saññāvimokkho hoti, vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:44.22.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko saññāvimokkho dasa saññāvimokkhā honti, dasa saññāvimokkhā eko saññāvimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:45.5.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko saññāvimokkho dasa saññāvimokkhā honti, dasa saññāvimokkhā eko saññāvimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:46.10.verse: Evaṁ siyā, eko saññāvimokkho dasa saññāvimokkhā honti, dasa saññāvimokkhā eko saññāvimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena—

ps1.5:47.2.verse: Siyā eko ñāṇavimokkho dasa ñāṇavimokkhā honti, dasa ñāṇavimokkhā eko ñāṇavimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena siyāti.

ps1.5:47.4.verse: Aniccānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ niccato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.6.verse: Dukkhānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ sukhato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.8.verse: Anattānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ attato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.10.verse: Nibbidānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ nandiyā sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.12.verse: Virāgānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ rāgato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.14.verse: Nirodhānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ samudayato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.16.verse: Paṭinissaggānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ ādānato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.18.verse: Animittānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ nimittato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.20.verse: Appaṇihitānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ paṇidhiyā sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.22.verse: Suññatānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ abhinivesato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:47.24.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko ñāṇavimokkho dasa ñāṇavimokkhā honti, dasa ñāṇavimokkhā eko ñāṇavimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:48.1.verse: Rūpe aniccānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ niccato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:48.3.verse: rūpe suññatānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ abhinivesato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:48.5.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko ñāṇavimokkho dasa ñāṇavimokkhā honti, dasa ñāṇavimokkhā eko ñāṇavimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:49.6.verse: jarāmaraṇe aniccānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ niccato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:49.8.verse: jarāmaraṇe suññatānupassanā yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ abhinivesato sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti—

ps1.5:49.10.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko ñāṇavimokkho dasa ñāṇavimokkhā honti, dasa ñāṇavimokkhā eko ñāṇavimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena—

ps1.5:50.2.verse: Siyā eko sītisiyāvimokkho dasa sītisiyāvimokkhā honti, dasa sītisiyāvimokkhā eko sītisiyāvimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena siyāti.

ps1.5:50.4.verse: Aniccānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ niccato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.6.verse: Dukkhānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ sukhato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.8.verse: Anattānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ attato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.10.verse: Nibbidānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ nandiyā santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.12.verse: Virāgānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ rāgato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.14.verse: Nirodhānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ samudayato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.16.verse: Paṭinissaggānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ ādānato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.18.verse: Animittānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ nimittato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.20.verse: Appaṇihitānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ paṇidhiyā santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.22.verse: Suññatānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ abhinivesato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:50.24.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko sītisiyāvimokkho dasa sītisiyāvimokkhā honti, dasa sītisiyāvimokkhā eko sītisiyāvimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:51.1.verse: Rūpe aniccānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ niccato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:51.3.verse: rūpe suññatānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ abhinivesato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:51.5.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko sītisiyāvimokkho dasa sītisiyāvimokkhā honti, dasa sītisiyāvimokkhā eko sītisiyāvimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:52.6.verse: jarāmaraṇe aniccānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ niccato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:52.8.verse: jarāmaraṇe suññatānupassanā anuttaraṁ sītibhāvañāṇaṁ abhinivesato santāpapariḷāhadarathā muccatīti—

ps1.5:52.10.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko sītisiyāvimokkho dasa sītisiyāvimokkhā honti, dasa sītisiyāvimokkhā eko sītisiyāvimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena—

ps1.5:53.34.verse: Jhāte ca jhāpe ca jānātīti—jhānavimokkho—ayaṁ jhānavimokkho.

ps1.5:54.2.verse: Siyā eko anupādācittassa vimokkho dasa anupādācittassa vimokkhā honti, dasa anupādācittassa vimokkhā eko anupādācittassa vimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena siyāti.

ps1.5:54.24.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko anupādācittassa vimokkho dasa anupādācittassa vimokkhā honti, dasa anupādācittassa vimokkhā eko anupādācittassa vimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:55.5.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko anupādācittassa vimokkho dasa anupādācittassa vimokkhā honti, dasa anupādācittassa vimokkhā eko anupādācittassa vimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:56.10.verse: Evaṁ siyā eko anupādācittassa vimokkho dasa anupādācittassa vimokkhā honti, dasa anupādācittassa vimokkhā eko anupādācittassa vimokkho hoti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:60.1.verse: Yañca aniccānupassanañāṇaṁ, yañca anattānupassanañāṇaṁ, yañca animittānupassanañāṇaṁ, yañca suññatānupassanañāṇaṁ—

ps1.5:60.4.verse: Yañca dukkhānupassanañāṇaṁ, yaṁ ca nibbidānupassanañāṇaṁ, yañca virāgānupassanañāṇaṁ, yañca appaṇihitānupassanañāṇaṁ—

ps1.5:61.1.verse: Tīṇi kho panimāni vimokkhamukhāni lokaniyyānāya saṁvattanti.

ps1.5:61.2.verse: Sabbasaṅkhāre paricchedaparivaṭumato samanupassanatāya animittāya ca dhātuyā cittasampakkhandanatāya, sabbasaṅkhāresu manosamuttejanatāya appaṇihitāya ca dhātuyā cittasampakkhandanatāya, sabbadhamme parato samanupassanatāya suññatāya ca dhātuyā cittasampakkhandanatāya—

ps1.5:62.4.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto khayato formations upaṭṭhanti, dukkhato manasikaroto bhayato formations upaṭṭhanti, anattato manasikaroto suññato formations upaṭṭhanti.

ps1.5:63.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto kiṁ bahulaṁ cittaṁ hoti?

ps1.5:63.2.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto kiṁ bahulaṁ cittaṁ hoti?

ps1.5:63.3.verse: Anattato manasikaroto kiṁ bahulaṁ cittaṁ hoti?

ps1.5:65.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto adhimokkhabahulassa katamindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti, bhāvanāya katindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, kenaṭṭhena bhāvanā, ko bhāveti?

ps1.5:65.2.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto passaddhibahulassa katamindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti, bhāvanāya katindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, kenaṭṭhena bhāvanā, ko bhāveti?

ps1.5:65.3.verse: Anattato manasikaroto vedabahulassa katamindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti, bhāvanāya katindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, kenaṭṭhena bhāvanā, ko bhāveti?

ps1.5:65.4.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto adhimokkhabahulassa saddhindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti.

ps1.5:65.5.verse: Bhāvanāya cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti.

ps1.5:65.9.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto passaddhibahulassa samādhindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti.

ps1.5:65.10.verse: Bhāvanāya cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti.

ps1.5:65.14.verse: Anattato manasikaroto vedabahulassa paññindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti.

ps1.5:65.15.verse: Bhāvanāya cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti.

ps1.5:66.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto adhimokkhabahulassa katamindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti?

ps1.5:66.2.verse: Bhāvanāya katindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti?

ps1.5:66.4.verse: Paṭivedhāya katindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti?

ps1.5:66.7.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto passaddhibahulassa katamindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti?

ps1.5:66.8.verse: Bhāvanāya katindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti?

ps1.5:66.10.verse: Paṭivedhāya katindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti?

ps1.5:66.13.verse: Anattato manasikaroto vedabahulassa katamindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti?

ps1.5:66.14.verse: Bhāvanāya katindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti?

ps1.5:66.16.verse: Paṭivedhāya katindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti?

ps1.5:67.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto adhimokkhabahulassa saddhindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti.

ps1.5:67.2.verse: Bhāvanāya cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti.

ps1.5:67.4.verse: Paṭivedhāya cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti.

ps1.5:67.8.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto passaddhibahulassa samādhindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti.

ps1.5:67.9.verse: Bhāvanāya cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti.

ps1.5:67.11.verse: Paṭivedhāya cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti.

ps1.5:67.15.verse: Anattato manasikaroto vedabahulassa paññindriyaṁ ādhipateyyaṁ hoti.

ps1.5:67.16.verse: Bhāvanāya cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti.

ps1.5:67.18.verse: Paṭivedhāya cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti.

ps1.5:70.9.verse: Jhānaphassaṁ paṭhamaṁ phusati, pacchā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ sacchikarotīti—

ps1.5:70.11.verse: “Dukkhā saṅkhārā, sukho nirodho”ti ñātaṁ hoti diṭṭhaṁ viditaṁ sacchikataṁ phassitaṁ paññāyāti—

ps1.5:70.13.verse: Yo cāyaṁ puggalo saddhāvimutto, yo ca kāyasakkhī, yo ca diṭṭhippatto, siyā ime tayo puggalā saddhāvimuttāpi kāyasakkhīpi diṭṭhippattāpi vatthuvasena pariyāyena siyāti.

ps1.5:70.21.verse: Evaṁ ime tayo puggalā saddhindriyassa vasena saddhāvimuttā.

ps1.5:71.7.verse: Evaṁ ime tayo puggalā samādhindriyassa vasena kāyasakkhī.

ps1.5:72.7.verse: Evaṁ ime tayo puggalā paññindriyassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:73.1.verse: Yo cāyaṁ puggalo saddhāvimutto, yo ca kāyasakkhī, yo ca diṭṭhippatto, evaṁ siyā ime tayo puggalā saddhāvimuttāpi kāyasakkhīpi diṭṭhippattāpi vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:73.2.verse: Yo cāyaṁ puggalo saddhāvimutto, yo ca kāyasakkhī, yo ca diṭṭhippatto, siyā ime tayo puggalā …pe…

ps1.5:73.3.verse: aññoyeva saddhāvimutto, añño kāyasakkhī, añño diṭṭhippatto.

ps1.5:74.9.verse: Yo cāyaṁ puggalo saddhāvimutto, yo ca kāyasakkhī, yo ca diṭṭhippatto, evaṁ siyā ime tayo puggalā saddhāvimuttāpi kāyasakkhīpi diṭṭhippattāpi vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

ps1.5:74.10.verse: Aññoyeva saddhāvimutto, añño kāyasakkhī, añño diṭṭhippatto.

ps1.5:75.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto saddhindriyaṁ adhimattaṁ hoti, saddhindriyassa adhimattattā sotāpattimaggaṁ paṭilabhati;

ps1.5:75.4.verse: Cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti.

ps1.5:75.5.verse: Saddhindriyassa vasena catunnaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvanā hoti.
