ps1.5:75.6.verse: Ye hi keci saddhindriyassa vasena sotāpattimaggaṁ paṭilabhanti, sabbe te saddhānusārino.

ps1.5:76.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto saddhindriyaṁ adhimattaṁ hoti, saddhindriyassa adhimattattā sotāpattiphalaṁ sacchikataṁ hoti;

ps1.5:76.4.verse: Cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti.

ps1.5:76.5.verse: Saddhindriyassa vasena cattārindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.

ps1.5:76.6.verse: Yehi keci saddhindriyassa vasena sotāpattiphalaṁ sacchikatā, sabbe te saddhāvimuttā.

ps1.5:77.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto saddhindriyaṁ adhimattaṁ hoti, saddhindriyassa adhimattattā sakadāgāmimaggaṁ paṭilabhati …pe…

ps1.5:77.11.verse: Saddhindriyassa vasena cattārindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.

ps1.5:77.12.verse: Yehi keci saddhindriyassa vasena arahattaṁ sacchikatā, sabbe te saddhāvimuttā.

ps1.5:78.1.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto samādhindriyaṁ adhimattaṁ hoti, samādhindriyassa adhimattattā sotāpattimaggaṁ paṭilabhati;

ps1.5:78.4.verse: Cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti.

ps1.5:78.5.verse: Samādhindriyassa vasena catunnaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvanā hoti.

ps1.5:78.6.verse: Ye hi keci samādhindriyassa vasena sotāpattimaggaṁ paṭilabhanti, sabbe te kāyasakkhī.

ps1.5:79.1.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto samādhindriyaṁ adhimattaṁ hoti, samādhindriyassa adhimattattā sotāpattiphalaṁ sacchikataṁ hoti …pe…

ps1.5:79.10.verse: Cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti.

ps1.5:79.11.verse: Samādhindriyassa vasena cattārindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.

ps1.5:79.12.verse: Ye hi keci samādhindriyassa vasena arahattaṁ sacchikatā, sabbe te kāyasakkhī.

ps1.5:80.1.verse: Anattato manasikaroto paññindriyaṁ adhimattaṁ hoti, paññindriyassa adhimattattā sotāpattimaggaṁ paṭilabhati;

ps1.5:80.6.verse: Paññindriyassa vasena catunnaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvanā hoti.

ps1.5:80.7.verse: Ye hi keci paññindriyassa vasena sotāpattimaggaṁ paṭilabhanti, sabbe te dhammānusārino.

ps1.5:81.1.verse: Anattato manasikaroto paññindriyaṁ adhimattaṁ hoti, paññindriyassa adhimattattā sotāpattiphalaṁ sacchikataṁ hoti;

ps1.5:81.6.verse: Paññindriyassa vasena cattārindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.

ps1.5:81.7.verse: Ye hi keci paññindriyassa vasena sotāpattiphalaṁ sacchikatā, sabbe te diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:82.1.verse: Anattato manasikaroto paññindriyaṁ adhimattaṁ hoti, paññindriyassa adhimattattā sakadāgāmimaggaṁ paṭilabhati …pe…

ps1.5:82.9.verse: Cattārindriyāni tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti.

ps1.5:82.10.verse: Paññindriyassa vasena cattārindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.

ps1.5:82.11.verse: Ye hi keci paññindriyassa vasena arahattaṁ sacchikatā, sabbe te diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:83.1.verse: Ye hi keci nekkhammaṁ bhāvitā vā bhāventi vā bhāvissanti vā, adhigatā vā adhigacchanti vā adhigamissanti vā, pattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, paṭiladdhā vā paṭilabhanti vā paṭilabhissanti vā, paṭividdhā vā paṭivijjhanti vā paṭivijjhissanti vā, sacchikatā vā sacchikaronti vā sacchikarissanti vā, phassitā vā phassanti vā phassissanti vā, vasippattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, pāramippattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, vesārajjappattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, sabbe te saddhindriyassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, samādhindriyassa vasena kāyasakkhī, paññindriyassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:84.11.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceṁ …

ps1.5:84.12.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousnessṁ …

ps1.5:84.13.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessṁ …

ps1.5:84.14.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionṁ …

ps1.5:85.8.verse: ye hi keci aṭṭha vimokkhe bhāvitā vā bhāventi vā bhāvissanti vā, adhigatā vā adhigacchanti vā adhigamissanti vā, pattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, paṭiladdhā vā paṭilabhanti vā paṭilabhissanti vā, paṭividdhā vā paṭivijjhanti vā paṭivijjhissanti vā, sacchikatā vā sacchikaronti vā sacchikarissanti vā, phassitā vā phassanti vā phassissanti vā, vasippattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā pāramippattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, vesārajjappattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, sabbe te saddhindriyassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, samādhindriyassa vasena kāyasakkhī, paññindriyassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:86.1.verse: Ye hi keci catasso paṭisambhidā pattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā …pe…

ps1.5:86.2.verse: sabbe te saddhindriyassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, samādhindriyassa vasena kāyasakkhī, paññindriyassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:87.1.verse: Ye hi keci tisso vijjā paṭividdhā vā paṭivijjhanti vā paṭivijjhissanti vā …pe…

ps1.5:87.2.verse: sabbe te saddhindriyassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, samādhindriyassa vasena kāyasakkhī, paññindriyassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:88.1.verse: Ye hi keci tisso sikkhā sikkhitā vā sikkhanti vā sikkhissanti vā, sacchikatā vā sacchikaronti vā sacchikarissanti vā, phassitā vā phassanti vā phassissanti vā, vasippattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, pāramippattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, vesārajjappattā vā pāpuṇanti vā pāpuṇissanti vā, sabbe te saddhindriyassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, samādhindriyassa vasena kāyasakkhī, paññindriyassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:89.1.verse: Ye hi keci suffering parijānanti samudayaṁ pajahanti nirodhaṁ sacchikaronti maggaṁ bhāventi, sabbe te saddhindriyassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, samādhindriyassa vasena kāyasakkhī, paññindriyassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:90.5.verse: Dukkhasaccaṁ pariññāpaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati, samudayasaccaṁ pahānappaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati, nirodhasaccaṁ sacchikiriyāpaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati, maggasaccaṁ bhāvanāpaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati.

ps1.5:90.7.verse: Imehi catūhākārehi saccāni paṭivijjhanto saddhindriyassa vasena saddhāvimutto, samādhindriyassa vasena kāyasakkhī, paññindriyassa vasena diṭṭhippatto.

ps1.5:91.3.verse: Navahākārehi saccappaṭivedho hoti, navahākārehi saccāni paṭivijjhati.

ps1.5:91.4.verse: Dukkhasaccaṁ pariññāpaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati, samudayasaccaṁ pahānappaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati, nirodhasaccaṁ sacchikiriyāpaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati, maggasaccaṁ bhāvanāpaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati.

ps1.5:91.5.verse: Abhiññāpaṭivedho ca sabbadhammānaṁ, pariññāpaṭivedho ca sabbasaṅkhārānaṁ, pahānappaṭivedho ca sabbākusalānaṁ, bhāvanāpaṭivedho ca catunnaṁ maggānaṁ, sacchikiriyāpaṭivedho ca nirodhassa.

ps1.5:91.7.verse: Imehi navahākārehi saccāni paṭivijjhanto saddhindriyassa vasena saddhāvimutto, samādhindriyassa vasena kāyasakkhī, paññindriyassa vasena diṭṭhippatto.

ps1.5:93.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto kiṁ bahulaṁ cittaṁ hoti?

ps1.5:93.2.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto kiṁ bahulaṁ cittaṁ hoti?

ps1.5:93.3.verse: Anattato manasikaroto kiṁ bahulaṁ cittaṁ hoti?

ps1.5:94.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaronto adhimokkhabahulo katamaṁ vimokkhaṁ paṭilabhati?

ps1.5:94.2.verse: Dukkhato manasikaronto passaddhibahulo katamaṁ vimokkhaṁ paṭilabhati?

ps1.5:94.3.verse: Anattato manasikaronto vedabahulo katamaṁ vimokkhaṁ paṭilabhati?

ps1.5:94.4.verse: Aniccato manasikaronto adhimokkhabahulo animittaṁ vimokkhaṁ paṭilabhati.

ps1.5:94.5.verse: Dukkhato manasikaronto passaddhibahulo appaṇihitaṁ vimokkhaṁ paṭilabhati.

ps1.5:94.6.verse: Anattato manasikaronto vedabahulo suññataṁ vimokkhaṁ paṭilabhati.

ps1.5:95.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto adhimokkhabahulassa katamo vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, bhāvanāya kati vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, kenaṭṭhena bhāvanā, ko bhāveti?

ps1.5:95.2.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto passaddhibahulassa katamo vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, bhāvanāya kati vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, kenaṭṭhena bhāvanā, ko bhāveti?

ps1.5:95.3.verse: Anattato manasikaroto vedabahulassa katamo vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, bhāvanāya kati vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, kenaṭṭhena bhāvanā, ko bhāveti?

ps1.5:96.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto adhimokkhabahulassa animitto vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti.

ps1.5:96.2.verse: Bhāvanāya dve vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti.

ps1.5:96.6.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto passaddhibahulassa appaṇihito vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti.

ps1.5:96.7.verse: Bhāvanāya dve vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti.

ps1.5:96.11.verse: Anattato manasikaroto vedabahulassa suññato vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti.

ps1.5:96.12.verse: Bhāvanāya dve vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti.

ps1.5:97.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto adhimokkhabahulassa katamo vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, bhāvanāya kati vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, paṭivedhakāle katamo vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, paṭivedhāya kati vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, kenaṭṭhena bhāvanā, kenaṭṭhena paṭivedho?

ps1.5:97.2.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto passaddhibahulassa katamo vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, bhāvanāya kati vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, paṭivedhakāle katamo vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, paṭivedhāya kati vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, kenaṭṭhena bhāvanā, kenaṭṭhena paṭivedho?

ps1.5:97.3.verse: Anattato manasikaroto vedabahulassa katamo vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, bhāvanāya kati vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, paṭivedhakāle katamo vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, paṭivedhāya kativimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, kenaṭṭhena bhāvanā, kenaṭṭhena paṭivedho?

ps1.5:98.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto adhimokkhabahulassa animitto vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, bhāvanāya dve vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, paṭivedhakālepi animitto vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, paṭivedhāya dve vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, dassanaṭṭhena paṭivedho, evaṁ paṭivijjhantopi bhāveti, bhāventopi paṭivijjhati.

ps1.5:98.2.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto passaddhibahulassa appaṇihito vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, bhāvanāya dve vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, paṭivedhakālepi appaṇihito vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, paṭivedhāya dve vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, dassanaṭṭhena paṭivedho, evaṁ paṭivijjhantopi bhāveti, bhāventopi paṭivijjhati.

ps1.5:98.3.verse: Anattato manasikaroto vedabahulassa suññato vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, bhāvanāya dve vimokkhā tadanvayā honti sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, paṭivedhakālepi suññato vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, paṭivedhāya dve vimokkhā tadanvayā honti, sahajātapaccayā honti, aññamaññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, sampayuttapaccayā honti, ekarasā honti, ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, dassanaṭṭhena paṭivedho, evaṁ paṭivijjhantopi bhāveti, bhāventopi paṭivijjhati.

ps1.5:99.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto katamo vimokkho adhimatto hoti?

ps1.5:99.3.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto katamo vimokkho adhimatto hoti?

ps1.5:99.5.verse: Anattato manasikaroto katamo vimokkho adhimatto hoti?

ps1.5:100.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto animitto vimokkho adhimatto hoti.

ps1.5:100.3.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto appaṇihito vimokkho adhimatto hoti.

ps1.5:100.5.verse: Anattato manasikaroto suññato vimokkho adhimatto hoti.

ps1.5:101.9.verse: Jhānaphassaṁ paṭhamaṁ phusati, pacchā nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ sacchikarotīti—

ps1.5:101.11.verse: “Dukkhā saṅkhārā, sukho nirodho”ti viññātaṁ hoti diṭṭhaṁ viditaṁ sacchikataṁ phassitaṁ paññāyāti—

ps1.5:101.13.verse: ye hi keci nekkhammaṁ bhāvitā vā bhāventi vā bhāvissanti vā …pe…

ps1.5:101.14.verse: sabbe te animittavimokkhassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena kāyasakkhī, suññatavimokkhassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:102.4.verse: ye hi keci suffering parijānanti, samudayaṁ pajahanti, nirodhaṁ sacchikaronti, maggaṁ bhāventi, sabbe te animittavimokkhassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena kāyasakkhī, suññatavimokkhassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.

ps1.5:103.5.verse: Dukkhasaccaṁ pariññāpaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati, samudayasaccaṁ pahānapaṭivedhaṁ paṭivijjhati.

ps1.5:103.9.verse: Imehi catūhākārehi saccāni paṭivijjhanto animittavimokkhassa vasena saddhāvimutto, appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena kāyasakkhī, suññatavimokkhassa vasena diṭṭhippatto.

ps1.5:104.8.verse: Imehi navahākārehi saccāni paṭivijjhanto animittavimokkhassa vasena saddhāvimutto, appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena kāyasakkhī, suññatavimokkhassa vasena diṭṭhippatto.

ps1.5:105.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaronto katame dhamme yathābhūtaṁ jānāti passati?

ps1.5:105.3.verse: Kathaṁ tadanvayena sabbe formations aniccato sudiṭṭhā honti?

ps1.5:105.5.verse: Dukkhato manasikaronto katame dhamme yathābhūtaṁ jānāti passati?

ps1.5:105.7.verse: Kathaṁ tadanvayena sabbe formations dukkhato sudiṭṭhā honti?

ps1.5:105.9.verse: Anattato manasikaronto katame dhamme yathābhūtaṁ jānāti passati?

ps1.5:105.11.verse: Kathaṁ tadanvayena sabbe dhammā anattato sudiṭṭhā honti?

ps1.5:106.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaronto nimittaṁ yathābhūtaṁ jānāti passati;

ps1.5:106.4.verse: Evaṁ tadanvayena sabbe formations aniccato sudiṭṭhā honti.

ps1.5:106.6.verse: Dukkhato manasikaronto pavattaṁ yathābhūtaṁ jānāti passati;

ps1.5:106.9.verse: Evaṁ tadanvayena sabbe formations dukkhato sudiṭṭhā honti.

ps1.5:106.11.verse: Anattato manasikaronto nimittañca pavattañca yathābhūtaṁ jānāti passati;

ps1.5:106.14.verse: Evaṁ tadanvayena sabbe dhammā anattato sudiṭṭhā honti.

ps1.5:107.1.verse: Yañca yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ yañca sammādassanaṁ yā ca kaṅkhāvitaraṇā, ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca, udāhu ekatthā, byañjanameva nānanti?

ps1.5:107.2.verse: Yañca yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇaṁ yañca sammādassanaṁ yā ca kaṅkhāvitaraṇā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nānaṁ.

ps1.5:108.6.verse: Anattato manasikaroto nimittañca pavattañca bhayato upaṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:109.1.verse: Yā ca bhayatupaṭṭhāne paññā yañca ādīnave ñāṇaṁ yā ca nibbidā, ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca, udāhu ekatthā, byañjanameva nānanti?

ps1.5:109.2.verse: Yā ca bhayatupaṭṭhāne paññā yañca ādīnave ñāṇaṁ yā ca nibbidā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nānaṁ.

ps1.5:110.1.verse: Yā ca anattānupassanā yā ca suññatānupassanā, ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca, udāhu ekatthā, byañjanameva nānanti?

ps1.5:110.2.verse: Yā ca anattānupassanā yā ca suññatānupassanā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nānaṁ.

ps1.5:111.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto kiṁ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṁ uppajjati?

ps1.5:111.2.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto kiṁ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṁ uppajjati?

ps1.5:111.3.verse: Anattato manasikaroto kiṁ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṁ uppajjati?

ps1.5:111.4.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto nimittaṁ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṁ uppajjati.

ps1.5:111.5.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto pavattaṁ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṁ uppajjati.

ps1.5:111.6.verse: Anattato manasikaroto nimittañca pavattañca paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṁ uppajjati.

ps1.5:112.1.verse: Yā ca muccitukamyatā yā ca paṭisaṅkhānupassanā yā ca saṅkhārupekkhā, ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca, udāhu ekatthā, byañjanameva nānanti?

ps1.5:112.2.verse: Yā ca muccitukamyatā yā ca paṭisaṅkhānupassanā yā ca saṅkhārupekkhā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nānaṁ.

ps1.5:113.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto kuto cittaṁ vuṭṭhāti, kattha cittaṁ pakkhandati?

ps1.5:113.2.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto kuto cittaṁ vuṭṭhāti, kattha cittaṁ pakkhandati?

ps1.5:113.3.verse: Anattato manasikaroto kuto cittaṁ vuṭṭhāti, kattha cittaṁ pakkhandati?

ps1.5:113.4.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto nimittā cittaṁ vuṭṭhāti, animitte cittaṁ pakkhandati.

ps1.5:113.5.verse: Dukkhato manasikaroto pavattā cittaṁ vuṭṭhāti, appavatte cittaṁ pakkhandati.

ps1.5:113.6.verse: Anattato manasikaroto nimittā ca pavattā ca cittaṁ vuṭṭhāti, animitte appavatte nirodhe nibbānadhātuyā cittaṁ pakkhandati.

ps1.5:114.1.verse: Yā ca bahiddhāvuṭṭhānavivaṭṭane paññā ye ca gotrabhū dhammā, ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca, udāhu ekatthā, byañjanameva nānanti?

ps1.5:114.2.verse: Yā ca bahiddhāvuṭṭhānavivaṭṭane paññā ye ca gotrabhū dhammā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nānaṁ.

ps1.5:116.1.verse: Yā ca dubhato vuṭṭhānavivaṭṭane paññā yañca magge ñāṇaṁ, ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca, udāhu ekatthā, byañjanameva nānanti?

ps1.5:116.2.verse: Yā ca dubhato vuṭṭhānavivaṭṭane paññā yañca magge ñāṇaṁ, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nānaṁ.

ps1.5:118.1.verse: Katamehi catūhākārehi tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti?

ps1.5:118.3.verse: Kathaṁ ādhipateyyaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti?

ps1.5:118.4.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto animitto vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, dukkhato manasikaroto appaṇihito vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, anattato manasikaroto suññato vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti.

ps1.5:118.5.verse: Evaṁ ādhipateyyaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti.

ps1.5:119.1.verse: Kathaṁ adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti?

ps1.5:119.2.verse: Aniccato manasikaronto animittavimokkhassa vasena cittaṁ adhiṭṭhāti, dukkhato manasikaronto appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena cittaṁ adhiṭṭhāti, anattato manasikaronto suññatavimokkhassa vasena cittaṁ adhiṭṭhāti.

ps1.5:119.3.verse: Evaṁ adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti.

ps1.5:120.1.verse: Kathaṁ abhinīhāraṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti?

ps1.5:120.2.verse: Aniccato manasikaronto animittavimokkhassa vasena cittaṁ abhinīharati, dukkhato manasikaronto appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena cittaṁ abhinīharati, anattato manasikaronto suññatavimokkhassa vasena cittaṁ abhinīharati.

ps1.5:120.3.verse: Evaṁ abhinīhāraṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti.

ps1.5:121.1.verse: Kathaṁ niyyānaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti?

ps1.5:121.2.verse: Aniccato manasikaronto animittavimokkhassa vasena nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ niyyāti, dukkhato manasikaronto appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ niyyāti, anattato manasikaronto suññatavimokkhassa vasena nirodhaṁ nibbānaṁ niyyāti.

ps1.5:121.3.verse: Evaṁ niyyānaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti.

ps1.5:121.4.verse: Imehi catūhākārehi tayo vimokkhā nānākkhaṇe honti.

ps1.5:122.1.verse: Katamehi sattahākārehi tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti?

ps1.5:122.2.verse: Samodhānaṭṭhena, adhigamanaṭṭhena, paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena, sacchikiriyaṭṭhena, phassanaṭṭhena, abhisamayaṭṭhena.

ps1.5:122.3.verse: Kathaṁ samodhānaṭṭhena adhigamanaṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti?

ps1.5:122.12.verse: Evaṁ samodhānaṭṭhena adhigamanaṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti.

ps1.5:123.7.verse: Yena nimittena animitto, tattha na paṇidahatīti—

ps1.5:123.9.verse: Evaṁ samodhānaṭṭhena adhigamanaṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti.

ps1.5:124.5.verse: Yena nimittena animitto, tattha na paṇidahatīti—

ps1.5:124.9.verse: Evaṁ samodhānaṭṭhena adhigamanaṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti.

ps1.5:124.10.verse: Imehi sattahākārehi tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti.

ps1.5:125.1.verse: Atthi vimokkho, atthi mukhaṁ, atthi vimokkhamukhaṁ, atthi vimokkhapaccanīkaṁ, atthi vimokkhānulomaṁ, atthi vimokkhavivaṭṭo, atthi vimokkhabhāvanā, atthi vimokkhappaṭippassaddhi.

ps1.5:126.2.verse: Suññato vimokkho, animitto vimokkho, appaṇihito vimokkho.

ps1.5:132.2.verse: Ye tattha jātā anavajjakusalā bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, idaṁ mukhaṁ.

ps1.5:133.2.verse: Yaṁ tesaṁ dhammānaṁ ārammaṇaṁ nirodho nibbānaṁ, idaṁ vimokkhamukhaṁ.

ps1.5:134.2.verse: Tīṇi akusalamūlāni vimokkhapaccanīkāni, tīṇi duccaritāni vimokkhapaccanīkāni, sabbepi akusalā dhammā vimokkhapaccanīkā, idaṁ vimokkhapaccanīkaṁ.

ps1.5:135.2.verse: Tīṇi kusalamūlāni vimokkhānulomāni, tīṇi sucaritāni vimokkhānulomāni, sabbepi kusalā dhammā vimokkhānulomā, idaṁ vimokkhānulomaṁ.

ps1.5:136.2.verse: Saññāvivaṭṭo, cetovivaṭṭo, cittavivaṭṭo, ñāṇavivaṭṭo, vimokkhavivaṭṭo, saccavivaṭṭo.

ps1.5:137.1.verse: Yattha saññāvivaṭṭo tattha cetovivaṭṭo, yattha cetovivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo, yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo tattha cittavivaṭṭo, yattha cittavivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo.

ps1.5:137.2.verse: Yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo tattha ñāṇavivaṭṭo, yattha ñāṇavivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo.

ps1.5:137.3.verse: Yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo tattha vimokkhavivaṭṭo, yattha vimokkhavivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo.

ps1.5:137.4.verse: Yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo vimokkhavivaṭṭo tattha saccavivaṭṭo, yattha saccavivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo vimokkhavivaṭṭo.

ps1.5:138.2.verse: Paṭhamassa jhānassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, dutiyassa jhānassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, tatiyassa jhānassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, catutthassa jhānassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceyā āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā …pe…

ps1.5:138.3.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessyā …

ps1.5:138.4.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, sotāpattimaggassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, sakadāgāmimaggassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, anāgāmimaggassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, arahattamaggassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṁ, ayaṁ vimokkhabhāvanā.

ps1.5:139.2.verse: Paṭhamassa jhānassa paṭilābho vā vipāko vā, dutiyassa jhānassa paṭilābho vā vipāko vā, tatiyassa jhānassa …pe…

ps1.5:139.4.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceyā …

ps1.5:139.5.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousnessyā …

ps1.5:139.6.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessyā …

ps1.5:139.7.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā paṭilābho vā vipāko vā, sotāpattimaggassa sotāpattiphalaṁ, sakadāgāmimaggassa sakadāgāmiphalaṁ, anāgāmimaggassa anāgāmiphalaṁ, arahattamaggassa arahattaphalaṁ, ayaṁ vimokkhappaṭippassaddhīti.

ps1.8:8.1.verse: Ime cattāro vipallāsā diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā, appahīnāti.

ps1.8:8.3.verse: Anicce niccanti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso pahīno.

ps1.8:8.4.verse: Dukkhe sukhanti saññā uppajjati, cittaṁ uppajjati, diṭṭhivipallāso pahīno.

ps1.8:8.5.verse: Anattani attāti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso pahīno.

ps1.8:8.6.verse: Asubhe subhanti saññā uppajjati, cittaṁ uppajjati, diṭṭhivipallāso pahīno.

ps1.8:8.8.verse: Dvīsu vatthūsu dve vipallāsā pahīnā, cattāro vipallāsā appahīnā.

ps1.8:8.9.verse: Catūsu vatthūsu aṭṭha vipallāsā pahīnā, cattāro vipallāsā appahīnāti.

ps1.9:1.2.verse: Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi micchādiṭṭhiyā pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, sahajātānaṁ dhammānaṁ upatthambhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, kilesānaṁ pariyādānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, paṭivedhādivisodhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa adhiṭṭhānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa vodānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, visesādhigamāya maggo ceva hetu ca, uttaripaṭivedhāya maggo ceva hetu ca, saccābhisamayāya maggo ceva hetu ca, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpanāya maggo ceva hetu ca.

ps1.9:2.1.verse: Abhiniropanaṭṭhena sammāsaṅkappo micchāsaṅkappassa pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, sahajātānaṁ dhammānaṁ upatthambhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, kilesānaṁ pariyādānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, paṭivedhādivisodhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa adhiṭṭhānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa vodānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, visesādhigamāya maggo ceva hetu ca, uttaripaṭivedhāya maggo ceva hetu ca, saccābhisamayāya maggo ceva hetu ca, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpanāya maggo ceva hetu ca.

ps1.9:3.1.verse: Pariggahaṭṭhena sammāvācā micchāvācāya pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, sahajātānaṁ dhammānaṁ upatthambhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, kilesānaṁ pariyādānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, paṭivedhādivisodhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa adhiṭṭhānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa vodānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, visesādhigamāya maggo ceva hetu ca, uttaripaṭivedhāya maggo ceva hetu ca, saccābhisamayāya maggo ceva hetu ca, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpanāya maggo ceva hetu ca.

ps1.9:4.1.verse: Samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena sammākammanto micchākammantassa pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, sahajātānaṁ dhammānaṁ upatthambhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, kilesānaṁ pariyādānāya maggo ceva hetu ca paṭivedhādivisodhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa adhiṭṭhānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa vodānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, visesādhigamāya maggo ceva hetu ca, uttaripaṭivedhāya maggo ceva hetu ca, saccābhisamayāya maggo ceva hetu ca, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpanāya maggo ceva hetu ca.

ps1.9:5.1.verse: Vodānaṭṭhena sammāājīvo micchāājīvassa pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca …pe…

ps1.9:5.2.verse: paggahaṭṭhena sammāvāyāmo micchāvāyāmassa pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca …pe…

ps1.9:5.3.verse: upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena sammāsati micchāsatiyā pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca …pe…

ps1.9:5.4.verse: avikkhepaṭṭhena sammāsamādhi micchāsamādhissa pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, sahajātānaṁ dhammānaṁ upatthambhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, kilesānaṁ pariyādānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, paṭivedhādivisodhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa adhiṭṭhānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa vodānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, visesādhigamāya maggo ceva hetu ca, uttaripaṭivedhāya maggo ceva hetu ca, saccābhisamayāya maggo ceva hetu ca, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpanāya maggo ceva hetu ca.

ps1.9:6.2.verse: avikkhepaṭṭhena sammāsamādhi oḷārikassa kāmarāgasaññojanassa paṭighasaññojanassa oḷārikassa kāmarāgānusayassa paṭighānusayassa pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, sahajātānaṁ dhammānaṁ upatthambhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, kilesānaṁ pariyādānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, paṭivedhādivisodhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa adhiṭṭhānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa vodānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, visesādhigamāya maggo ceva hetu ca, uttaripaṭivedhāya maggo ceva hetu ca, saccābhisamayāya maggo ceva hetu ca, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpanāya maggo ceva hetu ca.

ps1.9:7.2.verse: avikkhepaṭṭhena sammāsamādhi anusahagatassa kāmarāgasaññojanassa paṭighasaññojanassa, anusahagatassa kāmarāgānusayassa paṭighānusayassa pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, sahajātānaṁ dhammānaṁ upatthambhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, kilesānaṁ pariyādānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, paṭivedhādivisodhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa adhiṭṭhānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa vodānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, visesādhigamāya maggo ceva hetu ca, uttaripaṭivedhāya maggo ceva hetu ca, saccābhisamayāya maggo ceva hetu ca, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpanāya maggo ceva hetu ca.

ps1.9:8.2.verse: avikkhepaṭṭhena sammāsamādhi rūparāgassa arūparāgassa mānassa uddhaccassa avijjāya, mānānusayassa bhavarāgānusayassa avijjānusayassa pahānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, sahajātānaṁ dhammānaṁ upatthambhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, kilesānaṁ pariyādānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, paṭivedhādivisodhanāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa adhiṭṭhānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, cittassa, vodānāya maggo ceva hetu ca, visesādhigamāya maggo ceva hetu ca, uttaripaṭivedhāya maggo ceva hetu ca, saccābhisamayāya maggo ceva, hetu ca, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpanāya maggo ceva hetu ca.

ps1.9:9.1.verse: Dassanamaggo sammādiṭṭhi, abhiniropanamaggo sammāsaṅkappo, pariggahamaggo sammāvācā, samuṭṭhānamaggo sammākammanto, vodānamaggo sammāājīvo, paggahamaggo sammāvāyāmo, upaṭṭhānamaggo sammāsati, avikkhepamaggo sammāsamādhi.

ps1.9:9.2.verse: Upaṭṭhānamaggo satisambojjhaṅgo, pavicayamaggo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo, paggahamaggo vīriyasambojjhaṅgo, pharaṇamaggo pītisambojjhaṅgo, upasamamaggo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, avikkhepamaggo samādhisambojjhaṅgo, paṭisaṅkhānamaggo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.

ps1.9:10.1.verse: Assaddhiye akampiyamaggo saddhābalaṁ, kosajje akampiyamaggo vīriyabalaṁ, pamāde akampiyamaggo satibalaṁ, uddhacce akampiyamaggo samādhibalaṁ, avijjāya akampiyamaggo paññābalaṁ.

ps1.9:10.2.verse: Adhimokkhamaggo saddhindriyaṁ, paggahamaggo vīriyindriyaṁ, upaṭṭhānamaggo satindriyaṁ, avikkhepamaggo samādhindriyaṁ, dassanamaggo paññindriyaṁ.

ps1.9:11.1.verse: Ādhipateyyaṭṭhena indriyā maggo, akampiyaṭṭhena balā maggo, niyyānaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā maggo, hetuṭṭhena maggaṅgā maggo, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satipaṭṭhānā maggo, padahanaṭṭhena sammappadhānā maggo, ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhipādā maggo, tathaṭṭhena saccāni maggo, avikkhepaṭṭhena samatho maggo, anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā maggo, ekarasaṭṭhena samathavipassanā maggo, anativattanaṭṭhena yuganaddhā maggo, saṁvaraṭṭhena sīlavisuddhi maggo, avikkhepaṭṭhena cittavisuddhi maggo, dassanaṭṭhena diṭṭhivisuddhi maggo, muttaṭṭhena vimokkho maggo, paṭivedhaṭṭhena vijjā maggo, pariccāgaṭṭhena vimutti maggo, samucchedaṭṭhena khaye ñāṇaṁ maggo, chando mūlaṭṭhena maggo, manasikāro samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena maggo, contact samodhānaṭṭhena maggo, feeling  samosaraṇaṭṭhena maggo, samādhi pamukhaṭṭhena maggo, sati ādhipateyyaṭṭhena maggo, paññā taduttaraṭṭhena maggo, vimutti sāraṭṭhena maggo, amatogadhaṁ nibbānaṁ pariyosānaṭṭhena maggoti.

ps1.10:2.2.verse: Catunnaṁ ariyasaccānaṁ ācikkhanā desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṁ, catunnaṁ satipaṭṭhānānaṁ …pe…

ps1.10:2.8.verse: ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa ācikkhanā desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṁ—

ps1.10:3.2.verse: Bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā ye vā panaññepi keci viññātāro—

ps1.10:4.3.verse: sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi—

ps1.10:5.2.verse: assaddhiyaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā saddhindriyassa adhimokkhamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:5.5.verse: kosajjaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā vīriyindriyassa paggahamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:5.8.verse: pamādaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā satindriyassa upaṭṭhānamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:5.11.verse: uddhaccaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā samādhindriyassa avikkhepamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:5.14.verse: avijjaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā paññindriyassa dassanamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:6.2.verse: assaddhiyaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā saddhābalassa assaddhiye akampiyamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:6.5.verse: kosajjaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā vīriyabalassa kosajje akampiyamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:6.8.verse: pamādaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā satibalassa pamāde akampiyamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:6.11.verse: uddhaccaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā samādhibalassa uddhacce akampiyamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:6.14.verse: avijjaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā paññābalassa avijjāya akampiyamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:7.2.verse: pamādaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā satisambojjhaṅgassa upaṭṭhānamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:7.5.verse: avijjaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa pavicayamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:7.8.verse: kosajjaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa paggahamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:7.11.verse: pariḷāhaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā pītisambojjhaṅgassa pharaṇamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:7.14.verse: duṭṭhullaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa upasamamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:7.17.verse: uddhaccaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa avikkhepamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:7.20.verse: appaṭisaṅkhaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa paṭisaṅkhānamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:8.2.verse: micchādiṭṭhiṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā sammādiṭṭhiyā dassanamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:8.5.verse: micchāsaṅkappaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā sammāsaṅkappassa abhiniropanamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:8.8.verse: micchāvācaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā sammāvācāya pariggahamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:8.11.verse: micchākammantaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā sammākammantassa samuṭṭhānamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:8.14.verse: micchāājīvaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā sammāājīvassa vodānamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:8.17.verse: micchāvāyāmaṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā sammāvāyāmassa paggahamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:8.20.verse: micchāsatiṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā sammāsatiyā upaṭṭhānamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:8.23.verse: micchāsamādhiṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā sammāsamādhissa avikkhepamaṇḍaṁ pivatīti—

ps1.10:9.1.verse: Atthi maṇḍo, atthi peyyaṁ, atthi kasaṭo.

ps1.10:17.1.verse: Ādhipateyyaṭṭhena indriyā maṇḍo, akampiyaṭṭhena balā maṇḍo, niyyānaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā maṇḍo, hetuṭṭhena maggo maṇḍo, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satipaṭṭhānā maṇḍo, padahanaṭṭhena sammappadhānā maṇḍo, ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhipādā maṇḍo, tathaṭṭhena saccā maṇḍo, avikkhepaṭṭhena samatho maṇḍo, anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā maṇḍo, ekarasaṭṭhena samathavipassanā maṇḍo, anativattanaṭṭhena yuganaddhā maṇḍo, saṁvaraṭṭhena sīlavisuddhi maṇḍo, avikkhepaṭṭhena cittavisuddhi maṇḍo, dassanaṭṭhena diṭṭhivisuddhi maṇḍo, muttaṭṭhena vimokkho maṇḍo, paṭivedhaṭṭhena vijjā maṇḍo, pariccāgaṭṭhena vimutti maṇḍo, samucchedaṭṭhena khaye ñāṇaṁ maṇḍo, paṭippassaddhaṭṭhena anuppāde ñāṇaṁ maṇḍo, chando mūlaṭṭhena maṇḍo, manasikāro samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena maṇḍo, contact samodhānaṭṭhena maṇḍo, feeling  samosaraṇaṭṭhena maṇḍo, samādhi pamukhaṭṭhena maṇḍo, sati ādhipateyyaṭṭhena maṇḍo, paññā taduttaraṭṭhena maṇḍo, vimutti sāraṭṭhena maṇḍo, amatogadhaṁ nibbānaṁ pariyosānaṭṭhena maṇḍoti.

ps1.10:18.5.verse: Esa nikāyadharehi ṭhapito, asamo paṭhamo pavaro varavaggoti.

ps2.1:1.2.verse: ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṁ viharati ghositārāme.

ps2.1:1.3.verse: Tatra kho āyasmā ānando bhikkhū āmantesi—

ps2.1:1.5.verse: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṁ.

ps2.1:2.1.verse: “Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattappattaṁ byākaroti, sabbaso catūhi maggehi etesaṁ vā aññatarena.

ps2.1:3.2.verse: Tassa samathapubbaṅgamaṁ vipassanaṁ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.

ps2.1:3.3.verse: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

ps2.1:3.4.verse: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.

ps2.1:4.1.verse: Puna caparaṁ, āvuso, bhikkhu vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṁ samathaṁ bhāveti.

ps2.1:4.2.verse: Tassa vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṁ samathaṁ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.

ps2.1:4.3.verse: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

ps2.1:4.4.verse: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.

ps2.1:5.1.verse: Puna caparaṁ, āvuso, bhikkhu samathavipassanaṁ yuganaddhaṁ bhāveti.

ps2.1:5.2.verse: Tassa samathavipassanaṁ yuganaddhaṁ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.

ps2.1:5.3.verse: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

ps2.1:5.4.verse: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.

ps2.1:6.1.verse: Puna caparaṁ, āvuso, bhikkhuno dhammuddhaccaviggahitaṁ mānasaṁ hoti;

ps2.1:6.2.verse: hoti so, āvuso, samayo yaṁ taṁ cittaṁ ajjhattameva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati.

ps2.1:6.4.verse: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

ps2.1:6.5.verse: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.

ps2.1:7.1.verse: Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattappattaṁ byākaroti, sabbaso imehi catūhi maggehi, etesaṁ vā aññatarenā”ti.

ps2.1:8.3.verse: Tattha jāte dhamme aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā.

ps2.1:8.8.verse: tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.

ps2.1:9.2.verse: Dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi maggo sañjāyati, abhiniropanaṭṭhena sammāsaṅkappo maggo sañjāyati, pariggahaṭṭhena sammāvācā maggo sañjāyati, samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena sammākammanto maggo sañjāyati, vodānaṭṭhena sammāājīvo maggo sañjāyati, paggahaṭṭhena sammāvāyāmo maggo sañjāyati, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena sammāsati maggo sañjāyati, avikkhepaṭṭhena sammāsamādhi maggo sañjāyati—

ps2.1:10.1.verse: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti āsevatīti kathaṁ āsevati?

ps2.1:10.2.verse: Āvajjanto āsevati, jānanto āsevati, passanto āsevati, paccavekkhanto āsevati, cittaṁ adhiṭṭhahanto āsevati, saddhāya adhimuccanto āsevati, vīriyaṁ paggaṇhanto āsevati, satiṁ upaṭṭhāpento āsevati, cittaṁ samādahanto āsevati, paññāya pajānanto āsevati, abhiññeyyaṁ abhijānanto āsevati, pariññeyyaṁ parijānanto āsevati, pahātabbaṁ pajahanto āsevati, bhāvetabbaṁ bhāvento āsevati, sacchikātabbaṁ sacchikaronto āsevati—

ps2.1:11.2.verse: Āvajjanto bhāveti, jānanto bhāveti, passanto bhāveti, paccavekkhanto bhāveti, cittaṁ adhiṭṭhahanto bhāveti, saddhāya adhimuccanto bhāveti, vīriyaṁ paggaṇhanto bhāveti, satiṁ upaṭṭhāpento bhāveti, cittaṁ samādahanto bhāveti, paññāya pajānanto bhāveti, abhiññeyyaṁ abhijānanto bhāveti, pariññeyyaṁ parijānanto bhāveti, pahātabbaṁ pajahanto bhāveti, bhāvetabbaṁ bhāvento bhāveti, sacchikātabbaṁ sacchikaronto bhāveti—

ps2.1:12.2.verse: Āvajjanto bahulīkaroti, jānanto bahulīkaroti, passanto bahulīkaroti, paccavekkhanto bahulīkaroti, cittaṁ adhiṭṭhahanto bahulīkaroti, saddhāya adhimuccanto bahulīkaroti, vīriyaṁ paggaṇhanto bahulīkaroti, satiṁ upaṭṭhāpento bahulīkaroti, cittaṁ samādahanto bahulīkaroti, paññāya pajānanto bahulīkaroti, abhiññeyyaṁ abhijānanto bahulīkaroti, pariññeyyaṁ parijānanto bahulīkaroti, pahātabbaṁ pajahanto bahulīkaroti, bhāvetabbaṁ bhāvento bahulīkaroti, sacchikātabbaṁ sacchikaronto bahulīkaroti—

ps2.1:13.1.verse: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti anusayā byantīhontīti kathaṁ saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti?

ps2.1:13.14.verse: Arahattamaggena rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṁ, avijjā—

ps2.1:14.3.verse: paṭinissaggānupassī assāsavasena paṭinissaggānupassī passāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi.

ps2.1:14.4.verse: Tattha jāte dhamme aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā.

ps2.1:14.9.verse: tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.

ps2.1:15.2.verse: Dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi maggo sañjāyati, abhiniropanaṭṭhena sammāsaṅkappo maggo sañjāyati …pe…

ps2.1:16.1.verse: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti āsevatīti kathaṁ āsevati?

ps2.1:17.1.verse: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhontīti kathaṁ saññojanā pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti?

ps2.1:17.14.verse: Arahattamaggena rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṁ, avijjā—

ps2.1:18.2.verse: Aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā.

ps2.1:18.3.verse: Tattha jātānaṁ dhammānañca vosaggārammaṇatā cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo.

ps2.1:18.4.verse: Samādhi iti paṭhamaṁ vipassanā, pacchā samatho.

ps2.1:19.1.verse: materiality  aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, materiality  dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, materiality  anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā.

ps2.1:19.2.verse: Tattha jātānaṁ dhammānañca vosaggārammaṇatā cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi.

ps2.1:20.6.verse: aging and death aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, aging and death dukkhato …pe…

ps2.1:20.8.verse: Tattha jātānaṁ dhammānañca vosaggārammaṇatā cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi.

ps2.1:21.3.verse: Ārammaṇaṭṭhena gocaraṭṭhena pahānaṭṭhena pariccāgaṭṭhena vuṭṭhānaṭṭhena vivaṭṭanaṭṭhena santaṭṭhena paṇītaṭṭhena vimuttaṭṭhena anāsavaṭṭhena taraṇaṭṭhena animittaṭṭhena appaṇihitaṭṭhena suññataṭṭhena ekarasaṭṭhena anativattanaṭṭhena yuganaddhaṭṭhena.

ps2.1:22.2.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhārammaṇo, avijjaṁ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhārammaṇā.

ps2.1:22.3.verse: Iti ārammaṇaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:23.2.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjaṁ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:23.3.verse: Iti gocaraṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:24.2.verse: Uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:24.3.verse: Iti pahānaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:25.2.verse: Uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pariccajato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pariccajato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:25.3.verse: Iti pariccāgaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:26.2.verse: Uddhaccasahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:26.3.verse: Iti vuṭṭhānaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:27.2.verse: Uddhaccasahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vivaṭṭato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vivaṭṭato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:27.3.verse: Iti vivaṭṭanaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:28.2.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi santo honti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṁ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā santā hoti nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:28.3.verse: Iti santaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:29.2.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi paṇīto hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṁ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā paṇītā hoti nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:29.3.verse: Iti paṇītaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:30.2.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi kāmāsavā vimutto hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṁ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā avijjāsavā vimuttā hoti nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:30.3.verse: Iti rāgavirāgā cetovimutti avijjāvirāgā paññāvimutti vimuttaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:31.2.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi kāmāsavena anāsavo hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṁ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā avijjāsavena anāsavā hoti nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:31.3.verse: Iti anāsavaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:32.2.verse: Uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca tarato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca tarato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:32.3.verse: Iti taraṇaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:33.2.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi sabbanimittehi animitto hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṁ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā sabbanimittehi animittā hoti nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:33.3.verse: Iti animittaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:34.2.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi sabbapaṇidhīhi appaṇihito hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṁ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā sabbapaṇidhīhi appaṇihitā hoti nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:34.3.verse: Iti appaṇihitaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:35.2.verse: Uddhaccaṁ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi sabbābhinivesehi suñño hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṁ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā sabbābhinivesehi suññā hoti nirodhagocarā.

ps2.1:35.3.verse: Iti suññataṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṁ nātivattantīti.

ps2.1:35.12.verse: Imehi soḷasahi ākārehi samathavipassanaṁ yuganaddhaṁ bhāveti, evaṁ samathavipassanaṁ yuganaddhaṁ bhāveti.

ps2.1:36.2.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto obhāso uppajjati, obhāso dhammoti obhāsaṁ āvajjati, tato vikkhepo uddhaccaṁ.

ps2.1:36.3.verse: Tena uddhaccena viggahitamānaso aniccato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti, dukkhato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti, anattato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.

ps2.1:36.5.verse: “dhammuddhaccaviggahitamānaso hoti so samayo, yaṁ taṁ cittaṁ ajjhattameva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati.

ps2.1:36.6.verse: Tassa maggo sañjāyatī”ti kathaṁ maggo sañjāyati …pe…

ps2.1:36.7.verse: evaṁ maggo sañjāyati, evaṁ saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.

ps2.1:37.1.verse: Aniccato manasikaroto ñāṇaṁ uppajjati, pīti uppajjati, passaddhi uppajjati, sukhaṁ uppajjati, adhimokkho uppajjati, paggaho uppajjati, upaṭṭhānaṁ uppajjati, upekkhā uppajjati, nikanti uppajjati, “nikanti dhammo”ti nikantiṁ āvajjati.

ps2.1:37.3.verse: Tena uddhaccena viggahitamānaso aniccato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti, dukkhato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti, anattato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.

ps2.1:37.5.verse: “dhammuddhaccaviggahitamānaso hoti so samayo, yaṁ taṁ cittaṁ ajjhattameva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati.

ps2.1:37.8.verse: evaṁ maggo sañjāyati, evaṁ saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.

ps2.1:38.2.verse: anattato manasikaroto obhāso uppajjati …pe… ñāṇaṁ uppajjati, pīti uppajjati, passaddhi uppajjati, sukhaṁ uppajjati, adhimokkho uppajjati, paggaho uppajjati, upaṭṭhānaṁ uppajjati, upekkhā uppajjati, nikanti uppajjati, “nikanti dhammo”ti nikantiṁ āvajjati.

ps2.1:38.4.verse: Tena uddhaccena viggahitamānaso anattato upaṭṭhānaṁ, aniccato upaṭṭhānaṁ, dukkhato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.

ps2.1:39.10.verse: aging and death dukkhato manasikaroto, aging and death anattato manasikaroto obhāso uppajjati …pe… ñāṇaṁ uppajjati, pīti uppajjati, passaddhi uppajjati, sukhaṁ uppajjati, adhimokkho uppajjati, paggaho uppajjati, upaṭṭhānaṁ uppajjati, upekkhā uppajjati, nikanti uppajjati, “nikanti dhammo”ti nikantiṁ āvajjati.

ps2.1:39.13.verse: aging and death anattato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.

ps2.1:39.14.verse: aging and death aniccato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti, aging and death dukkhato upaṭṭhānaṁ yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.

ps2.1:39.17.verse: So samayo, yaṁ taṁ cittaṁ ajjhattameva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati.

ps2.1:44.3.verse: Na ca vikkhipate cittaṁ na kilissati,

ps2.1:45.1.verse: Imehi catūhi ṭhānehi cittassa saṅkhepavikkhepaviggahitaṁ dasa ṭhāne sampajānātīti.

ps2.2:1.5.verse: ‘ayaṁ dukkhasamudayo’ti tathametaṁ avitathametaṁ anaññathametaṁ, ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodho’ti tathametaṁ avitathametaṁ anaññathametaṁ, ‘ayaṁ the way leading to the cessation of suffering paṭipadā’ti tathametaṁ avitathametaṁ anaññathametaṁ.

ps2.2:1.6.verse: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni”.

ps2.2:2.2.verse: Cattāro dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.

ps2.2:2.4.verse: ime cattāro dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.

ps2.2:3.2.verse: Cattāro samudayassa samudayaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.

ps2.2:3.4.verse: ime cattāro samudayassa samudayaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.

ps2.2:4.2.verse: Cattāro nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.

ps2.2:4.4.verse: ime cattāro nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.

ps2.2:5.2.verse: Cattāro maggassa maggaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.

ps2.2:5.4.verse: ime cattāro maggassa maggaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.

ps2.2:7.3.verse: Dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho tathaṭṭho—

ps2.2:7.4.verse: imehi catūhākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.

ps2.2:8.3.verse: Dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho anattaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho anattaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho anattaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho anattaṭṭho—

ps2.2:8.4.verse: imehi catūhākārehi anattaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.

ps2.2:9.3.verse: Dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho saccaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho saccaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho saccaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho saccaṭṭho—

ps2.2:9.4.verse: imehi catūhākārehi saccaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.

ps2.2:10.3.verse: Dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho—

ps2.2:10.4.verse: imehi catūhākārehi paṭivedhaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni yaṁ ekasaṅgahitaṁ taṁ ekattaṁ.

ps2.2:11.2.verse: Yaṁ aniccaṁ taṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ suffering taṁ aniccaṁ, yaṁ aniccañca dukkhañca taṁ anattā.

ps2.2:11.3.verse: Yaṁ aniccañca dukkhañca anattā ca taṁ tathaṁ.

ps2.2:11.4.verse: Yaṁ aniccaṁ ca dukkhañca anattā ca tathañca taṁ saccaṁ.

ps2.2:11.5.verse: Yaṁ aniccañca dukkhañca anattā ca tathañca saccañca taṁ ekasaṅgahitaṁ.

ps2.2:12.3.verse: Tathaṭṭhena, anattaṭṭhena, saccaṭṭhena, paṭivedhaṭṭhena, abhiññaṭṭhena, pariññaṭṭhena, pahānaṭṭhena, bhāvanaṭṭhena, sacchikiriyaṭṭhena—

ps2.2:13.3.verse: Dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, pariññāya pariññaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, pahānassa pahānaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, bhāvanāya bhāvanaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭho tathaṭṭho—

ps2.2:13.4.verse: imehi navahākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.

ps2.2:14.5.verse: Dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, pariññāya pariññaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, pahānassa pahānaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, bhāvanāya bhāvanaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho—

ps2.2:14.6.verse: imehi navahākārehi paṭivedhaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.

ps2.2:15.3.verse: Tathaṭṭhena, anattaṭṭhena, saccaṭṭhena, paṭivedhaṭṭhena, abhijānanaṭṭhena, parijānanaṭṭhena, dhammaṭṭhena, tathaṭṭhena, ñātaṭṭhena, sacchikiriyaṭṭhena, phassanaṭṭhena, abhisamayaṭṭhena—

ps2.2:15.4.verse: imehi dvādasahi ākārehi cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.

ps2.2:16.3.verse: Dukkhassa pīḷanaṭṭho, saṅkhataṭṭho, santāpaṭṭho, vipariṇāmaṭṭho, tathaṭṭho;

ps2.2:16.4.verse: samudayassa āyūhanaṭṭho, nidānaṭṭho, saṁyogaṭṭho, palibodhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho;

ps2.2:16.5.verse: nirodhassa nissaraṇaṭṭho, vivekaṭṭho, asaṅkhataṭṭho, amataṭṭho tathaṭṭho;

ps2.2:16.6.verse: maggassa niyyānaṭṭho, hetuṭṭho, dassanaṭṭho, ādhipateyyaṭṭho tathaṭṭho—

ps2.2:16.7.verse: imehi soḷasahi ākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.

ps2.2:17.12.verse: Soḷasahi ākārehi abhisamayaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekappaṭivedhāni.

ps2.2:17.13.verse: Dukkhassa pīḷanaṭṭho, saṅkhataṭṭho, santāpaṭṭho, vipariṇāmaṭṭho, abhisamayaṭṭho;

ps2.2:17.14.verse: samudayassa āyūhanaṭṭho, nidānaṭṭho, saṁyogaṭṭho, palibodhaṭṭho, abhisamayaṭṭho;

ps2.2:17.15.verse: nirodhassa nissaraṇaṭṭho, vivekaṭṭho, asaṅkhataṭṭho, amataṭṭho, abhisamayaṭṭho;

ps2.2:17.16.verse: maggassa niyyānaṭṭho, hetuṭṭho, dassanaṭṭho, ādhipateyyaṭṭho, abhisamayaṭṭho—

ps2.2:17.17.verse: imehi soḷasahi ākārehi abhisamayaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.

ps2.2:19.3.verse: Saṅkhatānaṁ saccānaṁ uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitānaṁ aññathattaṁ paññāyati asaṅkhatassa saccassa na uppādo paññāyati, na vayo paññāyati, na ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati—

ps2.2:20.3.verse: Dukkhasaccassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati;

ps2.2:20.4.verse: samudayasaccassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati;

ps2.2:20.5.verse: maggasaccassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati;

ps2.2:20.6.verse: nirodhasaccassa na uppādo paññāyati, na vayo paññāyati, na ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati—

ps2.2:21.1.verse: Catunnaṁ saccānaṁ kati kusalā, kati akusalā, kati abyākatā?

ps2.2:21.2.verse: Samudayasaccaṁ akusalaṁ, maggasaccaṁ kusalaṁ, nirodhasaccaṁ abyākataṁ.

ps2.2:21.3.verse: Dukkhasaccaṁ siyā kusalaṁ, siyā akusalaṁ, siyā abyākataṁ.

ps2.2:22.1.verse: Siyā tīṇi saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṁ tīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṁ?

ps2.2:22.5.verse: evaṁ akusalaṭṭhena dve saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṁ dvīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṁ.

ps2.2:22.7.verse: evaṁ kusalaṭṭhena dve saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṁ dvīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṁ.

ps2.2:22.9.verse: evaṁ abyākataṭṭhena dve saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṁ dvīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṁ.

ps2.2:22.10.verse: Evaṁ siyā tīṇi saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṁ tīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṁ vatthuvasena pariyāyenāti.

ps2.2:23.1.verse: “Pubbe me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi—

ps2.2:23.2.verse: ‘ko nu kho rūpassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ;

ps2.2:23.3.verse: ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ;

ps2.2:23.4.verse: ko saññāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ;

ps2.2:23.5.verse: ko saṅkhārānaṁ assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇaṁ;

ps2.2:23.6.verse: ko viññāṇassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇan’ti?

ps2.2:23.8.verse: ‘yaṁ kho materiality  paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ—

ps2.2:23.10.verse: Yaṁ materiality  aniccaṁ, taṁ suffering vipariṇāmadhammaṁ—

ps2.2:23.17.verse: yaṁ viññāṇaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ—

ps2.2:23.19.verse: Yaṁ viññāṇaṁ aniccaṁ taṁ suffering vipariṇāmadhammaṁ—

ps2.2:24.1.verse: Yāvakīvañcāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ pañcannaṁ upādānakkhandhānaṁ evaṁ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṁ nābbhaññāsiṁ, neva tāvāhaṁ, bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya ‘anuttaraṁ sammāsambodhiṁ abhisambuddho’ti paccaññāsiṁ yato ca khvāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ pañcannaṁ upādānakkhandhānaṁ evaṁ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṁ abbhaññāsiṁ, athāhaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṁ sammāsambodhiṁ abhisambuddho’ti paccaññāsiṁ.

ps2.2:25.1.verse: Yaṁ materiality  paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, ayaṁ rūpassa assādoti—

ps2.2:25.3.verse: Yaṁ materiality  aniccaṁ taṁ suffering vipariṇāmadhammaṁ, ayaṁ rūpassa ādīnavoti—

ps2.2:25.5.verse: Yo rūpasmiṁ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṁ, idaṁ rūpassa nissaraṇanti—

ps2.2:25.7.verse: Yā imesu tīsu ṭhānesu diṭṭhi saṅkappo vācā kammanto ājīvo vāyāmo sati samādhi—

ps2.2:26.4.verse: yaṁ viññāṇaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, ayaṁ viññāṇassa assādoti—

ps2.2:26.6.verse: Yaṁ viññāṇaṁ aniccaṁ taṁ suffering vipariṇāmadhammaṁ, ayaṁ viññāṇassa ādīnavoti—

ps2.2:26.8.verse: Yo viññāṇasmiṁ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṁ, idaṁ viññāṇassa nissaraṇanti—

ps2.2:26.10.verse: Yā imesu tīsu ṭhānesu diṭṭhi saṅkappo vācā kammanto ājīvo vāyāmo sati samādhi—

ps2.2:27.4.verse: aging and death kiṁnidānaṁ, kiṁsamudayaṁ, kiṁjātikaṁ, kiṁpabhavanti—

ps2.2:27.6.verse: aging and death jātinidānaṁ, jātisamudayaṁ, jātijātikaṁ, jātippabhavanti—

ps2.2:27.8.verse: Jarāmaraṇañca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇasamudayañca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇanirodhañca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:28.5.verse: Jātiñca pajānāti, jātisamudayañca pajānāti, jātinirodhañca pajānāti, jātinirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:29.5.verse: Bhavaṁ ca pajānāti, bhavasamudayañca pajānāti, bhavanirodhañca pajānāti, bhavanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:30.5.verse: Upādānañca pajānāti, upādānasamudayañca pajānāti, upādānanirodhañca pajānāti upādānanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:31.5.verse: Taṇhañca pajānāti, taṇhāsamudayañca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhañca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:32.5.verse: Vedanañca pajānāti, vedanāsamudayañca pajānāti, vedanānirodhañca pajānāti, vedanānirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:33.5.verse: Phassañca pajānāti, phassasamudayañca pajānāti, phassanirodhañca pajānāti, phassanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:34.1.verse: the six-fold base kiṁnidānaṁ, kiṁsamudayaṁ, kiṁjātikaṁ, kiṁpabhavanti—

ps2.2:34.3.verse: the six-fold base nāmarūpanidānaṁ, nāmarūpasamudayaṁ, nāmarūpajātikaṁ, nāmarūpappabhavanti—

ps2.2:34.5.verse: Saḷāyatanañca pajānāti, saḷāyatanasamudayañca pajānāti, saḷāyatananirodhañca pajānāti, saḷāyatananirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:35.5.verse: Nāmarūpañca pajānāti, nāmarūpasamudayañca pajānāti, nāmarūpanirodhañca pajānāti, nāmarūpanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:36.5.verse: Viññāṇañca pajānāti, viññāṇasamudayañca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhañca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:37.5.verse: Saṅkhāre ca pajānāti, saṅkhārasamudayañca pajānāti, saṅkhāranirodhañca pajānāti, saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadañca pajānāti—

ps2.2:38.1.verse: aging and death dukkhasaccaṁ, birth samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.2.verse: birth dukkhasaccaṁ, being  samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.3.verse: being  dukkhasaccaṁ, clinging samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.4.verse: clinging dukkhasaccaṁ, craving samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.5.verse: craving dukkhasaccaṁ, feeling  samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.6.verse: feeling  dukkhasaccaṁ, contact samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.7.verse: contact dukkhasaccaṁ, the six-fold base samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.8.verse: the six-fold base dukkhasaccaṁ, mentality-materiality samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.9.verse: mentality-materiality dukkhasaccaṁ, viññāṇaṁ samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.10.verse: Viññāṇaṁ dukkhasaccaṁ, formations samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:38.11.verse: formations dukkhasaccaṁ, Ignorance samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:39.1.verse: aging and death siyā dukkhasaccaṁ, siyā samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccaṁ.

ps2.2:39.3.verse: being  siyā dukkhasaccaṁ, siyā samudayasaccaṁ, ubhinnampi nissaraṇaṁ nirodhasaccaṁ, nirodhappajānanā maggasaccanti.

ps2.3:1.4.verse: Satisambojjhaṅgo, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo, vīriyasambojjhaṅgo, pītisambojjhaṅgo, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, samādhisambojjhaṅgo, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo—

ps2.3:3.1.verse: Bujjhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anubujjhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paṭibujjhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, sambujjhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:5.1.verse: Bodhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anubodhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paṭibodhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, sambodhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:6.1.verse: Bodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anubodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, sambodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:7.1.verse: Buddhilabhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhipaṭilabhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhiropanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhiabhiropanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhipāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhisampāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:8.1.verse: Mūlaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, mūlacariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, mūlapariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, mūlaparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, mūlaparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, mūlaparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, mūlapaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, mūlapaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, mūlapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, mūlapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:9.1.verse: Hetuṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, hetucariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, hetupariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, hetuparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, hetuparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, hetuparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, hetupaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, hetupaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, hetupaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, hetupaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:10.1.verse: Paccayaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paccayacariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paccayapariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paccayaparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paccayaparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paccayaparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paccayapaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paccayapaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paccayapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paccayapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:11.1.verse: Visuddhaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, visuddhicariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, visuddhipariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, visuddhiparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, visuddhiparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, visuddhiparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, visuddhipaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, visuddhipaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, visuddhipaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, visuddhipaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:12.1.verse: Anavajjaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anavajjacariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anavajjapariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anavajjaparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anavajjaparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anavajjaparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anavajjapaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anavajjapaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anavajjapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anavajjapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:13.1.verse: Nekkhammaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, nekkhammacariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, nekkhammapariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, nekkhammaparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, nekkhammaparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, nekkhammaparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, nekkhammapaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, nekkhammapaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, nekkhammapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, nekkhammapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:14.1.verse: Vimuttaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vimutticariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vimuttipariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vimuttiparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vimuttiparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vimuttiparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vimuttipaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vimuttipaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vimuttipaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vimuttipaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:15.1.verse: Anāsavaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anāsavacariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anāsavapariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anāsavaparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anāsavaparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anāsavaparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anāsavapaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anāsavapaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anāsavapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anāsavapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:16.1.verse: Vivekaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vivekacariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vivekapariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vivekaparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vivekaparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vivekaparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vivekapaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vivekapaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vivekapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vivekapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:17.1.verse: Vosaggaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vosaggacariyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vosaggapariggahaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vosaggaparivāraṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vosaggaparipūraṇaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vosaggaparipākaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vosaggapaṭisambhidaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vosaggapaṭisambhidāpāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vosaggapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, vosaggapaṭisambhidāya vasībhāvappattānampi bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:33.7.verse: Samudayassa āyūhanaṭṭhaṁ … nidānaṭṭhaṁ … saññogaṭṭhaṁ … palibodhaṭṭhaṁ bujjhantīti—bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:33.9.verse: Nirodhassa nissaraṇaṭṭhaṁ … vivekaṭṭhaṁ … asaṅkhataṭṭhaṁ … amataṭṭhaṁ bujjhantīti—bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:33.11.verse: Maggassa niyyānaṭṭhaṁ … hetuṭṭhaṁ … dassanaṭṭhaṁ … ādhipateyyaṭṭhaṁ bujjhantīti—bojjhaṅgā.

ps2.3:39.2.verse: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi—

ps2.3:39.4.verse: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṁ.

ps2.3:42.1.verse: Kathaṁ satisambojjhaṅgo iti ce me hotīti bojjhaṅgo?

ps2.3:43.2.verse: Pamāṇabaddhā kilesā, sabbe ca pariyuṭṭhānā, ye ca formations ponobhavikā appamāṇo nirodho acalaṭṭhena asaṅkhataṭṭhena.

ps2.3:44.3.verse: Yāvatā nirodhūpaṭṭhāti tāvatā susamāraddho iti ce me hotīti bojjhaṅgo.

ps2.4:1.2.verse: “Mettāya, bhikkhave, cetovimuttiyā āsevitāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya ekādasānisaṁsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
