ps3.1:12.1.verse: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya saṁvattanti.

ps3.1:12.4.verse: ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya saṁvattanti.

ps3.1:13.1.verse: Cattārome, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya saṁvattanti …pe…

ps3.1:13.6.verse: ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā arahattamaggaphalasacchikiriyāya saṁvattanti.

ps3.1:14.1.verse: Cattārome, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā paññāpaṭilābhāya saṁvattanti …pe…

ps3.1:14.2.verse: paññābuddhiyā saṁvattanti, paññāvepullāya saṁvattanti, mahāpaññatāya saṁvattanti, puthupaññatāya saṁvattanti, vipulapaññatāya saṁvattanti, gambhīrapaññatāya saṁvattanti, asāmantapaññatāya saṁvattanti, bhūripaññatāya saṁvattanti, paññābāhullāya saṁvattanti, sīghapaññatāya saṁvattanti, lahupaññatāya saṁvattanti, hāsapaññatāya saṁvattanti, javanapaññatāya saṁvattanti, tikkhapaññatāya saṁvattanti, nibbedhikapaññatāya saṁvattanti.

ps3.1:14.5.verse: ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā paññāpaṭilābhāya saṁvattanti, paññābuddhiyā saṁvattanti …pe…

ps3.1:15.2.verse: Catunnaṁ maggañāṇānaṁ, catunnaṁ phalañāṇānaṁ, catunnaṁ paṭisambhidāñāṇānaṁ, channaṁ abhiññāñāṇānaṁ, tesattatīnaṁ ñāṇānaṁ, sattasattatīnaṁ ñāṇānaṁ lābho paṭilābho patti sampatti phassanā sacchikiriyā upasampadā.

ps3.1:16.2.verse: Sattannañca sekkhānaṁ puthujjanakalyāṇakassa ca paññā vaḍḍhati, arahato paññā vaḍḍhati.

ps3.1:17.2.verse: Sattannaṁ sekkhānaṁ puthujjanakalyāṇakassa ca paññāvepullaṁ gacchati.

ps3.1:19.28.verse: Puthujjanasādhāraṇe dhamme atikkamma paramatthe nibbāne ñāṇaṁ pavattatīti—puthupaññā.

ps3.1:22.2.verse: Yassa puggalassa atthavavatthānato atthapaṭisambhidā adhigatā hoti sacchikatā phassitā paññāya, dhammavavatthānato dhammapaṭisambhidā adhigatā hoti sacchikatā phassitā paññāya, niruttivavatthānato niruttipaṭisambhidā adhigatā hoti sacchikatā phassitā paññāya, paṭibhānavavatthānato paṭibhānapaṭisambhidā adhigatā hoti sacchikatā phassitā paññāya, tassa atthe ca dhamme ca niruttiyā ca paṭibhāne ca na añño koci sakkoti abhisambhavituṁ.

ps3.1:23.1.verse: Puthujjanakalyāṇakassa paññā aṭṭhamakassa paññāya dūre vidūre suvidūre na santike na sāmantā.

ps3.1:23.3.verse: Aṭṭhamakassa paññā sotāpannassa paññāya dūre vidūre suvidūre na santike na sāmantā.

ps3.1:23.5.verse: Sotāpannassa paññā sakadāgāmissa paññāya dūre vidūre suvidūre na santike na sāmantā.

ps3.1:23.7.verse: Sakadāgāmissa paññā anāgāmissa paññāya dūre vidūre suvidūre na santike na sāmantā.

ps3.1:23.9.verse: Anāgāmissa paññā arahato paññāya dūre vidūre suvidūre na santike na sāmantā.

ps3.1:23.11.verse: Arahato paññā paccekasambuddhassa paññāya dūre vidūre suvidūre na santike na sāmantā.

ps3.1:23.13.verse: Paccekabuddhañca sadevakañca lokaṁ upādāya tathāgato arahaṁ sammāsambuddho aggo asāmantapañño.

ps3.1:24.1.verse: Paññāpabhedakusalo pabhinnañāṇo adhigatappaṭisambhido catuvesārajjappatto dasabaladhārī purisāsabho purisasīho purisanāgo purisājañño purisadhorayho anantañāṇo anantatejo anantayaso aḍḍho mahaddhano dhanavā netā vinetā anunetā paññāpetā nijjhāpetā pekkhetā pasādetā.

ps3.1:24.2.verse: “So hi bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido maggānugāmī ca panassa etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatā”.

ps3.1:25.1.verse: “So hi bhagavā jānaṁ jānāti, passaṁ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato.

ps3.1:25.2.verse: Natthi tassa bhagavato aññātaṁ adiṭṭhaṁ aviditaṁ asacchikataṁ aphassitaṁ paññāya.

ps3.1:25.3.verse: Atītaṁ anāgataṁ paccuppannaṁ upādāya sabbe dhammā sabbākārena buddhassa bhagavato ñāṇamukhe āpāthaṁ āgacchanti.

ps3.1:25.4.verse: Yaṁ kiñci neyyaṁ nāma atthi taṁ sabbaṁ jānitabbaṁ.

ps3.1:25.5.verse: Attattho vā parattho vā ubhayattho vā diṭṭhadhammiko vā attho samparāyiko vā attho uttāno vā attho gambhīro vā attho gūḷho vā attho paṭicchanno vā attho neyyo vā attho nīto vā attho anavajjo vā attho nikkileso vā attho vodāno vā attho paramattho vā attho, sabbaṁ taṁ antobuddhañāṇe parivattati.

ps3.1:26.7.verse: Yāvatakaṁ neyyaṁ tāvatakaṁ ñāṇaṁ, yāvatakaṁ ñāṇaṁ tāvatakaṁ neyyaṁ.

ps3.1:26.12.verse: Yathā dvinnaṁ samuggapaṭalānaṁ sammā phusitānaṁ heṭṭhimaṁ samuggapaṭalaṁ uparimaṁ nātivattati, uparimaṁ samuggapaṭalaṁ heṭṭhimaṁ nātivattati, aññamaññapariyantaṭṭhāyino;

ps3.1:26.13.verse: evameva buddhassa bhagavato neyyañca ñāṇañca aññamaññapariyantaṭṭhāyino.

ps3.1:26.14.verse: Yāvatakaṁ neyyaṁ tāvatakaṁ ñāṇaṁ, yāvatakaṁ ñāṇaṁ tāvatakaṁ neyyaṁ.

ps3.1:27.1.verse: Sabbe dhammā buddhassa bhagavato āvajjanappaṭibaddhā ākaṅkhappaṭibaddhā manasikārappaṭibaddhā cittuppādappaṭibaddhā.

ps3.1:27.3.verse: Sabbesaṁ sattānaṁ buddho āsayaṁ jānāti, anusayaṁ jānāti, caritaṁ jānāti, adhimuttiṁ jānāti.

ps3.1:27.4.verse: Apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye bhabbābhabbe satte pajānāti.

ps3.1:27.5.verse: Sadevako loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā antobuddhañāṇe parivattati.

ps3.1:28.1.verse: Yathā ye keci macchakacchapā, antamaso timitimiṅgalaṁ upādāya, antomahāsamudde parivattanti, evamevaṁ sadevako loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā antobuddhañāṇe parivattati.

ps3.1:28.2.verse: Yathā ye keci pakkhino, antamaso garuḷaṁ venateyyaṁ upādāya, ākāsassa padese parivattanti;

ps3.1:28.3.verse: evameva yepi te sāriputtasamā paññāya tepi buddhañāṇassa padese parivattanti.

ps3.1:28.4.verse: Buddhañāṇaṁ devamanussānaṁ paññaṁ pharitvā atighaṁsitvā tiṭṭhati.

ps3.1:29.1.verse: Yepi te khattiyapaṇḍitā brāhmaṇapaṇḍitā gahapatipaṇḍitā samaṇapaṇḍitā nipuṇā kataparappavādā vālavedhirūpā vobhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni, te pañhaṁ abhisaṅkharitvā abhisaṅkharitvā tathāgataṁ upasaṅkamitvā pucchanti gūḷhāni ca paṭicchannāni ca.

ps3.1:29.2.verse: Kathitā visajjitā ca te pañhā bhagavatā honti niddiṭṭhakāraṇā.

ps3.1:29.4.verse: Atha kho bhagavā tattha atirocati yadidaṁ paññāyā”ti.

ps3.1:30.47.verse: sabbe bhavagāmikammā ari taṁ ariṁ maddanipaññāti—bhūripaññā.

ps3.1:30.49.verse: Tāya pathavisamāya vitthatāya vipulāya paññāya samannāgatoti—bhūripaññā.

ps3.1:31.2.verse: Idhekacco paññāgaruko hoti paññācarito paññāsayo paññādhimutto paññādhajo paññāketu paññādhipateyyo vicayabahulo pavicayabahulo okkhāyanabahulo samokkhāyanabahulo sampekkhāyanadhammo vibhūtavihārī taccarito taggaruko tabbahulo tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo.

ps3.1:31.3.verse: Yathā gaṇagaruko vuccati “gaṇabāhuliko”ti, cīvaragaruko vuccati “cīvarabāhuliko”ti, pattagaruko vuccati “pattabāhuliko”ti, senāsanagaruko vuccati “senāsanabāhuliko”ti;

ps3.1:31.4.verse: evamevaṁ idhekacco paññāgaruko hoti paññācarito paññāsayo paññādhimutto paññādhajo paññāketu paññādhipateyyo vicayabahulo pavicayabahulo okkhāyanabahulo samokkhāyanabahulo sampekkhāyanadhammo vibhūtavihārī taccarito taggaruko tabbahulo tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo.

ps3.1:34.2.verse: Idhekacco hāsabahulo vedabahulo tuṭṭhibahulo pāmojjabahulo sīlāni paripūretīti—hāsapaññā.

ps3.1:34.3.verse: Hāsabahulo vedabahulo tuṭṭhibahulo pāmojjabahulo indriyasaṁvaraṁ paripūretīti—hāsapaññā.

ps3.1:34.4.verse: Hāsabahulo vedabahulo tuṭṭhibahulo pāmojjabahulo bhojane mattaññutaṁ paripūretīti—hāsapaññā.

ps3.1:34.5.verse: Hāsabahulo vedabahulo tuṭṭhibahulo pāmojjabahulo jāgariyānuyogaṁ paripūretīti—hāsapaññā.

ps3.1:34.22.verse: Hāsabahulo vedabahulo tuṭṭhibahulo pāmojjabahulo abhiññāyo paṭivijjhatīti—hāsapaññā.

ps3.1:34.23.verse: Hāsabahulo vedabahulo tuṭṭhibahulo pāmojjabahulo paramatthaṁ nibbānaṁ sacchikarotīti—hāsapaññā.

ps3.1:35.2.verse: Yaṁ kiñci materiality  atītānāgatapaccuppannaṁ ajjhattaṁ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṁ vā sukhumaṁ vā hīnaṁ vā paṇītaṁ vā yaṁ dūre santike vā, sabbaṁ materiality  aniccato khippaṁ javatīti—javanapaññā.

ps3.1:35.8.verse: yaṁ kiñci viññāṇaṁ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṁ ajjhattaṁ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṁ vā sukhumaṁ vā hīnaṁ vā paṇītaṁ vā yaṁ dūre santike vā, sabbaṁ viññāṇaṁ aniccato khippaṁ javatīti—javanapaññā.

ps3.1:35.12.verse: aging and death atītānāgatapaccuppannaṁ aniccato khippaṁ javatīti—javanapaññā.

ps3.1:36.1.verse: materiality  atītānāgatapaccuppannaṁ aniccaṁ khayaṭṭhena suffering bhayaṭṭhena anattā asārakaṭṭhenāti tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṁ katvā rūpanirodhe nibbāne khippaṁ javatīti—javanapaññā.

ps3.1:36.7.verse: aging and death atītānāgatapaccuppannaṁ aniccaṁ khayaṭṭhena suffering bhayaṭṭhena anattā asārakaṭṭhenāti tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṁ katvā jarāmaraṇanirodhe nibbāne khippaṁ javatīti—javanapaññā.

ps3.1:37.1.verse: materiality  atītānāgatapaccuppannaṁ aniccaṁ saṅkhataṁ paṭiccasamuppannaṁ khayadhammaṁ vayadhammaṁ virāgadhammaṁ nirodhadhammanti tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṁ katvā rūpanirodhe nibbāne khippaṁ javatīti—javanapaññā.

ps3.1:37.7.verse: aging and death atītānāgatapaccuppannaṁ aniccaṁ saṅkhataṁ paṭiccasamuppannaṁ khayadhammaṁ vayadhammaṁ virāgadhammaṁ nirodhadhammanti tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṁ katvā jarāmaraṇanirodhe nibbāne khippaṁ javatīti—javanapaññā.

ps3.1:38.3.verse: Uppannaṁ kāmavitakkaṁ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṁ gametīti—tikkhapaññā.

ps3.1:38.4.verse: Uppannaṁ byāpādavitakkaṁ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṁ gametīti—tikkhapaññā.

ps3.1:38.6.verse: uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṁ gametīti—tikkhapaññā.

ps3.1:38.7.verse: Uppannaṁ rāgaṁ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṁ gametīti—tikkhapaññā.

ps3.1:38.27.verse: sabbe bhavagāmikamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṁ gametīti—tikkhapaññā.

ps3.1:38.28.verse: Ekasmiṁ āsane cattāro ca ariyamaggā cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni catasso paṭisambhidāyo cha abhiññāyo adhigatā honti sacchikatā phassitā paññāyāti—tikkhapaññā.

ps3.1:39.2.verse: Idhekacco sabbasaṅkhāresu ubbegabahulo hoti uttāsabahulo ukkaṇṭhanabahulo aratibahulo anabhiratibahulo.

ps3.1:40.2.verse: Imāhi soḷasahi paññāhi samannāgato puggalo paṭisambhidappatto.

ps3.1:41.3.verse: Yo pubbayogasampanno so tena atireko hoti, adhiko hoti, viseso hoti.

ps3.1:42.3.verse: Yo bahussuto, so tena atireko hoti, adhiko hoti, viseso hoti.

ps3.1:43.1.verse: Dve puggalā paṭisambhidappattā, dvepi pubbayogasampannā, dvepi bahussutā—

ps3.1:43.3.verse: Yo desanābahulo, so tena atireko hoti, adhiko hoti, viseso hoti.

ps3.1:44.1.verse: Dve puggalā paṭisambhidappattā, dvepi pubbayogasampannā, dvepi bahussutā, dvepi desanābahulā—

ps3.1:44.3.verse: Yo garūpanissito, so tena atireko hoti, adhiko hoti, viseso hoti.

ps3.1:45.1.verse: Dve puggalā paṭisambhidappattā, dvepi pubbayogasampannā, dvepi bahussutā, dvepi desanābahulā, dvepi garūpanissitā—

ps3.1:45.3.verse: Yo vihārabahulo, so tena atireko hoti, adhiko hoti, viseso hoti.

ps3.1:46.1.verse: Dve puggalā paṭisambhidappattā, dvepi pubbayogasampannā, dvepi bahussutā, dvepi desanābahulā, dvepi garūpanissitā, dvepi vihārabahulā—

ps3.1:46.3.verse: Yo paccavekkhaṇābahulo, so tena atireko hoti, adhiko hoti, viseso hoti.

ps3.1:47.1.verse: Dve puggalā paṭisambhidappattā, dvepi pubbayogasampannā, dvepi bahussutā, dvepi desanābahulā, dvepi garūpanissitā, dvepi vihārabahulā, dvepi paccavekkhaṇābahulā—

ps3.1:47.3.verse: Yo asekhapaṭisambhidappatto, so tena atireko hoti, adhiko hoti, viseso hoti.

ps3.1:48.1.verse: Dve puggalā paṭisambhidappattā, dvepi pubbayogasampannā, dvepi bahussutā, dvepi desanābahulā, dvepi garūpanissitā, dvepi vihārabahulā, dvepi paccavekkhaṇābahulā, dvepi asekhapaṭisambhidappattā—

ps3.1:48.3.verse: Yo sāvakapāramippatto, so tena atireko hoti, adhiko hoti, viseso hoti.

ps3.1:49.1.verse: Dve puggalā paṭisambhidappattā, dvepi pubbayogasampannā, dvepi bahussutā, dvepi desanābahulā, dvepi garūpanissitā, dvepi vihārabahulā, dvepi paccavekkhaṇābahulā, dvepi asekhapaṭisambhidappattā—

ps3.1:49.3.verse: Yo paccekasambuddho, so tena atireko hoti, adhiko hoti, viseso hoti.

ps3.1:50.1.verse: Paccekabuddhañca sadevakañca lokaṁ upādāya tathāgato arahaṁ sammāsambuddho aggo paṭisambhidappatto paññāpabhedakusalo pabhinnañāṇo adhigatapaṭisambhido catuvesārajjappatto dasabaladhārī purisāsabho purisasīho …pe…

ps3.1:50.2.verse: yepi te khattiyapaṇḍitā brāhmaṇapaṇḍitā gahapatipaṇḍitā samaṇapaṇḍitā nipuṇā kataparappavādā vālavedhirūpā vobhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni, te pañhaṁ abhisaṅkharitvā abhisaṅkharitvā tathāgataṁ upasaṅkamitvā pucchanti gūḷhāni ca paṭicchannāni ca.

ps3.1:50.3.verse: Kathitā visajjitā ca te pañhā bhagavatā honti niddiṭṭhakāraṇā, upakkhittakā ca te bhagavato sampajjanti.

ps3.1:50.4.verse: Atha kho bhagavā tattha atirocati, yadidaṁ paññāyāti aggo paṭisambhidappattoti.

ps3.2:1.3.verse: Iddhiyā kati bhūmiyo, kati pādā, kati padāni, kati mūlāni?

ps3.2:1.9.verse: Iddhiyā catasso bhūmiyo, cattāro pādā, aṭṭha padāni, soḷasa mūlāni.

ps3.2:2.2.verse: Adhiṭṭhānā iddhi, vikubbanā iddhi, manomayā iddhi, ñāṇavipphārā iddhi, samādhivipphārā iddhi, ariyā iddhi, kammavipākajā iddhi, puññavato iddhi, vijjāmayā iddhi, tattha tattha sammāpayogapaccayā ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi.

ps3.2:3.2.verse: Vivekajābhūmi paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ, pītisukhabhūmi dutiyaṁ jhānaṁ, upekkhāsukhabhūmi tatiyaṁ jhānaṁ, adukkhamasukhābhūmi catutthaṁ jhānaṁ.

ps3.2:3.3.verse: Iddhiyā imā catasso bhūmiyo iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya iddhivikubbanatāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivasībhāvāya iddhivesārajjāya saṁvattantīti.

ps3.2:4.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti, cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti, vīmaṁsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti.

ps3.2:4.3.verse: Iddhiyā ime cattāro pādā iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya iddhivikubbanatāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivasībhāvāya iddhivesārajjāya saṁvattantīti.

ps3.2:5.2.verse: Chandañce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṁ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṁ.

ps3.2:5.3.verse: Chando na samādhi, samādhi na chando.

ps3.2:5.5.verse: Vīriyañce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṁ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṁ.

ps3.2:5.6.verse: Vīriyaṁ na samādhi, samādhi na vīriyaṁ.

ps3.2:5.8.verse: Cittañce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṁ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṁ.

ps3.2:5.9.verse: Cittaṁ na samādhi, samādhi na cittaṁ.

ps3.2:5.11.verse: Vīmaṁsañce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṁ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṁ.

ps3.2:5.12.verse: Vīmaṁsā na samādhi, samādhi na vīmaṁsā.

ps3.2:5.14.verse: Iddhiyā imāni aṭṭha padāni iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya iddhivikubbanatāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivasībhāvāya iddhivesārajjāya saṁvattantīti.

ps3.2:6.12.verse: Saddhāya pariggahitaṁ cittaṁ assaddhiye na iñjatīti—āneñjaṁ.

ps3.2:6.13.verse: Vīriyena pariggahitaṁ cittaṁ kosajje na iñjatīti—āneñjaṁ.

ps3.2:6.14.verse: Satiyā pariggahitaṁ cittaṁ pamāde na iñjatīti—āneñjaṁ.

ps3.2:6.15.verse: Samādhinā pariggahitaṁ cittaṁ uddhacce na iñjatīti—āneñjaṁ.

ps3.2:6.16.verse: Paññāya pariggahitaṁ cittaṁ avijjāya na iñjatīti—āneñjaṁ.

ps3.2:6.18.verse: Iddhiyā imāni soḷasa mūlāni iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya iddhivikubbanatāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivasībhāvāya iddhivesārajjāya saṁvattantīti.

ps3.2:7.3.verse: ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti;

ps3.2:7.5.verse: tirokuṭṭaṁ tiropākāraṁ tiropabbataṁ asajjamāno gacchati, seyyathāpi ākāse;

ps3.2:7.8.verse: ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati, seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo;

ps3.2:7.9.verse: imepi candimasūriye evaṁmahiddhike evaṁmahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjati;

ps3.2:8.1.verse: Idhāti imissā diṭṭhiyā imissā khantiyā imissā ruciyā imasmiṁ ādāye imasmiṁ dhamme imasmiṁ vinaye imasmiṁ dhammavinaye imasmiṁ pāvacane imasmiṁ brahmacariye imasmiṁ satthusāsane.

ps3.2:8.4.verse: Bhikkhūti puthujjanakalyāṇako vā hoti bhikkhu sekho vā arahā vā akuppadhammo.

ps3.2:8.5.verse: Anekavihitaṁ iddhividhaṁ paccanubhotīti nānappakāraṁ iddhividhaṁ paccanubhoti.

ps3.2:8.6.verse: Ekopi hutvā bahudhā hotīti pakatiyā eko bahukaṁ āvajjati, sataṁ vā sahassaṁ vā satasahassaṁ vā āvajjati.

ps3.2:8.10.verse: Yathāyasmā cūḷapanthako ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, evamevaṁ so iddhimā cetovasippatto ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti.

ps3.2:8.11.verse: Bahudhāpi hutvā eko hotīti pakatiyā bahuko ekaṁ āvajjati;

ps3.2:8.15.verse: Yathāyasmā cūḷapanthako bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti, evamevaṁ so iddhimā cetovasippatto bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti.

ps3.2:9.1.verse: Āvibhāvanti kenaci anāvaṭaṁ hoti appaṭicchannaṁ vivaṭaṁ pākaṭaṁ.

ps3.2:9.2.verse: Tirobhāvanti kenaci āvaṭaṁ hoti paṭicchannaṁ pihitaṁ paṭikujjitaṁ.

ps3.2:9.3.verse: Tirokuṭṭaṁ tiropākāraṁ tiropabbataṁ asajjamāno gacchati, seyyathāpi ākāseti pakatiyā ākāsakasiṇasamāpattiyā lābhī hoti.

ps3.2:9.9.verse: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto kenaci anāvaṭe aparikkhitte asajjamānā gacchanti, evamevaṁ so iddhimā cetovasippatto tirokuṭṭaṁ tiropākāraṁ tiropabbataṁ asajjamāno gacchati, seyyathāpi ākāse.

ps3.2:10.1.verse: Pathaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṁ karoti, seyyathāpi udaketi pakatiyā āpokasiṇasamāpattiyā lābhī hoti.

ps3.2:10.7.verse: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto udake ummujjanimujjaṁ karonti, evamevaṁ so iddhimā cetovasippatto pathaviyā ummujjanimujjaṁ karoti, seyyathāpi udake.

ps3.2:11.1.verse: Udakepi abhijjamāne gacchati, seyyathāpi pathaviyanti pakatiyā pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiyā lābhī hoti.

ps3.2:11.7.verse: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto abhijjamānāya pathaviyā gacchanti, evamevaṁ so iddhimā cetovasippatto abhijjamāne udake gacchati, seyyathāpi pathaviyaṁ.

ps3.2:12.1.verse: Ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati, seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇoti pakatiyā pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiyā lābhī hoti.

ps3.2:12.6.verse: So ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamatipi tiṭṭhatipi nisīdatipi seyyampi kappeti.

ps3.2:12.7.verse: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto pathaviyā caṅkamantipi tiṭṭhantipi nisīdantipi seyyampi kappenti, evamevaṁ so iddhimā cetovasippatto ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamatipi tiṭṭhatipi nisīdatipi seyyampi kappeti, seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo.

ps3.2:13.1.verse: Imepi candimasūriye evaṁmahiddhike evaṁmahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjatīti idha so iddhimā cetovasippatto nisinnako vā nipannako vā candimasūriye āvajjati.

ps3.2:13.5.verse: So nisinnako vā nipannako vā candimasūriye pāṇinā āmasati parāmasati parimajjati.

ps3.2:13.6.verse: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto kiñcideva rūpagataṁ hatthapāse āmasanti parāmasanti parimajjanti, evamevaṁ so iddhimā cetovasippatto nisinnako vā nipannako vā candimasūriye pāṇinā āmasati parāmasati parimajjati.

ps3.2:14.1.verse: Yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṁ vattetīti sace so iddhimā cetovasippatto brahmalokaṁ gantukāmo hoti, dūrepi santike adhiṭṭhāti—

ps3.2:14.13.verse: Dibbena cakkhunā tassa brahmuno materiality  passati.

ps3.2:14.14.verse: Dibbāya sotadhātuyā tassa brahmuno saddaṁ suṇāti.

ps3.2:14.16.verse: Sace so iddhimā cetovasippatto dissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṁ gantukāmo hoti, kāyavasena cittaṁ pariṇāmeti, kāyavasena cittaṁ adhiṭṭhāti.

ps3.2:14.17.verse: Kāyavasena cittaṁ pariṇāmetvā, kāyavasena cittaṁ adhiṭṭhahitvā, sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamitvā dissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṁ gacchati.

ps3.2:14.18.verse: Sace so iddhimā cetovasippatto adissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṁ gantukāmo hoti, cittavasena kāyaṁ pariṇāmeti, cittavasena kāyaṁ adhiṭṭhāti.

ps3.2:14.19.verse: Cittavasena kāyaṁ pariṇāmetvā, cittavasena kāyaṁ adhiṭṭhahitvā sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamitvā adissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṁ gacchati.

ps3.2:14.20.verse: So tassa brahmuno purato rūpiṁ abhinimmināti manomayaṁ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṁ ahīnindriyaṁ.

ps3.2:14.21.verse: Sace so iddhimā caṅkamati, nimmitopi tattha caṅkamati.

ps3.2:14.22.verse: Sace so iddhimā tiṭṭhati, nimmitopi tattha tiṭṭhati.

ps3.2:14.23.verse: Sace so iddhimā nisīdati, nimmitopi tattha nisīdati.

ps3.2:14.24.verse: Sace so iddhimā seyyaṁ kappeti, nimmitopi tattha seyyaṁ kappeti.

ps3.2:14.25.verse: Sace so iddhimā dhūmāyati, nimmitopi tattha dhūmāyati.

ps3.2:14.26.verse: Sace so iddhimā pajjalati, nimmitopi tattha pajjalati.

ps3.2:14.27.verse: Sace so iddhimā dhammaṁ bhāsati, nimmitopi tattha dhammaṁ bhāsati.

ps3.2:14.28.verse: Sace so iddhimā pañhaṁ pucchati, nimmitopi tattha pañhaṁ pucchati.

ps3.2:14.29.verse: Sace so iddhimā pañhaṁ puṭṭho visajjeti, nimmitopi tattha pañhaṁ puṭṭho visajjeti.

ps3.2:14.30.verse: Sace so iddhimā tena brahmunā saddhiṁ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṁ samāpajjati, nimmitopi tattha tena brahmunā saddhiṁ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṁ samāpajjati.

ps3.2:14.31.verse: Yaññadeva so iddhimā karoti, taṁtadeva hi so nimmito karotīti—

ps3.2:15.2.verse: Sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa abhibhū nāma sāvako brahmaloke ṭhito sahassilokadhātuṁ sarena viññāpesi.

ps3.2:15.5.verse: dissamānenapi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṁ desesi.

ps3.2:15.6.verse: Dissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena, adissamānenapi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṁ desesi.

ps3.2:15.7.verse: So pakativaṇṇaṁ vijahitvā kumārakavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, nāgavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, supaṇṇavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, yakkhavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, indavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, devavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, brahmavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, samuddavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, pabbatavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, vanavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, sīhavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, byagghavaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, dīpivaṇṇaṁ vā dasseti, hatthimpi dasseti, assampi dasseti, rathampi dasseti, pattimpi dasseti, vividhampi senābyūhaṁ dassetīti—

ps3.2:16.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu imamhā kāyā aññaṁ kāyaṁ abhinimmināti rūpiṁ manomayaṁ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṁ ahīnindriyaṁ.

ps3.2:16.8.verse: Seyyathā vā pana puriso asiṁ kosiyā pavāheyya.

ps3.2:16.13.verse: Seyyathā vā pana puriso ahiṁ karaṇḍā uddhareyya.

ps3.2:16.18.verse: Evamevaṁ bhikkhu imamhā kāyā aññaṁ kāyaṁ abhinimmināti rūpiṁ manomayaṁ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṁ ahīnindriyaṁ.

ps3.2:17.11.verse: Āyasmato bākulassa ñāṇavipphārā iddhi, āyasmato saṅkiccassa ñāṇavipphārā iddhi, āyasmato bhūtapālassa ñāṇavipphārā iddhi.

ps3.2:18.8.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless spaceyā rūpasaññāya paṭighasaññāya nānattasaññāya pahānaṭṭho ijjhatīti …pe…

ps3.2:18.9.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of boundless consciousnessyā ākāsānañcāyatanasaññāya pahānaṭṭho ijjhatīti …pe…

ps3.2:18.10.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of nothingnessyā viññāṇañcāyatanasaññāya pahānaṭṭho ijjhatīti …pe…

ps3.2:18.11.verse: The attainment of the base consisting of neither perception nor non-perceptionyā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāya pahānaṭṭho ijjhatīti—

ps3.2:18.13.verse: Āyasmato sāriputtassa samādhivipphārā iddhi, āyasmato sañjīvassa samādhivipphārā iddhi, āyasmato khāṇukoṇḍaññassa samādhivipphārā iddhi, uttarāya upāsikāya samādhivipphārā iddhi, sāmāvatiyā upāsikāya samādhivipphārā iddhi.

ps3.2:19.7.verse: “paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyan”ti, appaṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.

ps3.2:19.9.verse: “appaṭikūle ca paṭikūle ca paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyan”ti, paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.

ps3.2:19.11.verse: “paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca tadubhayaṁ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyyaṁ sato sampajāno”ti, upekkhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno.

ps3.2:20.2.verse: Aniṭṭhasmiṁ vatthusmiṁ mettāya vā pharati, dhātuto vā upasaṁharati.

ps3.2:21.2.verse: Iṭṭhasmiṁ vatthusmiṁ asubhāya vā pharati, aniccato vā upasaṁharati.

ps3.2:22.1.verse: Kathaṁ paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca appaṭikūlasaññī viharati?

ps3.2:22.2.verse: Aniṭṭhasmiñca iṭṭhasmiñca vatthusmiṁ mettāya vā pharati, dhātuto vā upasaṁharati.

ps3.2:22.3.verse: Evaṁ paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca appaṭikūlasaññī viharati.

ps3.2:23.1.verse: Kathaṁ appaṭikūle ca paṭikūle ca paṭikūlasaññī viharati?

ps3.2:23.2.verse: Iṭṭhasmiñca aniṭṭhasmiñca vatthusmiṁ asubhāya vā pharati, aniccato vā upasaṁharati.

ps3.2:23.3.verse: Evaṁ appaṭikūle ca paṭikūle ca paṭikūlasaññī viharati.

ps3.2:24.1.verse: Kathaṁ paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca tadubhayaṁ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno?

ps3.2:24.2.verse: Idha bhikkhu cakkhunā materiality  disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.

ps3.2:24.7.verse: manasā dhammaṁ viññāya neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.

ps3.2:24.8.verse: Evaṁ paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca tadubhayaṁ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.

ps3.2:25.2.verse: Sabbesaṁ pakkhīnaṁ, sabbesaṁ devānaṁ, ekaccānaṁ manussānaṁ, ekaccānaṁ vinipātikānaṁ.

ps3.2:26.2.verse: Rājā cakkavattī vehāsaṁ gacchati saddhiṁ caturaṅginiyā senāya, antamaso assabandhagopurise upādāya.

ps3.2:26.3.verse: Jotikassa gahapatissa puññavato iddhi, jaṭilassa gahapatissa puññavato iddhi, meṇḍakassa gahapatissa puññavato iddhi, ghositassa gahapatissa puññavato iddhi, pañcannaṁ mahāpuññānaṁ puññavato iddhi.

ps3.2:27.2.verse: Vijjādharā vijjaṁ parijappetvā vehāsaṁ gacchanti, ākāse antalikkhe hatthimpi dassenti, assampi dassenti, rathampi dassenti, pattimpi dassenti, vividhampi senābyūhaṁ dassenti.

ps3.2:28.1.verse: Kathaṁ tattha tattha sammāpayogapaccayā ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi?

ps3.2:28.8.verse: Evaṁ tattha tattha sammāpayogapaccayā ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi.

ps3.3:2.1.verse: Hañci cittena abhisameti, tena hi aññāṇī abhisameti?

ps3.3:3.1.verse: Hañci ñāṇena abhisameti, tena hi acittena ca ñāṇena ca acittako abhisameti?

ps3.3:4.1.verse: Hañci cittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti, tena hi kāmāvacaracittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti?

ps3.3:4.2.verse: Na kāmāvacaracittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:5.1.verse: Tena hi rūpāvacaracittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti?

ps3.3:5.2.verse: Na rūpāvacaracittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:6.1.verse: Tena hi arūpāvacaracittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti?

ps3.3:6.2.verse: Na arūpāvacaracittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:7.1.verse: Tena hi kammassakatacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti?

ps3.3:7.2.verse: Na kammassakatacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:8.1.verse: Tena hi saccānulomikacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti?

ps3.3:8.2.verse: Na saccānulomikacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:9.1.verse: Tena hi atītacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti?

ps3.3:9.2.verse: Na atītacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:10.1.verse: Tena hi anāgatacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti?

ps3.3:10.2.verse: Na anāgatacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:11.1.verse: Tena hi paccuppannalokiyacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti?

ps3.3:11.2.verse: Na paccuppannalokiyacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:11.3.verse: Lokuttaramaggakkhaṇe paccuppannacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:12.1.verse: Kathaṁ lokuttaramaggakkhaṇe paccuppannacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti?

ps3.3:12.2.verse: Lokuttaramaggakkhaṇe uppādādhipateyyaṁ cittaṁ ñāṇassa hetu paccayo ca taṁsampayuttaṁ nirodhagocaraṁ dassanādhipateyyaṁ ñāṇaṁ cittassa hetu paccayo ca taṁsampayuttaṁ ñāṇaṁ nirodhagocaraṁ.

ps3.3:12.3.verse: Evaṁ lokuttaramaggakkhaṇe paccuppannacittena ca ñāṇena ca abhisameti.

ps3.3:13.3.verse: Lokuttaramaggakkhaṇe dassanābhisamayo sammādiṭṭhi, abhiniropanābhisamayo sammāsaṅkappo, pariggahābhisamayo sammāvācā, samuṭṭhānābhisamayo sammākammanto, vodānābhisamayo sammāājīvo, paggahābhisamayo sammāvāyāmo, upaṭṭhānābhisamayo sammāsati, avikkhepābhisamayo sammāsamādhi;

ps3.3:13.4.verse: upaṭṭhānābhisamayo satisambojjhaṅgo, pavicayābhisamayo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo, paggahābhisamayo vīriyasambojjhaṅgo, pharaṇābhisamayo pītisambojjhaṅgo, upasamābhisamayo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, avikkhepābhisamayo samādhisambojjhaṅgo, paṭisaṅkhānābhisamayo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo;

ps3.3:13.5.verse: assaddhiye akampiyābhisamayo saddhābalaṁ, kosajje akampiyābhisamayo vīriyabalaṁ, pamāde akampiyābhisamayo satibalaṁ, uddhacce akampiyābhisamayo samādhibalaṁ, avijjāya akampiyābhisamayo paññābalaṁ;

ps3.3:13.6.verse: adhimokkhābhisamayo saddhindriyaṁ, paggahābhisamayo vīriyindriyaṁ, upaṭṭhānābhisamayo satindriyaṁ, avikkhepābhisamayo samādhindriyaṁ, dassanābhisamayo paññindriyaṁ.

ps3.3:13.7.verse: Ādhipateyyaṭṭhena indriyābhisamayo, akampiyaṭṭhena balābhisamayo, niyyānaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgābhisamayo, hetuṭṭhena maggābhisamayo, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satipaṭṭhānābhisamayo, padahaṭṭhena sammappadhānābhisamayo, ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhipādābhisamayo, tathaṭṭhena saccābhisamayo, avikkhepaṭṭhena samathābhisamayo, anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanābhisamayo, ekarasaṭṭhena samathavipassanābhisamayo, anativattanaṭṭhena yuganaddhābhisamayo, saṁvaraṭṭhena sīlavisuddhiabhisamayo, avikkhepaṭṭhena visuddhiabhisamayo, dassanaṭṭhena diṭṭhivisuddhiabhisamayo, muttaṭṭhena vimokkhābhisamayo, paṭivedhaṭṭhena vijjābhisamayo, pariccāgaṭṭhena vimuttiabhisamayo, samucchedaṭṭhena khaye ñāṇaṁ abhisamayo.

ps3.3:13.8.verse: Chando mūlaṭṭhena abhisamayo, manasikāro samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena abhisamayo, contact samodhānaṭṭhena abhisamayo, feeling  samosaraṇaṭṭhena abhisamayo, samādhi pamukhaṭṭhena abhisamayo, sati ādhipateyyaṭṭhena abhisamayo, paññā taduttaraṭṭhena abhisamayo, vimutti sāraṭṭhena abhisamayo, amatogadhaṁ nibbānaṁ pariyosānaṭṭhena abhisamayo.

ps3.3:17.1.verse: Yvāyaṁ kilese pajahati, atīte kilese pajahati …pe…

ps3.3:17.2.verse: anāgate kilese pajahati, paccuppanne kilese pajahati, atīte kilese pajahatīti.

ps3.3:17.3.verse: Hañci atīte kilese pajahati, tena hi khīṇaṁ khepeti, niruddhaṁ nirodheti, vigataṁ vigameti, atthaṅgataṁ atthaṅgameti, atītaṁ yaṁ na atthi taṁ pajahatīti?

ps3.3:17.6.verse: Hañci anāgate kilese pajahati, tena hi ajātaṁ pajahati, anibbattaṁ pajahati, anuppannaṁ pajahati, apātubhūtaṁ pajahati, anāgataṁ yaṁ na atthi taṁ pajahatīti?

ps3.3:17.9.verse: Hañci paccuppanne kilese pajahati, tena hi ratto rāgaṁ pajahati, duṭṭho dosaṁ pajahati, mūḷho mohaṁ pajahati, vinibaddho mānaṁ pajahati, parāmaṭṭho diṭṭhiṁ pajahati, vikkhepagato uddhaccaṁ pajahati, aniṭṭhaṅgato vicikicchaṁ pajahati, thāmagato anusayaṁ pajahati, kaṇhasukkadhammā yuganaddhā samameva vattanti, saṅkilesikā maggabhāvanā hoti?

ps3.3:18.1.verse: Na hi atīte kilese pajahati, na anāgate kilese pajahati, na paccuppanne kilese pajahatīti.

ps3.3:18.2.verse: Hañci na atīte kilese pajahati, na anāgate …pe…

ps3.3:18.3.verse: na paccuppanne kilese pajahati, tena hi natthi maggabhāvanā, natthi phalasacchikiriyā, natthi kilesappahānaṁ, natthi dhammābhisamayoti?

ps3.3:18.4.verse: Atthi maggabhāvanā, atthi phalasacchikiriyā, atthi kilesappahānaṁ, atthi dhammābhisamayo.

ps3.3:18.8.verse: Ye tassa rukkhassa ajātaphalā, te ajātāyeva na jāyanti, anibbattāyeva na nibbattanti, anuppannāyeva na uppajjanti, apātubhūtāyeva na pātubhavanti.

ps3.3:18.9.verse: Evamevaṁ uppādo hetu, uppādo paccayo kilesānaṁ nibbattiyāti.

ps3.3:18.10.verse: Uppāde ādīnavaṁ disvā anuppāde cittaṁ pakkhandati.

ps3.3:18.11.verse: Anuppāde cittassa pakkhandattā ye uppādapaccayā kilesā nibbatteyyuṁ, te ajātāyeva na jāyanti, anibbattāyeva na nibbattanti, anuppannāyeva na uppajjanti, apātubhūtāyeva na pātubhavanti.

ps3.3:18.13.verse: Pavattaṁ hetu, nimittaṁ hetu, āyūhanā hetu.

ps3.3:18.15.verse: Āyūhane ādīnavaṁ disvā anāyūhane cittaṁ pakkhandati.

ps3.3:18.16.verse: Anāyūhane cittassa pakkhandattā, ye āyūhanapaccayā kilesā nibbatteyyuṁ, te ajātāyeva na jāyanti, anibbattāyeva na nibbattanti, anuppannāyeva na uppajjanti, apātubhūtāyeva na pātubhavanti.

ps3.3:18.18.verse: Evaṁ atthi maggabhāvanā, atthi phalasacchikiriyā, atthi kilesappahānaṁ, atthi dhammābhisamayoti.

ps3.4:1.2.verse: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā karīyanti, sabbe te pathaviṁ nissāya pathaviyaṁ patiṭṭhāya evamete balakaraṇīyā kammantā karīyanti;

ps3.4:1.3.verse: evamevaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bhāveti, ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bahulīkaroti.

ps3.4:2.1.verse: Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bhāveti, ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bahulīkaroti?

ps3.4:2.2.verse: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vosaggapariṇāmiṁ.

ps3.4:2.9.verse: sammāsamādhiṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vosaggapariṇāmiṁ.

ps3.4:2.10.verse: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bhāveti, ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bahulīkaroti.

ps3.4:3.1.verse: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci bījagāmabhūtagāmā vuddhiṁ viruḷhiṁ vepullaṁ āpajjanti, sabbe te pathaviṁ nissāya pathaviyaṁ patiṭṭhāya evamete bījagāmabhūtagāmā vuddhiṁ viruḷhiṁ vepullaṁ āpajjanti;

ps3.4:3.2.verse: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bhāvento ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bahulīkaronto vuddhiṁ viruḷhiṁ vepullaṁ pāpuṇāti dhammesu.

ps3.4:4.1.verse: Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bhāvento ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bahulīkaronto vuddhiṁ viruḷhiṁ vepullaṁ pāpuṇāti dhammesu?

ps3.4:4.2.verse: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vosaggapariṇāmiṁ.

ps3.4:4.9.verse: sammāsamādhiṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vosaggapariṇāmiṁ.

ps3.4:4.10.verse: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bhāvento ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ bahulīkaronto vuddhiṁ viruḷhiṁ vepullaṁ pāpuṇāti dhammesū”ti.

ps3.4:5.1.verse: Sammādiṭṭhiyā pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vosaggā, dvādasa nissayā.

ps3.4:5.8.verse: sammāsamādhissa pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vosaggā, dvādasa nissayā.

ps3.4:6.3.verse: Vikkhambhanaviveko ca nīvaraṇānaṁ paṭhamajjhānaṁ bhāvayato, tadaṅgaviveko ca diṭṭhigatānaṁ nibbedhabhāgiyaṁ samādhiṁ bhāvayato, samucchedaviveko ca lokuttaraṁ khayagāmimaggaṁ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhiviveko ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇaviveko ca nirodho nibbānaṁ.

ps3.4:6.5.verse: Imesu pañcasu vivekesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ.

ps3.4:7.3.verse: Vikkhambhanavirāgo ca nīvaraṇānaṁ paṭhamajjhānaṁ bhāvayato, tadaṅgavirāgo ca diṭṭhigatānaṁ nibbedhabhāgiyaṁ samādhiṁ bhāvayato, samucchedavirāgo ca lokuttaraṁ khayagāmimaggaṁ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhivirāgo ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇavirāgo ca nirodho nibbānaṁ.

ps3.4:7.5.verse: Imesu pañcasu virāgesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ.

ps3.4:8.3.verse: Vikkhambhananirodho ca nīvaraṇānaṁ paṭhamajjhānaṁ bhāvayato, tadaṅganirodho ca diṭṭhigatānaṁ nibbedhabhāgiyaṁ samādhiṁ bhāvayato, samucchedanirodho ca lokuttaraṁ khayagāmimaggaṁ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhinirodho ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇanirodho ca amatā dhātu.

ps3.4:8.5.verse: Imesu pañcasu nirodhesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ.

ps3.4:9.3.verse: Vikkhambhanavosaggo ca nīvaraṇānaṁ paṭhamajjhānaṁ bhāvayato, tadaṅgavosaggo ca diṭṭhigatānaṁ nibbedhabhāgiyaṁ samādhiṁ bhāvayato, samucchedavosaggo ca lokuttaraṁ khayagāmimaggaṁ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhivosaggo ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇavosaggo ca nirodho nibbānaṁ.

ps3.4:9.5.verse: Imesu pañcasu vosaggesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ.

ps3.4:9.6.verse: Sammādiṭṭhiyā ime pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vosaggā, dvādasa nissayā.

ps3.4:10.9.verse: Vikkhambhanaviveko ca nīvaraṇānaṁ paṭhamajjhānaṁ bhāvayato, tadaṅgaviveko ca diṭṭhigatānaṁ nibbedhabhāgiyaṁ samādhiṁ bhāvayato, samucchedaviveko ca lokuttaraṁ khayagāmimaggaṁ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhiviveko ca phalakkhaṇe nissaraṇaviveko ca nirodho nibbānaṁ.

ps3.4:10.11.verse: Imesu pañcasu vivekesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ.

ps3.4:11.3.verse: Vikkhambhanavirāgo ca nīvaraṇānaṁ paṭhamajjhānaṁ bhāvayato, tadaṅgavirāgo ca diṭṭhigatānaṁ nibbedhabhāgiyaṁ samādhiṁ bhāvayato, samucchedavirāgo ca lokuttaraṁ khayagāmimaggaṁ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhivirāgo ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇavirāgo ca nirodho nibbānaṁ.

ps3.4:11.5.verse: Imesu pañcasu virāgesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ.

ps3.4:12.3.verse: Vikkhambhananirodho ca nīvaraṇānaṁ paṭhamajjhānaṁ bhāvayato, tadaṅganirodho ca diṭṭhigatānaṁ nibbedhabhāgiyaṁ samādhiṁ bhāvayato, samucchedanirodho ca lokuttaraṁ khayagāmimaggaṁ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhinirodho ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇanirodho ca amatā dhātu.

ps3.4:12.5.verse: Imesu pañcasu nirodhesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ.

ps3.4:13.3.verse: Vikkhambhanavosaggo ca nīvaraṇānaṁ paṭhamajjhānaṁ bhāvayato, tadaṅgavosaggo ca diṭṭhigatānaṁ nibbedhabhāgiyaṁ samādhiṁ bhāvayato, samucchedavosaggo ca lokuttaraṁ khayagāmimaggaṁ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhivosaggo ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇavosaggo ca nirodho nibbānaṁ.

ps3.4:13.5.verse: Imesu pañcasu vosaggesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ.

ps3.4:13.6.verse: Sammāsamādhissa ime pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vosaggā, dvādasa nissayā.

ps3.4:14.1.verse: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā karīyanti, sabbe te pathaviṁ nissāya pathaviyaṁ patiṭṭhāya evamete balakaraṇīyā kammantā karīyanti;

ps3.4:14.2.verse: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti, satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti …pe…

ps3.4:14.3.verse: satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto vuddhiṁ virūḷhiṁ vepullaṁ pāpuṇāti dhammesu …pe…

ps3.4:14.4.verse: pañca balāni bhāveti, pañca balāni bahulīkaroti …pe…

ps3.4:14.5.verse: pañca balāni bhāvento pañca balāni bahulīkaronto vuddhiṁ virūḷhiṁ vepullaṁ pāpuṇāti dhammesu …pe…

ps3.4:15.1.verse: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci bījagāmabhūtagāmā vuddhiṁ virūḷhiṁ vepullaṁ āpajjanti, sabbe te pathaviṁ nissāya pathaviyaṁ patiṭṭhāya evamete bījagāmabhūtagāmā vuddhiṁ virūḷhiṁ vepullaṁ āpajjanti;

ps3.4:15.2.verse: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya pañcindriyāni bhāvento pañcindriyāni bahulīkaronto vuddhiṁ virūḷhiṁ vepullaṁ pāpuṇāti dhammesu.

ps3.4:16.1.verse: Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya pañcindriyāni bhāvento pañcindriyāni bahulīkaronto vuddhiṁ virūḷhiṁ vepullaṁ pāpuṇāti dhammesu?

ps3.4:16.2.verse: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhindriyaṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vosaggapariṇāmiṁ.

ps3.4:16.6.verse: paññindriyaṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vosaggapariṇāmiṁ.

ps3.4:16.7.verse: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṁ nissāya …pe…

ps3.4:17.1.verse: Saddhindriyassa pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vosaggā, dvādasa nissayā.

ps3.4:17.5.verse: paññindriyassa pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vosaggā, dvādasa nissayā.

ps3.4:18.3.verse: Vikkhambhanaviveko ca nīvaraṇānaṁ paṭhamajjhānaṁ bhāvayato, tadaṅgaviveko ca diṭṭhigatānaṁ nibbedhabhāgiyaṁ samādhiṁ bhāvayato, samucchedaviveko ca lokuttaraṁ khayagāmimaggaṁ bhāvayato, paṭippassaddhiviveko ca phalakkhaṇe, nissaraṇaviveko ca nirodho nibbānaṁ.

ps3.4:18.5.verse: Imesu pañcasu vivekesu chandajāto hoti saddhādhimutto, cittañcassa svādhiṭṭhitaṁ …pe…

ps3.4:18.6.verse: saddhindriyassa ime pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vosaggā, dvādasa nissayā.

ps3.4:19.6.verse: paññindriyassa ime pañca vivekā, pañca virāgā, pañca nirodhā, pañca vosaggā, dvādasa nissayāti.

ps3.5:1.2.verse: iriyāpathacariyā, āyatanacariyā, saticariyā, samādhicariyā, ñāṇacariyā, maggacariyā, patticariyā, lokatthacariyāti.

ps3.5:2.8.verse: Lokatthacariyāti tathāgatesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu padese paccekabuddhesu padese sāvakesu.

ps3.5:3.8.verse: Lokatthacariyā ca tathāgatānaṁ arahantānaṁ sammāsambuddhānaṁ padese paccekabuddhānaṁ padese sāvakānaṁ.

ps3.5:4.2.verse: Adhimuccanto saddhāya carati, paggaṇhanto vīriyena carati, upaṭṭhāpento satiyā carati, avikkhepaṁ karonto samādhinā carati, pajānanto paññāya carati, vijānanto viññāṇacariyāya carati, evaṁ paṭipannassa kusalā dhammā āyāpentīti āyatanacariyāya carati, evaṁ paṭipanno visesamadhigacchatīti visesacariyāya carati.

ps3.5:5.2.verse: Dassanacariyā ca sammādiṭṭhiyā, abhiniropanacariyā ca sammāsaṅkappassa, pariggahacariyā ca sammāvācāya, samuṭṭhānacariyā ca sammākammantassa, vodānacariyā ca sammāājīvassa, paggahacariyā ca sammāvāyāmassa, upaṭṭhānacariyā ca sammāsatiyā, avikkhepacariyā ca sammāsamādhissa.

ps3.6:2.2.verse: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco anekavihitaṁ iddhividhaṁ paccanubhoti—

ps3.6:2.3.verse: ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti;

ps3.6:3.3.verse: ‘evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittan’ti.

ps3.6:3.4.verse: So bahuñcepi ādisati, tatheva taṁ hoti, no aññathā.

ps3.6:3.5.verse: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, api ca kho manussānaṁ vā amanussānaṁ vā devatānaṁ vā saddaṁ sutvā ādisati—

ps3.6:3.6.verse: ‘evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittan’ti.

ps3.6:3.7.verse: So bahuñcepi ādisati, tatheva taṁ hoti, no aññathā.

ps3.6:3.8.verse: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, napi manussānaṁ vā amanussānaṁ vā devatānaṁ vā saddaṁ sutvā ādisati, api ca kho vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṁ sutvā ādisati—

ps3.6:3.9.verse: ‘evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittan’ti.

ps3.6:3.10.verse: So bahuñcepi ādisati, tatheva taṁ hoti, no aññathā.

ps3.6:3.11.verse: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, napi manussānaṁ vā amanussānaṁ vā devatānaṁ vā saddaṁ sutvā ādisati, napi vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṁ sutvā ādisati, api ca kho avitakkaṁ avicāraṁ samādhiṁ samāpannassa cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti—

ps3.6:3.12.verse: ‘yathā imassa bhoto manoformations paṇihitā imassa cittassa anantarā amukaṁ nāma vitakkaṁ vitakkayissatī’ti.

ps3.6:3.13.verse: So bahuñcepi ādisati, tatheva taṁ hoti, no aññathā.

ps3.6:4.4.verse: Evaṁ manasi karotha, mā evaṁ manasākattha.

ps3.6:5.3.verse: Ye tena nekkhammena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti—

ps3.6:5.5.verse: “Taṁ kho pana nekkhammaṁ evaṁ āsevitabbaṁ, evaṁ bhāvetabbaṁ, evaṁ bahulīkātabbaṁ, evaṁ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā”ti—

ps3.6:6.3.verse: Ye tena abyāpādena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti—

ps3.6:6.5.verse: “So kho pana abyāpādo evaṁ āsevitabbo, evaṁ bhāvetabbo, evaṁ bahulīkātabbo, evaṁ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā”ti—

ps3.6:7.3.verse: Ye tāya ālokasaññāya samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti—

ps3.6:7.5.verse: “Sā kho pana ālokasaññā evaṁ āsevitabbā, evaṁ bhāvetabbā, evaṁ bahulīkātabbā, evaṁ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā”ti—

ps3.6:8.3.verse: Ye tena avikkhepena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti—

ps3.6:8.5.verse: “So kho pana avikkhepo evaṁ āsevitabbo, evaṁ bhāvetabbo, evaṁ bahulīkātabbo, evaṁ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā”ti—

ps3.6:9.3.verse: Ye tena dhammavavatthānena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti—

ps3.6:9.5.verse: “Taṁ kho pana dhammavavatthānaṁ evaṁ āsevitabbaṁ, evaṁ bhāvetabbaṁ, evaṁ bahulīkātabbaṁ, evaṁ tadanudhammatā, sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā”ti—

ps3.6:10.3.verse: Ye tena ñāṇena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti—

ps3.6:10.5.verse: “Taṁ kho pana ñāṇaṁ evaṁ āsevitabbaṁ, evaṁ bhāvetabbaṁ, evaṁ bahulīkātabbaṁ, evaṁ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā”ti—

ps3.6:11.3.verse: Ye tena pāmojjena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti—

ps3.6:11.5.verse: “Taṁ kho pana pāmojjaṁ evaṁ āsevitabbaṁ, evaṁ bhāvetabbaṁ, evaṁ bahulīkātabbaṁ, evaṁ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā”ti—

ps3.6:12.3.verse: Ye tena paṭhamena jhānena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti—

ps3.6:12.5.verse: “Taṁ kho pana paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ evaṁ āsevitabbaṁ, evaṁ bhāvetabbaṁ, evaṁ bahulīkātabbaṁ, evaṁ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā”ti—

ps3.6:13.3.verse: Ye tena arahattamaggena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti—

ps3.6:13.5.verse: “So kho pana arahattamaggo evaṁ āsevitabbo, evaṁ bhāvetabbo, evaṁ bahulīkātabbo, evaṁ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā”ti—

ps3.6:14.3.verse: Yā ca iddhi yañca pāṭihāriyaṁ, idaṁ vuccati iddhipāṭihāriyaṁ.

ps3.6:14.6.verse: Yā ca iddhi yañca pāṭihāriyaṁ, idaṁ vuccati iddhipāṭihāriyaṁ.

ps3.6:14.11.verse: Yā ca iddhi yañca pāṭihāriyaṁ, idaṁ vuccati iddhipāṭihāriyanti.

ps3.7:1.1.verse: Sabbadhammānaṁ sammāsamucchede nirodhe ca anupaṭṭhānatā paññā samasīsaṭṭhe ñāṇaṁ.

ps3.7:2.1.verse: Sabbadhammānanti pañcakkhandhā, dvādasāyatanāni, aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo, kusalā dhammā, akusalā dhammā, abyākatā dhammā, kāmāvacarā dhammā, rūpāvacarā dhammā, arūpāvacarā dhammā, apariyāpannā dhammā.

ps3.7:2.2.verse: Sammā samucchedeti nekkhammena kāmacchandaṁ sammā samucchindati, abyāpādena byāpādaṁ sammā samucchindati, ālokasaññāya thinamiddhaṁ sammā samucchindati, avikkhepena uddhaccaṁ sammā samucchindati, dhammavavatthānena vicikicchaṁ sammā samucchindati, ñāṇena avijjaṁ sammā samucchindati, pāmojjena aratiṁ sammā samucchindati, paṭhamena jhānena nīvaraṇe sammā samucchindati …pe…

ps3.7:3.1.verse: Nirodheti nekkhammena kāmacchandaṁ nirodheti, abyāpādena byāpādaṁ nirodheti, ālokasaññāya thinamiddhaṁ nirodheti, avikkhepena uddhaccaṁ nirodheti, dhammavavatthānena vicikicchaṁ nirodheti, ñāṇena avijjaṁ nirodheti, pāmojjena aratiṁ nirodheti, paṭhamena jhānena nīvaraṇe nirodheti …pe…

ps3.7:4.1.verse: Anupaṭṭhānatāti nekkhammaṁ paṭiladdhassa kāmacchando na upaṭṭhāti, abyāpādaṁ paṭiladdhassa byāpādo na upaṭṭhāti, ālokasaññaṁ paṭiladdhassa thinamiddhaṁ na upaṭṭhāti, avikkhepaṁ paṭiladdhassa uddhaccaṁ na upaṭṭhāti, dhammavavatthānaṁ paṭiladdhassa vicikicchā na upaṭṭhāti, ñāṇaṁ paṭiladdhassa Ignorance na upaṭṭhāti, pāmojjaṁ paṭiladdhassa arati na upaṭṭhāti, paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ paṭiladdhassa nīvaraṇā na upaṭṭhanti …pe…

ps3.7:5.1.verse: Samanti kāmacchandassa pahīnattā nekkhammaṁ samaṁ, byāpādassa pahīnattā abyāpādo samaṁ, thinamiddhassa pahīnattā ālokasaññā samaṁ, uddhaccassa pahīnattā avikkhepo samaṁ, vicikicchāya pahīnattā dhammavavatthānaṁ samaṁ, avijjāya pahīnattā ñāṇaṁ samaṁ, aratiyā pahīnattā pāmojjaṁ samaṁ, nīvaraṇānaṁ pahīnattā paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ samaṁ …pe…

ps3.7:6.2.verse: palibodhasīsañca taṇhā, vinibandhanasīsañca māno, parāmāsasīsañca diṭṭhi, vikkhepasīsañca uddhaccaṁ, saṅkilesasīsañca avijjā, adhimokkhasīsañca saddhā, paggahasīsañca vīriyaṁ, upaṭṭhānasīsañca sati, avikkhepasīsañca samādhi, dassanasīsañca paññā, pavattasīsañca jīvitindriyaṁ, gocarasīsañca vimokkho, saṅkhārasīsañca nirodhoti.

ps3.8:1.4.verse: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṁ.

ps3.8:1.7.verse: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṁ.

ps3.8:2.2.verse: Idhekacco pathavīkāyaṁ aniccato anupassati, no niccato;

ps3.8:2.7.verse: nirodheti, no samudeti, paṭinissajjati, no ādiyati.

ps3.8:2.8.verse: Aniccato anupassanto niccasaññaṁ pajahati, dukkhato anupassanto sukhasaññaṁ pajahati, anattato anupassanto attasaññaṁ pajahati, nibbindanto nandiṁ pajahati, virajjanto rāgaṁ pajahati, nirodhento samudayaṁ pajahati, paṭinissajjanto ādānaṁ pajahati.

ps3.8:2.12.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena taṁ kāyaṁ anupassati.

ps3.8:3.2.verse: tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.

ps3.8:4.16.verse: virajjati, no rajjati, nirodheti, no samudeti;

ps3.8:4.18.verse: Aniccato anupassanto niccasaññaṁ pajahati, dukkhato anupassanto sukhasaññaṁ pajahati, anattato anupassanto attasaññaṁ pajahati, nibbindanto nandiṁ pajahati, virajjanto rāgaṁ pajahati, nirodhento samudayaṁ pajahati, paṭinissajjanto ādānaṁ pajahati.

ps3.8:4.22.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena taṁ kāyaṁ anupassati.

ps3.8:5.2.verse: tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.

ps3.8:6.2.verse: Idhekacco sukhaṁ vedanaṁ aniccato anupassati, no niccato …pe…

ps3.8:6.9.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena taṁ vedanaṁ anupassati.

ps3.8:7.16.verse: manosamphassajaṁ vedanaṁ aniccato anupassati, no niccato …pe…

ps3.8:7.23.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena taṁ vedanaṁ anupassati.

ps3.8:9.2.verse: Idhekacco sarāgaṁ cittaṁ aniccato anupassati, no niccato …pe…

ps3.8:9.9.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena taṁ cittaṁ anupassati.

ps3.8:11.28.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena taṁ cittaṁ anupassati.

ps3.8:13.2.verse: Idhekacco ṭhapetvā kāyaṁ ṭhapetvā vedanaṁ ṭhapetvā cittaṁ tadavasese dhamme aniccato anupassati, no niccato;

ps3.8:13.9.verse: Aniccato anupassanto niccasaññaṁ pajahati, dukkhato anupassanto sukhasaññaṁ pajahati, anattato anupassanto attasaññaṁ pajahati, nibbindanto nandiṁ pajahati, virajjanto rāgaṁ pajahati, nirodhento samudayaṁ pajahati, paṭinissajjanto ādānaṁ pajahati.

ps3.8:13.10.verse: Imehi sattahi ākārehi te dhamme anupassati.

ps3.8:13.13.verse: Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena te dhamme anupassati.

ps3.8:14.2.verse: tattha jātānaṁ dhammānaṁ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṁ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagavīriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.

ps3.9:1.2.verse: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.

ps3.9:2.1.verse: “So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kañci saṅkhāraṁ niccato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti—

ps3.9:2.5.verse: sammattaniyāmaṁ anokkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṁ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṁ vā anāgāmiphalaṁ vā arahattaṁ vā sacchikarissatīti—

ps3.9:3.1.verse: So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbasaṅkhāre aniccato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti—

ps3.9:3.4.verse: ṭhānametaṁ vijjati, sammattaniyāmaṁ okkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṁ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṁ vā anāgāmiphalaṁ vā arahattaṁ vā sacchikarissatīti—

ps3.9:4.1.verse: So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kañci saṅkhāraṁ sukhato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti—

ps3.9:4.5.verse: sammattaniyāmaṁ anokkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṁ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṁ vā anāgāmiphalaṁ vā arahattaṁ vā sacchikarissatīti—

ps3.9:5.1.verse: So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbasaṅkhāre dukkhato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti—

ps3.9:5.5.verse: sammattaniyāmaṁ okkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṁ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṁ vā anāgāmiphalaṁ vā arahattaṁ vā sacchikarissatīti—

ps3.9:6.1.verse: So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kañci dhammaṁ attato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti—

ps3.9:6.5.verse: sammattaniyāmaṁ anokkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṁ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṁ vā anāgāmiphalaṁ vā arahattaṁ vā sacchikarissatīti—

ps3.9:7.1.verse: So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbadhamme anattato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti—

ps3.9:7.5.verse: sammattaniyāmaṁ okkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṁ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṁ vā anāgāmiphalaṁ vā arahattaṁ vā sacchikarissatīti—

ps3.9:8.1.verse: So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nibbānaṁ dukkhato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti—

ps3.9:8.5.verse: sammattaniyāmaṁ anokkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṁ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṁ vā anāgāmiphalaṁ vā arahattaṁ vā sacchikarissatīti—

ps3.9:9.1.verse: So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nibbānaṁ sukhato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti—

ps3.9:9.5.verse: sammattaniyāmaṁ okkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṁ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṁ vā anāgāmiphalaṁ vā arahattaṁ vā sacchikarissatīti—

ps3.9:10.1.verse: Katihākārehi anulomikaṁ khantiṁ paṭilabhati, katihākārehi sammattaniyāmaṁ okkamati?

ps3.9:10.2.verse: Cattārīsāya ākārehi anulomikaṁ khantiṁ paṭilabhati, cattārīsāya ākārehi sammattaniyāmaṁ okkamati.

ps3.9:11.1.verse: Katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi anulomikaṁ khantiṁ paṭilabhati, katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi sammattaniyāmaṁ okkamati?

ps3.9:11.2.verse: Pañcakkhandhe aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato ītito upaddavato bhayato upasaggato calato pabhaṅguto addhuvato atāṇato aleṇato asaraṇato rittato tucchato suññato anattato ādīnavato vipariṇāmadhammato asārakato aghamūlato vadhakato vibhavato sāsavato saṅkhatato mārāmisato jātidhammato jarādhammato byādhidhammato maraṇadhammato sokadhammato paridevadhammato upāyāsadhammato saṅkilesikadhammato.
